WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(ends_on, starts_on) / 7 weeks_starts_on_to_ends_on,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') resolved_channel
    FROM promotions
    WHERE ends_on > TO_DATE('2023-12-12')
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on DESC, id) = 1
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(promo_code) promo_code_upper,
        ROUND(discount_pct, 1) discount_pct_rounded
    FROM ranked
    WHERE channel IS DISTINCT FROM 'store'
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT channel, promo_code
    FROM valid
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT channel, promo_code
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IN ('mobile', 'store')
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.channel = k.channel AND s.promo_code = k.promo_code
),
attributed AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM kept_rows src
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON src.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND src.ends_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
)
SELECT
    id,
    channel,
    promo_code,
    starts_on,
    ends_on,
    weeks_starts_on_to_ends_on,
    resolved_channel,
    promo_code_upper,
    discount_pct_rounded
FROM attributed
ORDER BY id DESC, ends_on
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("starts_on").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-12-12"))) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("weeks_starts_on_to_ends_on", (F.datediff("ends_on", "starts_on") / 7))
    .withColumn("resolved_channel", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

valid = (
    ranked
    .filter(~F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("store")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.upper("promo_code").alias("promo_code_upper"),
        F.round("discount_pct", 1).alias("discount_pct_rounded"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    valid
    .select("channel", "promo_code")
    .subtract(
        df_promotions
        .filter(F.col("channel").isin(["mobile", "store"]))
        .select("channel", "promo_code")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("k.channel")) & (F.col("s.promo_code") == F.col("k.promo_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

attributed = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("src.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & F.col("src.ends_on").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

result = (
    attributed
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "weeks_starts_on_to_ends_on",
        "resolved_channel",
        "promo_code_upper",
        "discount_pct_rounded",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc(), "ends_on")
)

sql: with base as (select id, store_id, order_date, status, amount, discount, shipping_fee, upper(status) status_upper, coalesce(channel, 'UNKNOWN') channel_clean from orders where order_date >= date '2023-06-05' and store_id is not null) select p.city, src.status, count(*) as cnt, min(src.discount) as min_discount, grouping_id() as level_id from base src inner join stores p on src.store_id = p.id group by grouping sets ((p.city, src.status), (p.city), ());

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-05").cast("date")) & F.col("store_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.upper("status").alias("status_upper"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("src.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .groupingSets(
        [["city", "status"], ["city"], []],
        F.col("p.city").alias("city"),
        F.col("src.status").alias("status"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min(F.col("src.discount")).alias("min_discount"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
)

with filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        cast(quantity as string) as quantity_num,
        cast(quantity as double) as quantity_num_2
    from inventory
    where last_restock >= to_date('2023-09-17')
),
joined as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select src.*, p.cost
    from filtered src
    left join products p
        on src.product_id = p.id
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        stddev_samp(quantity_num_2) over w_hist as store_id_stddev_samp_quantity_num_2,
        cume_dist() over (partition by date_trunc('MONTH', last_restock) order by cost desc nulls last) as cost_cume_dist,
        row_number() over w_hist_2 as event_seq,
        avg(cost) over w_ordered as cost_avg_5_prior
    from joined
    where quantity < 124
    window w_hist as (partition by store_id), w_hist_2 as (partition by date_trunc('YEAR', last_restock), product_id order by cost, id), w_ordered as (partition by store_id order by quantity_num_2, id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding)
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.store_id,
        a.quantity,
        a.quantity_num,
        a.quantity_num_2,
        a.store_id_stddev_samp_quantity_num_2,
        d.city,
        d.sqft
    from with_windows a
    left join stores d
        on a.store_id = d.id
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
select
    d.city as store_city,
    d.region,
    src.city as inventory_city,
    count(*) as cnt,
    max(src.quantity_num_2) as max_quantity_num_2
from enriched src
join stores d on src.store_id = d.id
group by grouping sets ((d.city, d.region, src.city), (d.city, d.region), (d.city), ());

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "last_restock")).orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_last())
w_hist_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "last_restock"), "product_id").orderBy("cost", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("quantity_num_2", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)

filtered = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-17")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("quantity").cast("string").alias("quantity_num"),
        F.col("quantity").cast("double").alias("quantity_num_2"),
    )
)

joined = (
    filtered
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.cost"))
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("quantity") < 124)
    .withColumn("store_id_stddev_samp_quantity_num_2", F.stddev_samp("quantity_num_2").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("cost_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w2))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_hist_2))
    .withColumn("cost_avg_5_prior", F.avg("cost").over(w_ordered))
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.store_id",
        "a.quantity",
        "a.quantity_num",
        "a.quantity_num_2",
        "a.store_id_stddev_samp_quantity_num_2",
        F.col("d.city"),
        F.col("d.sqft"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("src.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .groupingSets(
        [["store_city", "region", "inventory_city"], ["store_city", "region"], ["store_city"], []],
        F.col("d.city").alias("store_city"),
        F.col("d.region").alias("region"),
        F.col("src.city").alias("inventory_city"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.max(F.col("src.quantity_num_2")).alias("max_quantity_num_2"),
    )
)

WITH enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        status,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS monthly_fee_avg_6_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC NULLS LAST) AS monthly_fee_rank,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_monthly_fee
    FROM subscriptions
)
SELECT
    id,
    start_date,
    monthly_fee_avg_6_prior,
    cumulative_monthly_fee
FROM enriched;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

enriched = (
    df_subscriptions
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("monthly_fee_avg_6_prior"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("monthly_fee_rank"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w3).alias("cumulative_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select("id", "start_date", "monthly_fee_avg_6_prior", "cumulative_monthly_fee")
)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        CAST(quantity AS STRING) quantity_str,
        FLOOR(quantity) quantity_whole
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock > DATE '2023-09-07'
      AND last_restock <= '2024-02-01'
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.store_id,
        src.quantity,
        src.last_restock,
        src.quantity_str,
        s.store_name
    FROM base src
    LEFT JOIN stores s
        ON src.store_id = s.id
    WHERE s.sqft BETWEEN 8512 AND 15260
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        last_restock,
        quantity_str,
        store_name,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, id) quantity_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_restock, id) row_seq
    FROM joined
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        last_restock,
        quantity_str,
        quantity_bucket,
        row_seq,
        CEIL(row_seq) row_seq_whole
    FROM scored
    WHERE UPPER(store_name) LIKE '%IRP%'
),
valid_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        last_restock,
        quantity_str,
        row_seq,
        row_seq_whole,
        quantity_bucket * row_seq quantity_bucket_times_row_seq
    FROM valid
    WHERE last_restock > DATE '2023-04-29'
)
SELECT
    id,
    last_restock,
    quantity_str,
    row_seq,
    row_seq_whole,
    quantity_bucket_times_row_seq
FROM valid_inventory;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")

base = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") > F.lit("2023-09-07").cast("date")) & (F.col("last_restock") <= "2024-02-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.col("quantity").cast("string").alias("quantity_str"),
        F.floor("quantity").alias("quantity_whole"),
    )
)

joined = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("src.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("s.sqft").between(8512, 15260))
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.store_id",
        "src.quantity",
        "src.last_restock",
        "src.quantity_str",
        F.col("s.store_name"),
    )
)

scored = (
    joined
    .select(
        "id",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_str",
        "store_name",
        F.ntile(5).over(w).alias("quantity_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.upper("store_name").like("%IRP%"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_str",
        "quantity_bucket",
        "row_seq",
        F.ceil("row_seq").alias("row_seq_whole"),
    )
)

valid_inventory = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") > F.lit("2023-04-29").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_str",
        "row_seq",
        "row_seq_whole",
        (F.col("quantity_bucket") * F.col("row_seq")).alias("quantity_bucket_times_row_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid_inventory
    .select(
        "id",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_str",
        "row_seq",
        "row_seq_whole",
        "quantity_bucket_times_row_seq",
    )
)

with with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        avg(amount) over (partition by status order by cast(paid_at as bigint) range between 2592000 preceding and current row) as amount_avg_30d,
        ntile(3) over (order by amount, id) as amount_bucket,
        first_value(method, true) over (partition by method order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_method
    from payments
    where status <> 'REFUNDED'
),
deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        paid_at,
        status,
        amount_avg_30d,
        amount_bucket,
        first_known_method
    from with_windows
    qualify row_number() over (partition by order_id order by paid_at desc, id) = 1
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when paid_at - lag(paid_at) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id) > interval 14 days then 1 else 0 end as new_group_flag
    from deduped
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(new_group_flag) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from flagged
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when paid_at - lag(paid_at) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id) > interval 14 days then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from sessionized
),
sessions_payments as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from with_gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when amount_avg_30d >= 1305 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as amount_avg_30d_tier,
    case when amount_bucket >= 9 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as amount_bucket_tier,
    date_trunc('year', paid_at) as year_start,
    max(session_no) filter (where status = 'REFUNDED') as refunded_max_session_no,
    count(distinct status) as distinct_status,
    sort_array(collect_set(status)) as status_list
from sessions_payments
group by case when amount_avg_30d >= 1305 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, case when amount_bucket >= 9 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, date_trunc('year', paid_at)
order by amount_avg_30d_tier nulls first

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("amount", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_windows = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("status") != "REFUNDED")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("amount").over(w).alias("amount_avg_30d"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w2).alias("amount_bucket"),
        F.first("method", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("first_known_method"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "amount_avg_30d",
        "amount_bucket",
        "first_known_method",
    )
)

flagged = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w5) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w6))

with_gaps = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w5) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w6))

result = (
    sessions_payments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount_avg_30d") >= 1305, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("amount_avg_30d_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("amount_bucket") >= 9, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("amount_bucket_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("year", "paid_at").alias("year_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max(F.when(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED", F.col("session_no"))).alias("refunded_max_session_no"),
        F.countDistinct("status").alias("distinct_status"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("amount_avg_30d_tier").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        d.browser,
        d.country
    FROM web_events s
    LEFT JOIN sessions d
        ON s.session_id = d.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(event_time), event_type ORDER BY duration_sec NULLS LAST) AS duration_sec_rank,
        MAX(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) AS session_id_max_duration_sec
    FROM enriched
    WHERE event_type = 'purchase'
),
enriched_web_events AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        page,
        duration_sec,
        country,
        duration_sec_rank,
        COUNT(duration_sec) OVER w_hist AS running_count_duration_sec,
        MIN(duration_sec) OVER w_hist AS running_min_duration_sec,
        MAX(duration_sec) OVER w_hist AS running_max_duration_sec
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY session_id_max_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT event_type, page
    FROM enriched_web_events
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT event_type, page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE duration_sec >= 275
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched_web_events s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.event_type = k.event_type AND s.page = k.page
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        page,
        country,
        duration_sec_rank,
        AVG(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_avg_duration_sec
    FROM kept_rows
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN country_avg_duration_sec >= 454 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS country_avg_duration_sec_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS distinct_countries,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(country_avg_duration_sec, 0.9) AS country_avg_duration_sec_p90,
    SUM(country_avg_duration_sec) AS total_country_avg_duration_sec
FROM scored
GROUP BY CASE WHEN country_avg_duration_sec >= 454 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY total_country_avg_duration_sec NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.year("event_time"), "event_type").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last())

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("session_id_max_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country")

enriched = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")

)

    .withColumn("duration_sec_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("session_id_max_duration_sec", F.max("duration_sec").over(w2))

    .select(
        "id",
        "event_type",

        "event_type",

    WHERE last_restock >= TO_DATE('2023-03-06')
      AND store_id IN (3, 4)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY last_restock_plus_months DESC, id) AS rn
        FROM valid
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1

latest AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        last_restock_minus_26d,
        last_restock_plus_months
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY rn DESC, id) = 1

latest_inventory AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        last_restock_minus_26d
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_restock_plus_months NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
        FROM latest
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
valid_inventory AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATE_ADD(last_restock_minus_26d, 52) last_restock_minus_26d_plus_52d
    FROM latest_inventory
    WHERE last_restock_minus_26d > '2025-04-01'
)

    store_id,

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        status,
        COALESCE(balance, 0) AS balance_filled,
        COALESCE(status, 'NONE') AS resolved_status
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'CLOSED'
      AND account_type = 'CHECKING'
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.account_type,
        s.status,
        s.balance_filled,
        latest.txn_type
    FROM base s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_type
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND TO_DATE(c.txn_time) < '2023-07-01'
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        account_type,
        FIRST_VALUE(status, TRUE) OVER w_hist AS first_known_status,
        LAG(balance_filled, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance_filled, id) AS prev_balance_filled
    FROM kept
    WHERE status = 'OPEN'
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY balance_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("balance_filled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance_filled", "id")

base = (
    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("status").eqNullSafe(F.lit("CLOSED"))) & (F.col("account_type") == "CHECKING"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "status",
        F.coalesce("balance", F.lit(0)).alias("balance_filled"),
        F.coalesce("status", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_status"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.account_type",
        "s.status",
        "s.balance_filled",
        F.col("c.txn_type"),
    )
)

kept = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.to_date(F.col("c.txn_time")) < "2023-07-01"), "left_semi")
)

enriched = (
    kept

    .select(
        "id",
        "account_type",
        F.first("status", ignorenulls=True).over(w_hist).alias("first_known_status"),
        F.lag("balance_filled", 1).over(w3).alias("prev_balance_filled"),
    )
)

kept_accounts = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.amount") <= 2700), "left_semi")
)

summary = (
    kept_accounts
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_balance_filled") >= 66, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("prev_balance_filled_tier"),
    )

        F.max(F.when(F.col("account_type") == "CHECKING", F.col("prev_balance_filled"))).alias("checking_max_prev_balance_filled"),

        F.size(F.collect_set("account_type")).alias("num_account_types"),
    )
)

        "checking_max_prev_balance_filled",

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        COALESCE(store_name, 'Unknown') AS store_name_filled,
        COALESCE(region, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_region
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2023-09-11'
      AND region IS NOT NULL
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching order per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.store_name,
        s.opened_date,
        s.sqft,
        s.resolved_region,
        latest.status
    FROM valid s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY sqft, id) AS seq_no,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sqft_avg_6_prior,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(opened_date), status ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sqft_avg_6_prior_2,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', opened_date), status) AS opened_date_period_avg_sqft
    FROM with_latest
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        sqft,
        resolved_region,
        status,
        seq_no,
        ROUND(sqft_avg_6_prior_2, 0) AS sqft_avg_6_prior_2_rounded,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), opened_date) AS days_since_opened_date
    FROM metrics
    WHERE sqft = 9672
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN sqft_avg_6_prior_2_rounded >= 83 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS sqft_avg_6_prior_2_rounded_tier,
    CASE WHEN sqft >= 13080 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS sqft_tier,
    BIT_AND(sqft) AS sqft_bit_and,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    ROUND(SUM(sqft_avg_6_prior_2_rounded) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS sqft_avg_6_prior_2_rounded_per_completed
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY CASE WHEN sqft_avg_6_prior_2_rounded >= 83 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN sqft >= 13080 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY sqft_avg_6_prior_2_rounded_tier;

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(browser, 'N/A') AS browser_filled,
        SUBSTRING(country, 1, 2) AS country_prefix
    FROM sessions
    WHERE device = 'desktop'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.device,
        e.browser,
        e.country,
        e.browser_filled,
        c.signup_date,
        c.email,
        c.name
    FROM base e
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON e.customer_id <=> c.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY signup_date, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS event_seq_2
    FROM joined
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY signup_date DESC, id), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY signup_date DESC, id)
),
enriched_sessions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER w_part AS running_sum_seq_no,
        AVG(seq_no) OVER w_part AS running_avg_seq_no,
        COUNT(seq_no) OVER w_part AS running_count_seq_no,
        ROUND(seq_no / SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 4) AS seq_no_share
    FROM enriched
    WHERE event_seq = 8
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY event_seq_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    running_count_seq_no,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(event_seq, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS event_seq_quartiles,
    MIN(event_seq) AS min_event_seq,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(seq_no, 0.5) AS seq_no_p50
FROM enriched_sessions
GROUP BY running_count_seq_no
HAVING seq_no_p50 > 0;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("signup_date", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy(F.col("signup_date").desc(), "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("signup_date").desc(), "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("event_seq_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("device") == "desktop") & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("browser_filled", F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("N/A")))
    .withColumn("country_prefix", F.substring("country", 1, 2))
)

joined = (
    base
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("e.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.customer_id",
        "e.device",
        "e.browser",
        "e.country",
        "e.browser_filled",
        F.col("c.signup_date"),
        F.col("c.email"),
        F.col("c.name"),
    )

        "customer_id",

        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("event_seq_2"),
    )

enriched_sessions = (
    enriched

    .select(

        F.avg("seq_no").over(w_part).alias("running_avg_seq_no"),
        F.count("seq_no").over(w_part).alias("running_count_seq_no"),
        F.round((F.col("seq_no") / F.sum("seq_no").over(w5)), 4).alias("seq_no_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_sessions
    .groupBy("running_count_seq_no")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("event_seq_quartiles"),
        F.min("event_seq").alias("min_event_seq"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no", 0.5).alias("seq_no_p50"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("seq_no_p50") > 0)
)

with prev_events as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(paid_at) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at, id) as prev_paid_at
    from payments
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_paid_at is null or paid_at > prev_paid_at + interval 7 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from prev_events
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from flagged
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        src.*,
        o.status as order_status,
        o.order_date
    from islands src
    left join orders o
        on src.order_id = o.id
),
with_prev as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(paid_at) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id) as prev_paid_at_2
    from enriched
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_paid_at_2 is null or paid_at > prev_paid_at_2 + interval 14 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst_2
    from with_prev
),
islands_payments as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst_2) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from gaps
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        min(is_new_burst_2) over (partition by order_id order by prev_paid_at, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_min_is_new_burst_2,
        count(is_new_burst_2) over (partition by order_id order by prev_paid_at, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_count_is_new_burst_2,
        max(is_new_burst_2) over (partition by order_id order by prev_paid_at, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_max_is_new_burst_2,
        sum(is_new_burst_2) over (partition by order_id order by prev_paid_at, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_sum_is_new_burst_2,
        sum(session_no) over (partition by order_status order by order_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_session_no
    from islands_payments
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        avg(last4_sum_is_new_burst_2) over w_ordered as running_avg_last4_sum_is_new_burst_2,
        sum(last4_sum_is_new_burst_2) over w_ordered as running_sum_last4_sum_is_new_burst_2,
        count(last4_sum_is_new_burst_2) over w_ordered as running_count_last4_sum_is_new_burst_2
    from scored
    where method is not null
    window w_ordered as (partition by order_id order by running_session_no, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        coalesce(last4_count_is_new_burst_2, 0) as last4_count_is_new_burst_2_filled,
        coalesce(method, 'UNKNOWN') as method_clean
    from with_windows
    where session_id between 5 and 8
),
cleaned_payments as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        least(is_new_burst_2, session_no) as least_is_new_burst_2_session_no,
        date_trunc('MONTH', order_date) as order_date_period,
        coalesce(order_status, 'UNKNOWN') as resolved_order_status
    from cleaned
    where method is not distinct from 'promptpay'

    amount,

    is_new_burst,

    running_session_no,

    order_date_period,
    dense_rank() over (partition by year(prev_paid_at), method order by last4_min_is_new_burst_2 nulls first) as last4_min_is_new_burst_2_dense_rank,
    first_value(least_is_new_burst_2_session_no, true) over (partition by to_date(prev_paid_at), order_status order by last4_count_is_new_burst_2_filled, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_least_is_new_burst_2_session_no,
    lag(session_id, 2) over (partition by method order by is_new_burst_2, id) as prev_session_id
from cleaned_payments

    .withColumn("method_clean", F.coalesce("method", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

cleaned_payments = (

    .filter(F.col("method").eqNullSafe(F.lit("promptpay")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.least("is_new_burst_2", "session_no").alias("least_is_new_burst_2_session_no"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "order_date").alias("order_date_period"),

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        k,
        v
    from carts
    lateral view explode(attributes) t as k, v
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, rank() over (partition by k order by created_at) as dedup_rank
    from flattened
    qualify dedup_rank = 1
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.customer_id,
        a.created_at,
        a.k,
        a.v,
        a.dedup_rank,
        b.email
    from ranked a
    left join customers b
        on a.customer_id <=> b.id
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when created_at - lag(created_at) over (partition by k order by created_at, id, k) > interval 15 minutes then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from enriched
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by k order by created_at, id, k rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from with_gaps
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when created_at - lag(created_at) over (partition by customer_id order by created_at, id, k) > interval 30 minutes then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session_2
    from islands
),
sessions_carts as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session_2) over (partition by customer_id order by created_at, id, k rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id_2
    from flagged
),
joined as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.created_at,
        s.k,
        s.v,
        s.dedup_rank,
        s.is_new_session_2,
        p.country,
        p.email as customer_email
    from sessions_carts s
    left join customers p
        on s.customer_id = p.id
)
select
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.created_at,
    s.k,
    s.dedup_rank,
    s.is_new_session_2,
    s.customer_email,
    (select avg(o2.discount) from orders o2 where o2.customer_id = s.customer_id) as avg_order_discount
from joined s
order by is_new_session_2 desc nulls first;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("created_at")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("created_at", "id", "k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("created_at", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("created_at", "id", "k")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("created_at", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
discount_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.avg("discount").alias("avg_order_discount"))

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode("attributes").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    ranked
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("a.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.customer_id",
        "a.created_at",
        "a.k",
        "a.v",
        "a.dedup_rank",
        F.col("b.email"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("created_at") - F.lag("created_at").over(w2) > F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w3))

flagged = (
    islands
    .withColumn("is_new_session_2", F.when(F.col("created_at") - F.lag("created_at").over(w4) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_carts = flagged.withColumn("burst_id_2", F.sum("is_new_session_2").over(w5))

joined = (
    sessions_carts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.created_at",
        "s.k",
        "s.v",
        "s.dedup_rank",
        "s.is_new_session_2",
        F.col("p.country"),
        F.col("p.email").alias("customer_email"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .join(discount_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        "k",
        "dedup_rank",
        "is_new_session_2",
        "customer_email",
        F.col("avg_order_discount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_new_session_2").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS key, v
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY latency_ms, id, key) AS rank_in_group
    FROM lines
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host, key ORDER BY rank_in_group DESC, id, key) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms DESC, id, key) AS latency_ms_bucket
    FROM latest
    WHERE level IN ('ERROR', 'WARN')
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        v,
        seq_no,
        latency_ms_bucket,
        COUNT(latency_ms_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY latency_ms_bucket, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_latency_ms_bucket,
        AVG(latency_ms_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY latency_ms_bucket, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_latency_ms_bucket,
        MAX(latency_ms_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY latency_ms_bucket, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_latency_ms_bucket
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    id,
    latency_ms,
    key,
    running_avg_latency_ms_bucket,
    running_max_latency_ms_bucket
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY running_max_latency_ms_bucket

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("host", "key").orderBy(F.col("rank_in_group").desc(), "id", "key")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc(), "id", "key")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("latency_ms_bucket", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select("id", "host", "level", "latency_ms", F.explode("context").alias("key", "v"))
)

latest = (
    lines
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("level").isin(["ERROR", "WARN"]))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w3))
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "latency_ms",
        "key",
        "v",
        "seq_no",
        "latency_ms_bucket",
        F.count("latency_ms_bucket").over(w4).alias("running_count_latency_ms_bucket"),
        F.avg("latency_ms_bucket").over(w4).alias("running_avg_latency_ms_bucket"),
        F.max("latency_ms_bucket").over(w4).alias("running_max_latency_ms_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "latency_ms",
        "key",
        "running_avg_latency_ms_bucket",
        "running_max_latency_ms_bucket",
    )
    .orderBy("running_max_latency_ms_bucket")
)

    MAX(paid_at) AS ended_at,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(burst_id, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS burst_id_quartiles

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_gaps = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_payments
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "paid_at").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("burst_id"), 2).alias("avg_burst_id"),
        F.max("paid_at").alias("ended_at"),
        F.percentile_approx("burst_id", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("burst_id_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_burst_id").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM promotions
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, UPPER(channel) AS channel_upper
    FROM latest
    WHERE starts_on > DATE '2023-04-12'
      AND promo_code = 'VIP'
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS discount_pct_avg_3_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY rank_in_group DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) AS discount_pct_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        rank_in_group,
        channel_upper,
        discount_pct_avg_3_prior,
        seq_no,
        discount_pct_cume_dist,
        FLOOR(discount_pct) AS discount_pct_whole,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), ends_on) AS days_since_ends_on,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_channel
    FROM scored
    WHERE discount_pct_avg_3_prior != 0
)
SELECT
    id,
    starts_on,
    discount_pct,
    rank_in_group,
    discount_pct_avg_3_prior,
    discount_pct_cume_dist,
    days_since_ends_on,
    resolved_channel
FROM filtered
ORDER BY starts_on DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy(F.col("rank_in_group").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())

latest = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

cleaned = (
    latest
    .filter((F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2023-04-12").cast("date")) & (F.col("promo_code") == "VIP"))
    .select("*", F.upper("channel").alias("channel_upper"))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("discount_pct").over(w2).alias("discount_pct_avg_3_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("seq_no"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("discount_pct_cume_dist"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct_avg_3_prior") != 0)
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "rank_in_group",
        "channel_upper",
        "discount_pct_avg_3_prior",
        "seq_no",
        "discount_pct_cume_dist",
        F.floor("discount_pct").alias("discount_pct_whole"),
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "ends_on").alias("days_since_ends_on"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "rank_in_group",
        "discount_pct_avg_3_prior",
        "discount_pct_cume_dist",
        "days_since_ends_on",
        "resolved_channel",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("starts_on").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN country IN ('SG', 'TH') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS country_group,
        CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_singapore
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city = 'New York'
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT country, city
    FROM valid
    EXCEPT
    SELECT country, city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE supplier_name LIKE '%Imports%'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.country = k.country AND s.city = k.city
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.stock_qty < 220
        )
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.launch_date < '2023-08-15'
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        is_singapore,
        STDDEV_SAMP(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city) AS country_stddev_samp_rating,
        RANK() OVER w_hist AS is_singapore_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY is_singapore DESC NULLS LAST) AS is_singapore_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_ordered AS rating_rank,
        ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) AS rating_share
    FROM kept
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY is_singapore NULLS LAST), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST)
),
kept_suppliers AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.stock_qty IS NOT NULL
        )
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(city) AS city_length,
        COALESCE(city, 'DIRECT') AS city_clean
    FROM kept_suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND city IS DISTINCT FROM 'London'
),
daily AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        city,
        COUNT_IF(city = 'New York') AS new_york_events,
        SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN city_length ELSE 0 END) AS singapore_city_length,
        MAX(is_singapore_dense_rank) AS max_is_singapore_dense_rank,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list
    FROM base
    GROUP BY city
)
SELECT city, singapore_city_length
FROM daily
ORDER BY singapore_city_length, city DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country", "city")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy(F.col("is_singapore").asc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("is_singapore").desc_nulls_last())
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("country")

valid = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city") == "New York")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("country").isin(["SG", "TH"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("country_group"),
        F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_singapore"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    valid
    .select("country", "city")
    .subtract(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("supplier_name").like("%Imports%"))
        .select("country", "city")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")) & (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

eligible = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.stock_qty") < 220), "left_anti")
)

kept = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.launch_date") < "2023-08-15"), "left_anti")
)

with_windows = (
    kept
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "is_singapore",
        F.stddev_samp("rating").over(w).alias("country_stddev_samp_rating"),
        F.rank().over(w_hist).alias("is_singapore_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("is_singapore_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_ordered).alias("rating_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w5)), 4).alias("rating_share"),
    )
)

kept_suppliers = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.stock_qty").isNotNull()), "left_semi")
)

base = (
    kept_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & (~F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("London"))))
    .withColumn("city_length", F.length("city"))
    .withColumn("city_clean", F.coalesce("city", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

daily = (
    base
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("city") == "New York").alias("new_york_events"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", F.col("city_length")).otherwise(0)).alias("singapore_city_length"),
        F.max("is_singapore_dense_rank").alias("max_is_singapore_dense_rank"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select("city", "singapore_city_length")
    .orderBy("singapore_city_length", F.col("city").desc())
)

with cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        status,
        concat(status, ' - ', plan) as status_plan
    from subscriptions
    where customer_id is not null
      and plan = 'premium'
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select status, customer_id
    from cleaned
    intersect
    select status, customer_id
    from subscriptions
    where customer_id is not null
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from cleaned s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.status = k.status and s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select a.*, c.country
    from verified a
    left join customers c
        on a.customer_id = c.id
),
cleaned_subscriptions as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        start_date,
        status,
        add_months(end_date, 12) as end_date_plus_months,
        case when plan in ('basic', 'premium') then 'Priority' else 'Other' end as plan_group,
        coalesce(country, 'N/A') as country_filled
    from with_dims
    where plan in ('basic', 'premium')
),
with_dims_subscriptions as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        e.customer_id,
        e.status,
        e.end_date_plus_months,
        e.plan_group,
        p.country
    from cleaned_subscriptions e
    left join customers p
        on e.customer_id = p.id
),
with_dims_subscriptions_2 as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select s.*, b.segment
    from with_dims_subscriptions s
    inner join customers b
        on s.customer_id = b.id
    where b.city in ('Tokyo', 'Berlin')
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    date_trunc('quarter', end_date_plus_months) as quarter_start,
    size(collect_set(status)) as num_status,
    count_if(segment = 'Corporate') as corporate_events,
    count(*) as cnt,
    count_if(status = 'CANCELLED') as cancelled_events
from with_dims_subscriptions_2
group by quarter_start

cleaned = (

        .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())

    .select("s.*")
)

with_dims = (

    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("c.country"))

        F.coalesce("country", F.lit("N/A")).alias("country_filled"),

)

with_dims_subscriptions_2 = (

    .filter(F.col("b.city").isin(["Tokyo", "Berlin"]))

result = (

        F.count_if(F.col("segment") == "Corporate").alias("corporate_events"),

WITH kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM departments s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees x
            WHERE x.dept_id = s.id
              AND x.job_title NOT IN ('Designer', 'Manager', 'Director')
        )
),
kept_departments AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees x
            WHERE x.dept_id = s.id
              AND x.level IN ('L2', 'L1', 'L5')
        )
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.budget,
        top1.job_title
    FROM kept_departments s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.job_title
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(job_title) AS job_title_upper,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'DIRECT') AS job_title_filled
    FROM with_latest
    WHERE job_title IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    id,
    budget,
    job_title,
    NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY budget, id) AS budget_bucket,
    LEAD(budget, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY budget, id) AS next_budget,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY budget DESC NULLS LAST) AS budget_percent_rank,
    COUNT(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title) AS job_title_count_budget
FROM valid
WHERE job_title <> 'Manager';

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    FROM prev_events
),

    SELECT

    FROM gaps
)
SELECT
    id,
    amount,
    txn_time,
    island_id
FROM sessions_transactions;

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        INITCAP(TRIM(city)) AS city_title,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS resolved_city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE country IN ('SG', 'JP')
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.country,
        s.city,
        s.rating,
        s.resolved_city,
        top1.category,
        top1.cost
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.category, c.cost
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.stock_qty DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.product_brand
    FROM latest_match s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.brand AS product_brand
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_last_suppliers AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.launch_date
    FROM with_last s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.launch_date
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.stock_qty DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last_suppliers s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.launch_date <= s.launch_date
        )
),
summary AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', launch_date) AS activity_month,
        MAX(cost) FILTER (WHERE product_brand = 'Globex') AS globex_max_cost,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list
    FROM eligible
    GROUP BY activity_month
)
SELECT
    activity_month,
    globex_max_cost,
    country_list
FROM summary;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.stock_qty").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.launch_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country").isin(["SG", "JP"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.initcap(F.trim("city")).alias("city_title"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.country",
        "s.city",
        "s.rating",
        "s.resolved_city",
        F.col("c.category"),
        F.col("c.cost"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.brand").alias("product_brand"))
)

with_last_suppliers = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.launch_date"))
)

eligible = (
    with_last_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.launch_date") <= F.col("s.launch_date")), "left_anti")
)

summary = (

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        ROUND(amount * 1.07, 2) AS adjusted_amount,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'DIRECT') AS merchant_filled
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IN ('Lazada', 'Shell', '7-Eleven')
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) > INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM cleaned
),
sessions_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN adjusted_amount >= 85 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS adjusted_amount_tier,
    CASE WHEN is_new_session >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_new_session_tier,
    AVG(session_id) FILTER (WHERE txn_type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_avg_session_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 END) AS debit_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(adjusted_amount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS adjusted_amount_quartiles
FROM sessions_transactions
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN adjusted_amount >= 85 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN is_new_session >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END)
ORDER BY credit_avg_session_id DESC NULLS FIRST

w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS('-', browser, device) AS browser_device_key
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at > TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-09-20 05:00:00')
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM base
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.page IS NOT NULL
        )
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        browser,
        STDDEV_SAMP(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY browser) AS browser_stddev_samp_session_id,
        MIN(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY browser) AS browser_min_session_id
    FROM not_flagged
)
SELECT id, browser
FROM metrics;

    select

from summary

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_prices) AS val
    FROM price_tiers
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val) AS val_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val DESC NULLS LAST) AS val_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_grp AS val_percent_rank_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_grp AS val_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val DESC) AS val_percent_rank_3
    FROM flattened
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val NULLS FIRST)
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        val_rank,
        val_percent_rank_2,
        val_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(effective_from), currency ORDER BY val_cume_dist DESC NULLS FIRST) AS val_cume_dist_dense_rank
    FROM enriched
    WHERE val_percent_rank_3 <= 0.37
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        val_rank,
        val_percent_rank_2,
        val_cume_dist,
        DATE_FORMAT(effective_from, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS effective_from_label,
        val_cume_dist_dense_rank * val_cume_dist AS val_cume_dist_dense_rank_times_val_cume_dist
    FROM scored
    WHERE effective_from > TO_DATE('2024-03-18')
      AND val_percent_rank_2 > 0.77
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN val_cume_dist >= 0.69 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS val_cume_dist_tier,
    CASE WHEN val_percent_rank_2 >= 0.74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS val_percent_rank_2_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(val_cume_dist_dense_rank_times_val_cume_dist), 2) AS avg_val_cume_dist_dense_rank_times_val_cume_dist,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(val_cume_dist, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS val_cume_dist_quartiles,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN val_cume_dist >= 0.69 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END) AS grouping_level
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN val_cume_dist >= 0.69 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN val_percent_rank_2 >= 0.74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), (CASE WHEN val_cume_dist >= 0.69 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), ())
ORDER BY val_cume_dist_tier DESC;

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT s.*, c.email
    FROM sessions s
    INNER JOIN customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE YEAR(c.signup_date) = 2024
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN device IN ('mobile', 'tablet') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS device_group
    FROM joined
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch
            WHERE ch.session_id = s.id
              AND ch.event_time >= s.started_at
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT src.*, p.signup_date
    FROM kept src
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON src.customer_id <=> p.id
),
enriched_sessions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        country,
        email,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(signup_date), customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY signup_date DESC, id) AS seq_no_2
    FROM enriched
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.duration_sec
    FROM enriched_sessions s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.duration_sec
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_id_avg_duration_sec,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY seq_no_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_seq_no
    FROM with_last
)
SELECT
    id,
    device,
    browser,
    email,
    seq_no,
    seq_no_2,
    duration_sec,
    running_seq_no
FROM with_windows

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        CAST(monthly_fee AS INT) AS monthly_fee_int
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(monthly_fee, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_monthly_fee,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) AS monthly_fee_share,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) AS monthly_fee_share_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS event_seq
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY end_date DESC, id)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        monthly_fee_int,
        last_known_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_share_2,
        event_seq,
        ROUND(monthly_fee_int * 1.15, 2) AS monthly_fee_int_scaled
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE start_date >= TO_DATE('2023-05-07')
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY last_known_monthly_fee DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM filtered
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(status, 1, 4) AS status_prefix
    FROM latest
    WHERE end_date >= DATE '2023-07-10'
      AND status = 'PAUSED'
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS status_list,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(last_known_monthly_fee, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS last_known_monthly_fee_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT status) AS distinct_status
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY status
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

    FROM enriched s

            SELECT c.category AS product_category
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
with_last_suppliers AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.price,
        latest.product_cost
    FROM with_last s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.price, c.cost AS product_cost
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.stock_qty DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
-- Grouped metrics

    product_category,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(product_category)) AS num_product_categories,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(product_category)) AS product_category_list,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows
FROM with_last_suppliers

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        unit_price,
        ROUND(quantity, 1) AS quantity_rounded,
        unit_price - quantity AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IN (22, 24, 33)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        FIRST_VALUE(quantity_rounded) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_quantity_rounded,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_running AS quantity_rounded_bucket
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE quantity_rounded > 49
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_rounded DESC, id)
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(quantity_rounded_bucket, 1) AS quantity_rounded_bucket_rounded
    FROM enriched
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned_order_items AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN first_known_quantity_rounded >= 69 THEN 'High' WHEN first_known_quantity_rounded >= 27 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS first_known_quantity_rounded_level
    FROM valid
    WHERE first_known_quantity_rounded BETWEEN 36 AND 79
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        quantity_rounded_bucket_rounded - quantity_rounded_bucket AS quantity_rounded_bucket_rounded_minus_quantity_rounded_bucket,
        ROUND(quantity_rounded_bucket * 0.9, 2) AS adjusted_quantity_rounded_bucket
    FROM cleaned_order_items
    WHERE quantity_rounded_bucket = 5
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_rounded_bucket NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    quantity_rounded_bucket,
    quantity_rounded_bucket_rounded,
    first_known_quantity_rounded_level,
    NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY first_known_quantity_rounded DESC, id) AS first_known_quantity_rounded_bucket,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY adjusted_quantity_rounded_bucket DESC) AS adjusted_quantity_rounded_bucket_rank,
    LAG(quantity_rounded_bucket, 2) OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_quantity_rounded_bucket, id) AS prev_quantity_rounded_bucket
FROM ranked

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        status_bits * pressure AS status_bits_times_pressure
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 01:00:00'
      AND firmware IN ('2.0.1', '1.0.3')
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM filtered
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT device_code, firmware
    FROM islands
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT device_code, firmware
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE status_bits != 6
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.device_code = k.device_code AND s.firmware = k.firmware
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY session_no) AS session_no_percent_rank,
        COUNT(temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS device_code_count_temp_c,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c NULLS FIRST) AS temp_c_cume_dist
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE device_code != 'DV-02'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        session_no,
        session_no_percent_rank,
        temp_c_cume_dist,
        COUNT(session_no) OVER w_grp AS session_no_count_2h,
        MAX(device_code_count_temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS device_code_max_device_code_count_temp_c,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY session_no) AS session_no_rank
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
kept_keys_2 AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT device_code, id
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT device_code, id
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= '2023-10-01'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys_2 k ON s.device_code = k.device_code AND s.id = k.id
),
