WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        CONCAT_WS('-', channel, promo_code) AS channel_promo_code_key
    FROM promotions
    WHERE ends_on > DATE '2023-11-21'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        discount_pct,
        channel_promo_code_key,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on, id) AS seq_no_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_running AS discount_pct_percent_rank
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct)
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        discount_pct,
        channel_promo_code_key,
        seq_no,
        discount_pct_percent_rank,
        LAG(seq_no, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id) AS prev_seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY seq_no_2 DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no, id) AS seq_no_bucket,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id) AS discount_pct_bucket,
        ROUND(seq_no / SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY channel), 4) AS seq_no_share
    FROM metrics
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        prev_seq_no,
        discount_pct_bucket,
        seq_no_share,
        SUM(prev_seq_no) OVER w_recent AS running_sum_prev_seq_no,
        MAX(prev_seq_no) OVER w_recent AS running_max_prev_seq_no,
        AVG(prev_seq_no) OVER w_recent AS running_avg_prev_seq_no
    FROM scored
    WHERE discount_pct_bucket >= 5
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY discount_pct_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(running_avg_prev_seq_no) OVER (ORDER BY prev_seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_avg_prev_seq_no_avg_3_prior,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_running AS discount_pct_bucket_bucket,
        LAG(prev_seq_no, 1) OVER w_running AS prev_prev_seq_no
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY discount_pct_bucket, id)
),
enriched_promotions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        running_sum_prev_seq_no,
        running_max_prev_seq_no,
        running_avg_prev_seq_no,
        discount_pct_bucket_bucket,
        prev_prev_seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_sum_prev_seq_no) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY running_sum_prev_seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_sum_prev_seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prev_seq_no DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM enriched
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN discount_pct_bucket_bucket >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS discount_pct_bucket_bucket_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(discount_pct_bucket_bucket), 2) AS avg_discount_pct_bucket_bucket,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(first_known_running_sum_prev_seq_no, 0.5) AS first_known_running_sum_prev_seq_no_p50,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(event_seq, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS event_seq_quartiles
FROM enriched_promotions
GROUP BY discount_pct_bucket_bucket_tier
HAVING PERCENTILE_APPROX(first_known_running_sum_prev_seq_no, 0.5) >= 0
ORDER BY avg_discount_pct_bucket_bucket DESC NULLS FIRST

        lag(monthly_fee, 1) over (partition by date_trunc('month', end_date), status order by start_date, id) as prev_monthly_fee

        id,

        last7_max_monthly_fee,

        sum(prev_monthly_fee) over w_running as running_prev_monthly_fee,
        last_value(prev_monthly_fee, true) over (partition by status order by last7_min_monthly_fee, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_prev_monthly_fee,
        sum(last7_max_monthly_fee) over (partition by date_trunc('week', start_date) order by monthly_fee, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_last7_max_monthly_fee
    from with_windows
    window w_running as (order by last7_min_monthly_fee, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)

w_running = Window.orderBy("last7_min_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("last7_min_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "start_date")).orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("running_prev_monthly_fee")
w7 = Window.orderBy("last_known_prev_monthly_fee", "id")
w8 = Window.orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.orderBy("last7_count_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.orderBy("running_prev_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_last7_count_monthly_fee").asc_nulls_first())
w12 = Window.orderBy("running_last7_max_monthly_fee", "id")
w13 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "start_date"))
w14 = Window.orderBy("next_running_prev_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w15 = Window.orderBy(F.col("last3_avg_next_last7_count_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")

with_windows = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.month("end_date").isin([4, 6, 12]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("last7_min_monthly_fee"),
        F.max("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("last7_max_monthly_fee"),
        F.count("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("last7_count_monthly_fee"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 1).over(w2).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "last7_min_monthly_fee",
        "last7_max_monthly_fee",
        "last7_count_monthly_fee",
        F.sum("prev_monthly_fee").over(w_running).alias("running_prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.last("prev_monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("last_known_prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.sum("last7_max_monthly_fee").over(w5).alias("running_last7_max_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

scored_subscriptions = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("running_prev_monthly_fee_rank"),
        F.lead("last7_count_monthly_fee", 1).over(w7).alias("next_last7_count_monthly_fee"),
        F.avg("last7_max_monthly_fee").over(w8).alias("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored_subscriptions
    .withColumn("last3_avg_next_last7_count_monthly_fee", F.avg("next_last7_count_monthly_fee").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("last3_sum_next_last7_count_monthly_fee", F.sum("next_last7_count_monthly_fee").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("last3_min_next_last7_count_monthly_fee", F.min("next_last7_count_monthly_fee").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("cumulative_last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6", F.sum("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6").over(w_hist))
)

base = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("start_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-28")))
    .withColumn("last7_count_monthly_fee_minus_cumulative_last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6", (F.col("last7_count_monthly_fee") - F.col("cumulative_last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6")))
    .withColumn("running_last7_max_monthly_fee_rounded", F.round("running_last7_max_monthly_fee", 0))
)

metrics_subscriptions = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "last7_min_monthly_fee",
        "last7_count_monthly_fee",
        "running_prev_monthly_fee_rank",
        "next_last7_count_monthly_fee",
        "last3_avg_next_last7_count_monthly_fee",
        "last3_min_next_last7_count_monthly_fee",
        "cumulative_last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6",
        "running_last7_max_monthly_fee_rounded",
        F.rank().over(w11).alias("next_last7_count_monthly_fee_rank"),
        F.lead("running_prev_monthly_fee", 2).over(w12).alias("next_running_prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.stddev_samp("running_last7_max_monthly_fee_rounded").over(w13).alias("start_date_period_stddev_samp_running_last7_max_monthly_fee_rounded"),
        F.round((F.col("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6") / F.sum("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6").over(w13)), 4).alias("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("next_last7_count_monthly_fee_rank") <= 5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "last7_count_monthly_fee",
        "running_prev_monthly_fee_rank",
        "next_last7_count_monthly_fee",
        "last3_avg_next_last7_count_monthly_fee",
        "last3_min_next_last7_count_monthly_fee",
        "cumulative_last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6",
        "next_last7_count_monthly_fee_rank",
        "next_running_prev_monthly_fee",
        "last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share",
        F.col("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share").cast("int").alias("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share_int"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("running_max_last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share_int", F.max("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share_int").over(w14))
    .withColumn("running_count_last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share_int", F.count("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share_int").over(w14))
    .withColumn("running_avg_last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share_int", F.avg("last7_max_monthly_fee_avg_6_share_int").over(w14))
    .withColumn("last3_avg_next_last7_count_monthly_fee_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w15))
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(cost, 1) OVER w_running AS prev_cost,
        LAST_VALUE(carrier, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_carrier,
        AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(shipped_date), order_id ORDER BY delivered_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cost_avg_6,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier), 4) AS cost_share,
        FIRST_VALUE(carrier, TRUE) OVER w_part AS first_known_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost ASC, id ASC), w_part AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY delivered_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    carrier,
    shipped_date,
    delivered_date,
    status,
    cost_avg_6,
    first_known_carrier,
    CASE WHEN carrier RLIKE '^(FedEx|UPS)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' WHEN carrier RLIKE '^(DHL|Kerry)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS carrier_zone
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY carrier_zone DESC, carrier DESC

w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from suppliers s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products ch
            where ch.supplier_id = s.id
              and ch.stock_qty <> 231
        )
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        count(rating) over (partition by country, city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_count_rating,
        avg(rating) over (partition by country, city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_avg_rating,
        max(rating) over (partition by country, city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_max_rating,
        sum(rating) over (partition by country, city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_sum_rating,
        dense_rank() over (partition by country order by rating desc) rating_dense_rank
    from kept
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.country,
        s.running_count_rating,
        s.running_avg_rating,
        x.product_brand,
        x.stock_qty
    from scored s
    left join lateral (
            select c.brand as product_brand, c.stock_qty
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
            order by c.price desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        round(running_avg_rating / sum(running_avg_rating) over (partition by country, product_brand), 4) running_avg_rating_share,
        row_number() over (partition by country, product_brand order by stock_qty desc, id) event_seq
    from latest_match
    where stock_qty < 352
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
select
    id,
    country,
    running_count_rating,
    product_brand,
    stock_qty,
    event_seq,
    row_number() over (partition by country order by stock_qty desc, id) event_seq_2,
    lag(running_avg_rating_share, 1) over (partition by product_brand, country order by running_count_rating, id) prev_running_avg_rating_share,
    sum(running_count_rating) over (partition by country order by stock_qty, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cumulative_running_count_rating,
    dense_rank() over (partition by product_brand, country order by running_avg_rating_share nulls last) running_avg_rating_share_dense_rank,
    rank() over (partition by country, product_brand order by running_avg_rating desc nulls last) running_avg_rating_rank
from metrics

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc())

w5 = Window.partitionBy("country", "product_brand").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").desc(), "id")

w8 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("product_brand", "country").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_rating_share").asc_nulls_last())
w10 = Window.partitionBy("country", "product_brand").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_rating").desc_nulls_last())

kept = (
    df_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.stock_qty") != 231), "left_anti")

latest_match = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))

        "s.country",
        "s.running_count_rating",
        "s.running_avg_rating",
        F.col("c.brand").alias("product_brand"),

)

metrics = (

    .filter(F.col("stock_qty") < 352)
    .withColumn("running_avg_rating_share", F.round((F.col("running_avg_rating") / F.sum("running_avg_rating").over(w4)), 4))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w5))

result = (

WITH matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM inventory
    EXCEPT
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity BETWEEN 130 AND 161
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM inventory s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.id = k.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', last_restock) AS year_start,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(quantity, 0.9) AS quantity_p90,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity,
    ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity_2,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(quantity, 0.5) AS quantity_p50
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', last_restock)
ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched_keys = (
    df_inventory
    .select("product_id", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("quantity").between(130, 161))
        .select("product_id", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_inventory
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "last_restock").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("quantity", 0.9).alias("quantity_p90"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity_2"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity", 0.5).alias("quantity_p50"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_quantity").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        k,
        v
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) li AS k, v
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        k,
        v
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k, customer_id ORDER BY created_at, id, k) AS dedup_rank
        FROM lines
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, LENGTH(k) AS k_length
    FROM deduped
    WHERE k = 'utm_source'
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY k_length DESC NULLS LAST, id, k) AS dedup_rank
        FROM base
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    k,
    k_length,
    dedup_rank,
    CASE WHEN k RLIKE '^(utm_source|weight_kg)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' WHEN k RLIKE '^(device|gift)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS k_zone
FROM ranked
ORDER BY k DESC;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k", "customer_id").orderBy("created_at", "id", "k")

base = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("k") == "utm_source")
    .withColumn("k_length", F.length("k"))

    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)

    .select(
        "id",
        "k",
        "k_length",
        "dedup_rank",
        F.when(F.col("k").rlike("^(utm_source|weight_kg)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").when(F.col("k").rlike("^(device|gift)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("k_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("k").desc())
)

WITH with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT s.*, c.signup_date
    FROM sessions s
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE c.is_active
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) AS prev_started_at
    FROM with_dims
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM prev_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        started_at,
        MIN(session_id) OVER w_ordered AS running_min_session_id,
        COUNT(session_id) OVER w_ordered AS running_count_session_id,
        AVG(session_id) OVER w_ordered AS running_avg_session_id,
        SUM(session_id) OVER w_ordered AS running_sum_session_id,
        AVG(session_id) OVER w_recent AS browser_avg_session_id
    FROM islands
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY session_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY browser)
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.event_time >= s.started_at
        )
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        started_at,
        running_min_session_id,
        running_sum_session_id,
        browser_avg_session_id,
        COALESCE(running_min_session_id, 0) AS running_min_session_id_filled,
        running_min_session_id * browser_avg_session_id AS running_min_session_id_times_browser_avg_session_id
    FROM kept
    WHERE started_at > DATE '2023-08-18'
),
metrics_sessions AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(running_sum_session_id) OVER (ORDER BY browser_avg_session_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_running_sum_session_id,
        MIN(running_sum_session_id) OVER (ORDER BY browser_avg_session_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_running_sum_session_id,
        MAX(running_sum_session_id) OVER (ORDER BY browser_avg_session_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_running_sum_session_id,
        AVG(running_min_session_id_filled) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_session_id_times_browser_avg_session_id, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_session_id_filled_avg_2
    FROM filtered
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    measure,
    metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        running_min_session_id_times_browser_avg_session_id,
        running_max_running_sum_session_id,
        running_min_running_sum_session_id
    FROM metrics_sessions
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR measure IN (running_min_session_id_times_browser_avg_session_id, running_max_running_sum_session_id, running_min_running_sum_session_id)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("session_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("browser")
w5 = Window.orderBy("browser_avg_session_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("running_min_session_id_times_browser_avg_session_id", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

with_dims = (
    df_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("c.is_active"))
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.signup_date"))
)

prev_events = with_dims.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w))

flagged = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "started_at",
        F.min("session_id").over(w_ordered).alias("running_min_session_id"),
        F.count("session_id").over(w_ordered).alias("running_count_session_id"),
        F.avg("session_id").over(w_ordered).alias("running_avg_session_id"),
        F.sum("session_id").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_session_id"),
        F.avg("session_id").over(w_recent).alias("browser_avg_session_id"),
    )
)

kept = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("x"), (F.col("x.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.event_time") >= F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")
)

filtered = (
    kept
    .filter(F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-08-18").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "started_at",
        "running_min_session_id",
        "running_sum_session_id",
        "browser_avg_session_id",
        F.coalesce("running_min_session_id", F.lit(0)).alias("running_min_session_id_filled"),
        (F.col("running_min_session_id") * F.col("browser_avg_session_id")).alias("running_min_session_id_times_browser_avg_session_id"),
    )
)

metrics_sessions = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("running_avg_running_sum_session_id", F.avg("running_sum_session_id").over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_min_running_sum_session_id", F.min("running_sum_session_id").over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_max_running_sum_session_id", F.max("running_sum_session_id").over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_min_session_id_filled_avg_2", F.avg("running_min_session_id_filled").over(w6))
)

result = (
    metrics_sessions
    .select(
        "id",
        "running_min_session_id_times_browser_avg_session_id",
        "running_max_running_sum_session_id",
        "running_min_running_sum_session_id",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["running_min_session_id_times_browser_avg_session_id", "running_max_running_sum_session_id", "running_min_running_sum_session_id"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS attr_key, value
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(status_code) OVER w_part AS last3_max_status_code,
        SUM(status_code) OVER w_part AS last3_sum_status_code,
        MIN(status_code) OVER w_part AS last3_min_status_code,
        COUNT(status_code) OVER w_part AS last3_count_status_code,
        CORR(status_code, latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key) AS corr_status_code_latency_ms
    FROM exploded
    WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY host, attr_key ORDER BY latency_ms, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level, attr_key ORDER BY last3_count_status_code DESC) AS rank_in_group
        FROM enriched
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY rank_in_group, id, attr_key) AS row_seq,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host), 4) AS status_code_share,
        LAST_VALUE(attr_key, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY last3_count_status_code, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_attr_key,
        AVG(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY host, attr_key ORDER BY corr_status_code_latency_ms, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS latency_ms_avg_3_prior
    FROM latest
),
enriched_app_logs AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(status_code_share) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS host_count_status_code_share,
        LAG(corr_status_code_latency_ms, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY last3_sum_status_code, id, attr_key) AS prev_corr_status_code_latency_ms
    FROM with_windows
)
SELECT
    id,
    status_code,
    attr_key,
    last3_max_status_code,
    last3_min_status_code,
    last3_count_status_code,
    corr_status_code_latency_ms,
    last_known_attr_key,
    latency_ms_avg_3_prior,
    host_count_status_code_share,
    prev_corr_status_code_latency_ms,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY corr_status_code_latency_ms DESC, id, attr_key) AS row_seq_2,
    COUNT(host_count_status_code_share) OVER (PARTITION BY host, attr_key) AS host_count_host_count_status_code_share,
    ROUND(last3_sum_status_code / SUM(last3_sum_status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host), 4) AS last3_sum_status_code_share
FROM enriched_app_logs
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("host", "attr_key").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level", "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("last3_count_status_code").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id", "attr_key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("host")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("last3_count_status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("host", "attr_key").orderBy("corr_status_code_latency_ms", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("last3_sum_status_code", "id", "attr_key")
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("corr_status_code_latency_ms").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("host", "attr_key")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("last3_max_status_code", F.max("status_code").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("last3_sum_status_code", F.sum("status_code").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("last3_min_status_code", F.min("status_code").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("last3_count_status_code", F.count("status_code").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("corr_status_code_latency_ms", F.corr("status_code", "latency_ms").over(w2))
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("row_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w5)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
        F.last("attr_key", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("last_known_attr_key"),
        F.avg("latency_ms").over(w7).alias("latency_ms_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

enriched_app_logs = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("status_code_share").over(w5).alias("host_count_status_code_share"),
        F.lag("corr_status_code_latency_ms", 2).over(w8).alias("prev_corr_status_code_latency_ms"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "last3_max_status_code",
        "last3_min_status_code",
        "last3_count_status_code",
        "corr_status_code_latency_ms",
        "last_known_attr_key",
        "latency_ms_avg_3_prior",
        "host_count_status_code_share",
        "prev_corr_status_code_latency_ms",
        F.row_number().over(w9).alias("row_seq_2"),
        F.count("host_count_status_code_share").over(w10).alias("host_count_host_count_status_code_share"),
        F.round((F.col("last3_sum_status_code") / F.sum("last3_sum_status_code").over(w5)), 4).alias("last3_sum_status_code_share"),
    )
)

sql:
with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, to_date(event_time) as event_time_date
    from web_events
    where event_time > timestamp '2023-03-19 05:00:00'
      and page is not null
),
with_prev as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(event_time) over (partition by session_id order by event_time, id) as prev_event_time
    from valid
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_event_time is null or event_time > prev_event_time + interval 7 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from with_prev
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by session_id order by event_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from with_gaps
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    date_trunc('month', prev_event_time) as activity_month,
    min(session_no) as min_session_no,
    round(avg(is_new_session), 2) as avg_is_new_session,
    bit_and(duration_sec) as duration_sec_bit_and
from islands
group by date_trunc('month', prev_event_time)
order by activity_month nulls first
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") > F.lit("2023-03-19 05:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.to_date("event_time").alias("event_time_date"))
)

with_prev = valid.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "prev_event_time").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.min("session_no").alias("min_session_no"),
        F.round(F.avg("is_new_session"), 2).alias("avg_is_new_session"),
        F.bit_and("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_bit_and"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_month").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(amount AS INT) AS amount_int
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-06-09'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.unit_price < 350
        )
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CORR(discount, shipping_fee) OVER w_part AS corr_discount_shipping_fee,
        LEAD(amount_int, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, store_id ORDER BY amount, id) AS next_amount_int,
        CORR(shipping_fee, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS corr_shipping_fee_amount,
        STDDEV_SAMP(amount_int) OVER w_part_2 AS customer_id_stddev_samp_amount_int,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date), status ORDER BY discount NULLS LAST) AS discount_dense_rank
    FROM not_flagged
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY store_id, status), w_part_2 AS (PARTITION BY customer_id)
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_dense_rank NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
deduped_orders AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC, id) AS rn
        FROM deduped
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_ids,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS num_channels,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(discount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS discount_quartiles,
        SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN shipping_fee ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_shipping_fee
    FROM deduped_orders
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT
    status,
    distinct_customer_ids,
    num_channels,
    mobile_shipping_fee
FROM summary
ORDER BY mobile_shipping_fee DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "status")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "store_id").orderBy("amount", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w_part_2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "order_date"), "status").orderBy(F.col("discount").asc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_dense_rank").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc(), "id")

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-09").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.col("amount").cast("int").alias("amount_int"))
)

not_flagged = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.unit_price") < 350), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "*",
        F.corr("discount", "shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("corr_discount_shipping_fee"),
        F.lead("amount_int", 1).over(w2).alias("next_amount_int"),
        F.corr("shipping_fee", "amount").over(w3).alias("corr_shipping_fee_amount"),
        F.stddev_samp("amount_int").over(w_part_2).alias("customer_id_stddev_samp_amount_int"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("discount_dense_rank"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

deduped_orders = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

summary = (
    deduped_orders
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", 1)).alias("web_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("customer_id").alias("distinct_customer_ids"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("num_channels"),
        F.percentile_approx("discount", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("discount_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", F.col("shipping_fee")).otherwise(0)).alias("mobile_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select("status", "distinct_customer_ids", "num_channels", "mobile_shipping_fee")
    .orderBy(F.col("mobile_shipping_fee").desc())
)

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN is_remote THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_remote_label,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'NONE') AS job_title_filled
    FROM employees
    WHERE is_remote
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, level ORDER BY salary DESC, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT dept_id, id
    FROM ranked
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT dept_id, id
    FROM employees
    WHERE salary > 58000
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id AND s.id = k.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date), manager_id), 4) AS salary_share
    FROM verified
    WHERE manager_id IN (32, 34)
)
SELECT
    s.full_name,
    s.email,
    s.dept_id,
    s.manager_id,
    s.salary,
    s.hire_date,
    s.is_remote,
    s.job_title_filled,
    s.latest_rank,
    (SELECT MAX(t2.salary) FROM employees t2 WHERE t2.dept_id = s.dept_id) AS max_employee_salary
FROM with_windows s
ORDER BY max_employee_salary DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("manager_id", "level").orderBy(F.col("salary").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("salary").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "hire_date"), "manager_id")
salary_by_dept_id = df_employees.groupBy("dept_id").agg(F.max("salary").alias("max_employee_salary"))

filtered = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("is_remote"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("is_remote"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_remote_label"),
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("NONE")).alias("job_title_filled"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

remaining_keys = (
    ranked
    .select("dept_id", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("salary") > 58000)
        .select("dept_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("k.dept_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("manager_id").isin([32, 34]))
    .withColumn("salary_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("salary_share", F.round((F.col("salary") / F.sum("salary").over(w3)), 4))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .join(salary_by_dept_id, on="dept_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "job_title_filled",
        "latest_rank",
        F.col("max_employee_salary"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("max_employee_salary").desc())
)

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.plan,
        e.start_date,
        e.end_date,
        e.status,
        c.email,
        c.credit_limit,
        c.name
    FROM subscriptions e
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON e.customer_id = c.id
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        status,
        email,
        credit_limit,
        LAST_DAY(end_date) AS end_date_month_end
    FROM joined
    WHERE end_date BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2024-08-01'
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id, status
    FROM base
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT customer_id, status
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE plan = 'standard'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id AND s.status = k.status
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(end_date), status ORDER BY credit_limit NULLS LAST) AS credit_limit_dense_rank,
        ROUND(credit_limit / SUM(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY plan), 4) AS credit_limit_share
    FROM verified
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        d.city,
        d.name
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON s.customer_id = d.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        credit_limit_share,
        city,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY credit_limit_dense_rank) AS credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY credit_limit DESC NULLS FIRST) AS credit_limit_dense_rank_2
    FROM with_dims
),
joined_subscriptions AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.credit_limit_share,
        s.city,
        s.credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        b.signup_date,
        b.name
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON s.customer_id = b.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank >= 0.73 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank_tier,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
    SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank ELSE 0 END) AS bangkok_credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank
FROM joined_subscriptions
GROUP BY 1
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank ELSE 0 END) >= 0
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.month("end_date"), "status").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy("credit_limit_dense_rank")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc_nulls_first())

joined = (
    df_subscriptions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.customer_id",
        "e.plan",
        "e.start_date",
        "e.end_date",
        "e.status",
        F.col("c.email"),
        F.col("c.credit_limit"),
        F.col("c.name"),
    )
)

base = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("end_date").between("2023-06-01", "2024-08-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        "email",
        "credit_limit",
        F.last_day("end_date").alias("end_date_month_end"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    base
    .select("customer_id", "status")
    .subtract(
        df_subscriptions
        .filter(F.col("plan") == "standard")
        .select("customer_id", "status")
    )
)

verified = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("credit_limit_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("credit_limit_share", F.round((F.col("credit_limit") / F.sum("credit_limit").over(w2)), 4))
)

with_dims = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.city"), F.col("d.name"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "credit_limit_share",
        "city",
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("credit_limit_dense_rank_2"),
    )
)

joined_subscriptions = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.credit_limit_share",
        "s.city",
        "s.credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank",
        F.col("b.signup_date"),
        F.col("b.name"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined_subscriptions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank") >= 0.73, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("city")).alias("num_cities"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", F.col("credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank")).otherwise(0)).alias("bangkok_credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("bangkok_credit_limit_dense_rank_percent_rank") >= 0)
)

WITH flattened AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        element
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(coupon_codes) li AS element

with_dims AS (

with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC NULLS FIRST) AS age_dense_rank,
        ROUND(age / SUM(age) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) AS age_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY age ASC) AS age_dense_rank_2,
        ROUND(age / SUM(age) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 4) AS age_share_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY age ASC) AS age_percent_rank
    FROM with_dims
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        age_share,
        age_dense_rank_2,
        age_share_2,
        age_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY age_share_2 DESC NULLS LAST) AS age_share_2_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        age_share,
        age_dense_rank_2,
        age_percent_rank,
        age_share_2_cume_dist,
        ROUND(age_percent_rank / age_dense_rank_2, 2) AS age_percent_rank_per_age_dense_rank_2
    FROM enriched
    WHERE age_dense_rank_2 >= 5
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN age_percent_rank_per_age_dense_rank_2 >= 82 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS age_percent_rank_per_age_dense_rank_2_tier,
    CASE WHEN age_share >= 0.89 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS age_share_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(age_share, 0.5) AS age_share_p50,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(age_share_2_cume_dist, 0.5) AS age_share_2_cume_dist_p50,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt_2,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN age_percent_rank_per_age_dense_rank_2 >= 82 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN age_share >= 0.89 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (CASE WHEN age_percent_rank_per_age_dense_rank_2 >= 82 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END))

WITH matched AS (

        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM orders e
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON e.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND e.order_date >= sub.start_date

),
matched_orders AS (

        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM matched e
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON e.channel = pr.channel
       AND e.order_date BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT store_id, customer_id
    FROM matched_orders
    EXCEPT
    SELECT store_id, customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM matched_orders s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id AND s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(shipping_fee) OVER w_grp AS order_date_month_avg_shipping_fee,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, plan ORDER BY subscription_id DESC NULLS FIRST) AS subscription_id_rank
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE status IN ('RETURNED', 'CANCELLED')
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(order_date), promo_code)
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.order_date,
    s.status,
    s.shipping_fee,
    s.subscription_id,
    s.monthly_fee,
    s.order_date_month_avg_shipping_fee,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(PENDING|COMPLETED)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN status RLIKE '^(CANCELLED|SHIPPED)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS status_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(x.amount) FROM orders x WHERE x.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS max_order_amount
FROM scored s;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date"), "promo_code")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "plan").orderBy(F.col("subscription_id").desc_nulls_first())
amount_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.max("amount").alias("max_order_amount"))

matched = (
    df_orders
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("e.order_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("e.order_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

matched_orders = (
    matched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("e.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & F.col("e.order_date").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    matched_orders
    .select("store_id", "customer_id")
    .subtract(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("status").isin(["CANCELLED", "PENDING"]))
        .select("store_id", "customer_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    matched_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")) & (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["RETURNED", "CANCELLED"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("shipping_fee").over(w_grp).alias("order_date_month_avg_shipping_fee"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("subscription_id_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .join(amount_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "shipping_fee",
        "subscription_id",
        "monthly_fee",
        "order_date_month_avg_shipping_fee",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(PENDING|COMPLETED)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("status").rlike("^(CANCELLED|SHIPPED)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("status_zone"),
        F.col("max_order_amount"),
    )
)

with filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        floor(unit_price) unit_price_whole
    from order_items
    where unit_price is not null
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        min(quantity) over w_part running_min_quantity,
        max(quantity) over w_part running_max_quantity,
        avg(quantity) over w_part running_avg_quantity,
        sum(quantity) over w_part running_sum_quantity
    from filtered
    where order_id in (4, 12, 32)
    window w_part as (partition by order_id order by unit_price_whole, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        last_value(running_avg_quantity) ignore nulls over (order by running_avg_quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) last_known_running_avg_quantity,
        dense_rank() over (partition by order_id order by unit_price_whole desc nulls first) unit_price_whole_dense_rank
    from enriched
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.product_id,
        src.quantity,
        src.running_max_quantity,
        src.running_avg_quantity,
        src.running_sum_quantity,
        src.unit_price_whole_dense_rank,
        b.status,
        b.amount,
        b.order_date
    from with_windows src
    left join orders b
        on src.order_id = b.id
),
joined_order_items as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.quantity,
        src.running_max_quantity,
        src.running_sum_quantity,
        src.amount,
        o.amount as order_amount,
        o.shipping_fee
    from joined src
    inner join orders o
        on src.order_id = o.id
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        quantity,
        running_max_quantity,
        running_sum_quantity,
        amount,
        order_amount,
        count(running_max_quantity) over w_running order_id_count_running_max_quantity,
        ntile(5) over (partition by order_id order by running_sum_quantity, id) running_sum_quantity_bucket,
        sum(quantity) over w_recent running_quantity
    from joined_order_items
    window w_running as (partition by order_id), w_recent as (partition by order_id order by amount, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        quantity,
        running_sum_quantity,
        amount,
        order_amount,
        running_sum_quantity_bucket,
        running_quantity,
        round(quantity, 1) quantity_rounded,
        running_sum_quantity - running_sum_quantity_bucket running_sum_quantity_minus_running_sum_quantity_bucket
    from metrics
    where running_max_quantity between 3.4 and 4.6
),
report as (
    select
        id,
        quantity,
        running_sum_quantity,
        order_amount,
        running_sum_quantity_bucket,
        quantity_rounded,
        running_sum_quantity_minus_running_sum_quantity_bucket
    from base
    order by quantity_rounded nulls last, id
)
select
    id,
    running_sum_quantity,
    order_amount,
    running_sum_quantity_bucket,
    quantity_rounded,
    running_sum_quantity_minus_running_sum_quantity_bucket
from report;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("running_avg_quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price_whole").desc_nulls_first())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("running_sum_quantity", "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("unit_price").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        F.floor("unit_price").alias("unit_price_whole"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([4, 12, 32]))
    .withColumn("running_min_quantity", F.min("quantity").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_max_quantity", F.max("quantity").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_avg_quantity", F.avg("quantity").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_sum_quantity", F.sum("quantity").over(w_part))
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("running_avg_quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_running_avg_quantity"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("unit_price_whole_dense_rank"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_windows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.product_id",
        "src.quantity",
        "src.running_max_quantity",
        "src.running_avg_quantity",
        "src.running_sum_quantity",
        "src.unit_price_whole_dense_rank",
        F.col("b.status"),
        F.col("b.amount"),
        F.col("b.order_date"),
    )
)

joined_order_items = (
    joined
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.quantity",
        "src.running_max_quantity",
        "src.running_sum_quantity",
        "src.amount",
        F.col("o.amount").alias("order_amount"),
        F.col("o.shipping_fee"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    joined_order_items
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "running_max_quantity",
        "running_sum_quantity",
        "amount",
        "order_amount",
        F.count("running_max_quantity").over(w_running).alias("order_id_count_running_max_quantity"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w5).alias("running_sum_quantity_bucket"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("running_quantity"),
    )
)

base = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("running_max_quantity").between(3.4, 4.6))
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "running_sum_quantity",
        "amount",
        "order_amount",
        "running_sum_quantity_bucket",
        "running_quantity",
        F.round("quantity", 1).alias("quantity_rounded"),
        (F.col("running_sum_quantity") - F.col("running_sum_quantity_bucket")).alias("running_sum_quantity_minus_running_sum_quantity_bucket"),
    )
)

report = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "running_sum_quantity",
        "order_amount",
        "running_sum_quantity_bucket",
        "quantity_rounded",
        "running_sum_quantity_minus_running_sum_quantity_bucket",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_rounded").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
)

result = (
    report
    .select(
        "id",
        "running_sum_quantity",
        "order_amount",
        "running_sum_quantity_bucket",
        "quantity_rounded",
        "running_sum_quantity_minus_running_sum_quantity_bucket",
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        level,
        CONCAT(job_title, ' ', level) AS job_title_level,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_job_title
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-04-29'
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        job_title_level,
        resolved_job_title,
        CAST(is_remote AS INT) AS is_remote_flag,
        UPPER(full_name) AS full_name_upper,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'N/A') AS resolved_job_title_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-03-23'
      AND job_title IS NOT NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.manager_id,
        e.job_title,
        e.hire_date,
        e.resolved_job_title,
        e.is_remote_flag,
        d.email AS employee_email
    FROM valid e
    LEFT JOIN employees d
        ON e.manager_id = d.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        manager_id,
        hire_date,
        resolved_job_title,
        is_remote_flag,
        employee_email,
        MIN(is_remote_flag) OVER w_grp AS running_min_is_remote_flag,
        SUM(is_remote_flag) OVER w_grp AS running_sum_is_remote_flag,
        COUNT(is_remote_flag) OVER w_grp AS running_count_is_remote_flag,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_running AS is_remote_flag_dense_rank
    FROM with_dims
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY is_remote_flag ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_running AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(hire_date), manager_id ORDER BY is_remote_flag DESC)
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', hire_date) AS quarter_start,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', hire_date) AS week_start,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date) AS year_start,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_count_is_remote_flag, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_count_is_remote_flag_quartiles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        ROUND(AVG(running_count_is_remote_flag), 2) AS avg_running_count_is_remote_flag
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', hire_date), DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', hire_date), DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date))
    HAVING distinct_ids > 1
)
SELECT
    week_start,
    year_start,
    distinct_ids,
    avg_running_count_is_remote_flag
FROM stats
ORDER BY distinct_ids ASC NULLS FIRST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("is_remote_flag", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy(F.year("hire_date"), "manager_id").orderBy(F.col("is_remote_flag").desc())

filtered = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("hire_date") >= F.lit("2023-04-29").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "level",
        F.concat("job_title", F.lit(" "), "level").alias("job_title_level"),
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_job_title"),
    )
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") >= F.lit("2023-03-23").cast("date")) & F.col("job_title").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "job_title_level",
        "resolved_job_title",
        F.col("is_remote").cast("int").alias("is_remote_flag"),
        F.upper("full_name").alias("full_name_upper"),
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_job_title_2"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    valid
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_employees.alias("d"), F.col("e.manager_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.manager_id",
        "e.job_title",
        "e.hire_date",
        "e.resolved_job_title",
        "e.is_remote_flag",
        F.col("d.email").alias("employee_email"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "manager_id",
        "hire_date",
        "resolved_job_title",
        "is_remote_flag",
        "employee_email",
        F.min("is_remote_flag").over(w_grp).alias("running_min_is_remote_flag"),
        F.sum("is_remote_flag").over(w_grp).alias("running_sum_is_remote_flag"),
        F.count("is_remote_flag").over(w_grp).alias("running_count_is_remote_flag"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_running).alias("is_remote_flag_dense_rank"),
    )
)

stats = (
    metrics
    .rollup(
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "hire_date").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "hire_date").alias("week_start"),
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "hire_date").alias("year_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_count_is_remote_flag", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_count_is_remote_flag_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_count_is_remote_flag"), 2).alias("avg_running_count_is_remote_flag"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") > 1)
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "week_start",
        "year_start",
        "distinct_ids",
        "avg_running_count_is_remote_flag",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        ROUND(amount * 1.15, 2) AS amount_adjusted,
        CASE WHEN method = 'cash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cash
    FROM payments
    WHERE method IS NOT NULL
      AND method IS DISTINCT FROM 'paypal'
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM valid
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(is_cash) OVER w_part AS is_cash_max_30d,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(paid_at) ORDER BY is_cash, id) AS event_seq,
        STDDEV_SAMP(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_stddev_samp_amount
    FROM islands
    WHERE amount_adjusted BETWEEN 58 AND 76
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(paid_at), method ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at
    FROM enriched
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM prev_events
),
sessions_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        is_cash,
        session_no,
        is_cash_max_30d,
        event_seq,
        status_stddev_samp_amount,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    id,
    paid_at,
    session_no,
    status_stddev_samp_amount,
    island_id
FROM sessions_payments;

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(sqft, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_sqft,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_sqft
    FROM stores
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM with_windows
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft DESC, id) = 1
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        last_known_sqft,
        cumulative_sqft,
        COALESCE(sqft, 0) sqft_filled,
        LAST_DAY(opened_date) opened_date_month_end,
        COALESCE(region, 'OTHER') region_filled
    FROM deduped
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2023-08-17'
      AND region IS DISTINCT FROM 'West'
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        last_known_sqft,
        cumulative_sqft,
        region_filled,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY cumulative_sqft DESC, id) cumulative_sqft_bucket,
        SUM(last_known_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date_month_end, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_last_known_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', opened_date_month_end), city ORDER BY sqft_filled DESC, id) row_seq
    FROM filtered
)

    id,
    store_name,
    last_known_sqft,

    CASE WHEN store_name RLIKE '^(Airport Kiosk|Mall Central)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' WHEN store_name RLIKE '^(Siam Flagship|Downtown Express)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'CORE' END AS store_name_zone

WITH not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM stores s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales x
            WHERE x.store_id = s.id
              AND x.units > 20
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching order per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.channel,
        x.status
    FROM not_flagged s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.channel, c.status
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.discount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        region,
        sqft,
        channel,
        LAST_VALUE(region, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_region,
        LAST_VALUE(channel, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_channel,
        LAG(sqft, 1, 0) OVER w_running AS prev_sqft,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, region ORDER BY sqft ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sqft
    FROM latest_match
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY opened_date ASC, id ASC)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY sqft ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY prev_sqft ASC, id ASC) AS next_sqft,
        LAG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY prev_sqft ASC, id ASC) AS prev_sqft_2,
        LEAD(prev_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY prev_sqft ASC, id ASC) AS next_prev_sqft,
        LAG(prev_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY prev_sqft ASC, id ASC) AS prev_prev_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY prev_sqft ASC, id ASC) AS seq_no
    FROM ranked
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN prev_sqft >= 16675 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_sqft_tier,
    CASE WHEN next_prev_sqft >= 12307 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS next_prev_sqft_tier,
    SUM(prev_sqft_2) AS total_prev_sqft_2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'partner' THEN seq_no ELSE 0 END) AS partner_seq_no
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN prev_sqft >= 16675 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN next_prev_sqft >= 12307 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END;

w3 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("opened_date", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "region").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("sqft").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("prev_sqft", "id")

not_flagged = (
    df_stores
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.units") > 20), "left_anti")

latest_match = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.channel"), F.col("c.status"))
)

with_windows = (
    latest_match
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "region",
        "sqft",
        "channel",
        F.last("region", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_region"),
        F.last("channel", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_channel"),
        F.lag("sqft", 1, 0).over(w_running).alias("prev_sqft"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w5).alias("running_sqft"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

enriched = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("next_sqft", F.lead("sqft").over(w7))
    .withColumn("prev_sqft_2", F.lag("sqft").over(w7))
    .withColumn("next_prev_sqft", F.lead("prev_sqft").over(w7))
    .withColumn("prev_prev_sqft", F.lag("prev_sqft").over(w7))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w7))
)

result = (

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_sqft") >= 16675, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("prev_sqft_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("next_prev_sqft") >= 12307, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("next_prev_sqft_tier"),

        STDDEV_SAMP(val) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_stddev_samp_val,
        COUNT(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_count_val
    FROM lines
),

    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(currency) AS currency_upper,

    FROM scored
    WHERE plan_stddev_samp_val BETWEEN 72 AND 73
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(plan_stddev_samp_val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_count_plan_stddev_samp_val,
        ROUND(currency_count_val / SUM(currency_count_val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency), 4) AS currency_count_val_share
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT
    currency,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(currency)) AS currency_list,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR') AS eur_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(currency_count_plan_stddev_samp_val, 0.5) AS currency_count_plan_stddev_samp_val_p50
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY 1;
