WITH with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM sessions
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        session_id,
        MAX(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_session_id,
        COUNT(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_session_id,
        SUM(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_session_id,
        MIN(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_session_id,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY session_id, id) AS session_id_bucket
    FROM sessions_sessions
    WHERE HOUR(started_at) BETWEEN 10 AND 14
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.browser,
        s.session_id_bucket,
        x.web_event_event_type
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_type AS web_event_event_type
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch
            WHERE ch.session_id = s.id
              AND ch.event_type IN ('search', 'add_to_cart', 'click')
        )
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        web_event_event_type,
        AVG(session_id_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY web_event_event_type ORDER BY session_id_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS session_id_bucket_avg_6_prior,
        SUM(session_id_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY web_event_event_type ORDER BY session_id_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_session_id_bucket
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT
    id,
    browser,
    web_event_event_type,
    session_id_bucket_avg_6_prior,
    running_session_id_bucket,
    CASE WHEN browser RLIKE '^(Safari|Edge)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN browser RLIKE '^(Chrome|Firefox)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS browser_zone
FROM scored;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("session_id", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.event_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("web_event_event_type").orderBy("session_id_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("web_event_event_type").orderBy("session_id_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_gaps = (
    df_sessions
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    sessions_sessions
    .filter(F.hour("started_at").between(10, 14))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "browser",
        "session_id",
        F.max("session_id").over(w3).alias("running_max_session_id"),
        F.count("session_id").over(w3).alias("running_count_session_id"),
        F.sum("session_id").over(w3).alias("running_sum_session_id"),
        F.min("session_id").over(w3).alias("running_min_session_id"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w4).alias("session_id_bucket"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.browser",
        "s.session_id_bucket",
        F.col("c.event_type").alias("web_event_event_type"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.event_type").isin(["search", "add_to_cart", "click"])), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "browser",
        "web_event_event_type",
        F.avg("session_id_bucket").over(w6).alias("session_id_bucket_avg_6_prior"),
        F.sum("session_id_bucket").over(w7).alias("running_session_id_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "browser",
        "web_event_event_type",
        "session_id_bucket_avg_6_prior",
        "running_session_id_bucket",
        F.when(F.col("browser").rlike("^(Safari|Edge)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("browser").rlike("^(Chrome|Firefox)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("browser_zone"),
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        level,
        CASE WHEN level IN ('L5', 'L2') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END level_group,
        COALESCE(level, 'NONE') resolved_level
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-06-20'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        hire_date,
        level,
        level_group,
        resolved_level,
        LAG(salary, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary, id) prev_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary, id) row_seq
    FROM filtered
    WHERE level = 'L1'
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN level IN ('L4', 'L3') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END level_group_2,
        row_seq + prev_salary row_seq_plus_prev_salary
    FROM enriched
    WHERE level IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'L2'
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        hire_date,
        level,
        level_group,
        resolved_level,
        row_seq,
        level_group_2
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY row_seq_plus_prev_salary DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM base
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last3_min_row_seq,
        AVG(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last3_avg_row_seq,
        SUM(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last3_sum_row_seq,
        COUNT(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last3_count_row_seq
    FROM latest
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT level, id
    FROM scored
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT level, id
    FROM employees
    WHERE email IS NULL
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.level = k.level AND s.id = k.id
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        dept_id,
        level,
        row_seq
    FROM verified
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(row_seq) AS total,
    COUNT(1) AS cnt
    FOR level IN ('L2', 'L4')
)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("salary", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("row_seq_plus_prev_salary").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("hire_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        F.when(F.col("level").isin(["L5", "L2"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("level_group"),
        F.coalesce("level", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_level"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("level") == "L1")
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        "level_group",
        "resolved_level",
        F.lag("salary", 2).over(w).alias("prev_salary"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("level").eqNullSafe(F.lit("L2")))
    .withColumn("level_group_2", F.when(F.col("level").isin(["L4", "L3"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other"))
    .withColumn("row_seq_plus_prev_salary", (F.col("row_seq") + F.col("prev_salary")))
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "dept_id",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        "level_group",
        "resolved_level",
        "row_seq",
        "level_group_2",
    )
)

scored = (
    latest
    .withColumn("last3_min_row_seq", F.min("row_seq").over(w4))
    .withColumn("last3_avg_row_seq", F.avg("row_seq").over(w4))
    .withColumn("last3_sum_row_seq", F.sum("row_seq").over(w4))
    .withColumn("last3_count_row_seq", F.count("row_seq").over(w4))
)

kept_keys = (
    scored
    .select("level", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("email").isNull())
        .select("level", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy("dept_id")
    .pivot("level", ["L2", "L4"])
    .agg(F.max("row_seq").alias("total"), F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("cnt"))
)

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS key, attr_value
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key
    FROM lines
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY status_code DESC, id, key) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY key), 4) latency_ms_share,
        AVG(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY status_code, id, key ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) status_code_avg_5,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY latency_ms, id, key) latency_ms_bucket
    FROM latest
    WHERE key = 'version'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        latency_ms_share,
        latency_ms_bucket,
        AVG(latency_ms_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY status_code_avg_5, id, key ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) latency_ms_bucket_avg_3,
        MIN(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY key) key_min_status_code,
        MAX(latency_ms_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY key) key_max_latency_ms_bucket
    FROM metrics
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        latency_ms_bucket_avg_3,
        key_min_status_code,
        latency_ms_bucket * key_max_latency_ms_bucket latency_ms_bucket_times_key_max_latency_ms_bucket
    FROM enriched
    WHERE key_max_latency_ms_bucket = 4
),
latest_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY latency_ms_bucket_avg_3 DESC) = 1
),
latest_app_logs_2 AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        latency_ms_bucket_avg_3,
        key_min_status_code,
        latency_ms_bucket_times_key_max_latency_ms_bucket
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY key_min_status_code DESC NULLS LAST, id, key) AS rank_in_group
        FROM latest_app_logs
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN key_min_status_code >= 440 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS key_min_status_code_tier,
        COUNT_IF(key = 'trace') AS trace_events,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(latency_ms_bucket_avg_3, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS latency_ms_bucket_avg_3_quartiles,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(key)) AS key_list,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(key_min_status_code, 0.5) AS key_min_status_code_p50
    FROM latest_app_logs_2
    GROUP BY key_min_status_code_tier
)
SELECT key_min_status_code_tier, trace_events
FROM summary
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc(), "id", "key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("status_code", "id", "key").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("status_code_avg_5", "id", "key").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_bucket_avg_3").desc())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("key_min_status_code").desc_nulls_last(), "id", "key")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

latest = (
    lines
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "latency_ms", "status_code", "key")
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("key") == "version")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w2)), 4).alias("latency_ms_share"),
        F.avg("status_code").over(w3).alias("status_code_avg_5"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w4).alias("latency_ms_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "key",
        "latency_ms_share",
        "latency_ms_bucket",
        F.avg("latency_ms_bucket").over(w5).alias("latency_ms_bucket_avg_3"),
        F.min("status_code").over(w2).alias("key_min_status_code"),
        F.max("latency_ms_bucket").over(w2).alias("key_max_latency_ms_bucket"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("key_max_latency_ms_bucket") == 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "key",
        "latency_ms_bucket_avg_3",
        "key_min_status_code",
        (F.col("latency_ms_bucket") * F.col("key_max_latency_ms_bucket")).alias("latency_ms_bucket_times_key_max_latency_ms_bucket"),
    )
)

latest_app_logs = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

latest_app_logs_2 = (
    latest_app_logs
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "key",
        "latency_ms_bucket_avg_3",
        "key_min_status_code",
        "latency_ms_bucket_times_key_max_latency_ms_bucket",
    )
)

summary = (
    latest_app_logs_2
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("key_min_status_code") >= 440, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("key_min_status_code_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("key") == "trace").alias("trace_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("latency_ms_bucket_avg_3", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("latency_ms_bucket_avg_3_quartiles"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("key")).alias("key_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("key_min_status_code", 0.5).alias("key_min_status_code_p50"),
    )
)

result = summary.select("key_min_status_code_tier", "trace_events")

sql:
WITH flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM web_events
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time) AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time) AS year_start,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/product' THEN 1 END) AS product_count,
    BIT_AND(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_bit_and,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS num_event_types
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time), DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time))
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

flagged = (
    df_web_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessionized
    .cube(
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "event_time").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "event_time").alias("year_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", 1)).alias("product_count"),
        F.bit_and("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_bit_and"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("event_type")).alias("num_event_types"),
    )
)

WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        ABS(balance) AS abs_balance
    FROM accounts
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND opened_date > DATE '2023-05-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(balance) OVER w_part AS status_stddev_samp_balance,
        MAX(balance) OVER w_part AS status_max_balance,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY abs_balance DESC NULLS LAST) AS abs_balance_cume_dist,
        FIRST_VALUE(status) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, account_type ORDER BY opened_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_status
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY status)
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status, customer_id
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT status, customer_id
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'FROZEN', 'CLOSED')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time <= s.opened_date
        )
),
kept_accounts AS (

            SELECT 1

            WHERE x.account_id = s.id
              AND x.txn_time < s.opened_date
        )
),
not_flagged AS (

FROM not_flagged

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        UPPER(TRIM(store_name)) AS store_name_normalized,
        COALESCE(region, 'OTHER') AS region_filled
    FROM stores
    WHERE city IN ('Bangkok', 'Tokyo')
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
              AND c.order_date < s.opened_date
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(region) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_region,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sqft
    FROM eligible
    WHERE region != 'Central'
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(sqft) OVER w_running AS next_sqft,
        LAG(sqft) OVER w_running AS prev_sqft,
        LAG(cumulative_sqft) OVER w_running AS prev_cumulative_sqft,
        LEAD(cumulative_sqft) OVER w_running AS next_cumulative_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS seq_no,
        MIN(cumulative_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(opened_date)) AS opened_date_year_min_cumulative_sqft
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY cumulative_sqft, id)
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    region,
    CASE WHEN prev_cumulative_sqft >= 60727 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS prev_cumulative_sqft_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date) AS week_start,
    BIT_OR(sqft) AS sqft_bit_or,
    COUNT_IF(city = 'Bangkok') AS bangkok_events,
    AVG(next_sqft) AS avg_next_sqft,
    ROUND(AVG(seq_no), 2) AS avg_seq_no,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities
FROM scored
GROUP BY region, CASE WHEN prev_cumulative_sqft >= 60727 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date)
ORDER BY prev_cumulative_sqft_tier DESC NULLS FIRST;

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        LENGTH(city) AS city_length,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS city_filled,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS city_clean
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE rating <= 2.5
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.category NOT IN ('Home', 'Fashion', 'Sports')
        )
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.product_price
    FROM eligible s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.price AS product_price
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY product_price NULLS FIRST) AS product_price_cume_dist,
        AVG(city_length) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS city_length_avg_6_prior
    FROM with_last
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY city_length DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
        FROM with_windows
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        city_length,
        city_clean,
        product_price,
        product_price_cume_dist,
        city_length_avg_6_prior,
        row_num,
        AVG(product_price_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY product_price_cume_dist, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS product_price_cume_dist_avg_2_prior,
        ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 4) AS rating_share
    FROM ranked
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        city_length,
        city_clean,
        product_price,
        product_price_cume_dist,
        city_length_avg_6_prior,
        row_num,
        product_price_cume_dist_avg_2_prior,
        rating_share,
        COALESCE(product_price_cume_dist, 0) AS product_price_cume_dist_filled
    FROM enriched
    WHERE city_length BETWEEN 35 AND 52
)
SELECT
    id,
    city,
    city_clean,
    product_price,
    product_price_cume_dist,
    city_length_avg_6_prior,
    product_price_cume_dist_avg_2_prior,
    rating_share,
    product_price_cume_dist_filled,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Singapore|Tokyo)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS city_zone
FROM valid

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        o.shipping_fee,
        o.order_date,
        o.status
    FROM order_items src
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON src.order_id = o.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.product_id,
        src.order_date,
        src.status,
        p.price
    FROM joined src
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON src.product_id = p.id
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT order_id
    FROM with_dims
    INTERSECT
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id IN (15, 37)
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id
),
joined_order_items AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT e.*, b.status AS order_status
    FROM reconciled e
    INNER JOIN orders b
        ON e.order_id = b.id
),
joined_order_items_2 AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.stock_qty,
        b.category,
        b.cost
    FROM joined_order_items src
    LEFT JOIN products b
        ON src.product_id = b.id
),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        category,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS week_start,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS price_quartiles,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completed_count,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        GROUPING(category) AS grouping_level
    FROM joined_order_items_2
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((category, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date)), (category), ())
    HAVING event_count < 1000
)
SELECT
    category,
    week_start,
    price_quartiles,
    completed_count,
    event_count,
    grouping_level,
    CASE WHEN category RLIKE '^(Sports|Electronics)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN category RLIKE '^(Home|Books)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS category_zone
FROM totals

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CONCAT(method, '/', status) AS method_status
    FROM payments
    WHERE method IS NOT NULL
      AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-16 18:00:00'
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM base
),
sessions_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN amount >= 1490 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS amount_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at) AS activity_month,
    ROUND(AVG(session_id), 2) AS avg_session_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN method = 'promptpay' THEN is_new_session ELSE 0 END) AS promptpay_is_new_session,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN method = 'paypal' THEN 1 END) AS paypal_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE method = 'bank_transfer') AS bank_transfer_rows,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN amount >= 1490 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN method = 'promptpay' THEN is_new_session ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS promptpay_is_new_session_rank
FROM sessions_payments
GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 1490 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at)
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE method = 'bank_transfer') >= 1
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("amount_tier").orderBy(F.col("promptpay_is_new_session").desc())

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("method").isNotNull() & (F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-05-16 18:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .select("*", F.concat("method", F.lit("/"), "status").alias("method_status"))
)

flagged = (
    base
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_payments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1490, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("amount_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "paid_at").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("session_id"), 2).alias("avg_session_id"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("method") == "promptpay", F.col("is_new_session")).otherwise(0)).alias("promptpay_is_new_session"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "paypal", 1)).alias("paypal_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "bank_transfer", 1)).alias("bank_transfer_rows"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("bank_transfer_rows") >= 1)
    .withColumn("promptpay_is_new_session_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS k, value
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN host IN ('h1', 'h3') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS host_group,
        COALESCE(k, 'NONE') AS k_clean
    FROM flattened
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(host) AS host_lower,
        COALESCE(k, 'NONE') AS k_filled
    FROM filtered
    WHERE log_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-06-01 13:00:00')
),
with_windows AS (

    SELECT *, COUNT(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_count_30m

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_hist AS duration_sec_bucket,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, event_type ORDER BY duration_sec DESC NULLS LAST) AS duration_sec_percent_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(duration_sec) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_duration_sec
    FROM web_events
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', event_time), event_type ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.country,
        b.device,
        b.browser
    FROM with_windows src
    LEFT JOIN sessions b
        ON src.session_id = b.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.device AS session_device,
        d.browser AS session_browser
    FROM with_dims src
    JOIN sessions d
        ON src.session_id = d.id
    WHERE d.country = 'UK'
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT event_type, page
    FROM joined
    INTERSECT
    SELECT event_type, page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE session_id = 19
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.event_type = k.event_type AND s.page = k.page
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.session_id,
    s.event_type,
    s.page,
    s.event_time,
    s.duration_sec,
    s.duration_sec_bucket,
    s.device,
    s.browser,
    CASE WHEN browser RLIKE '^(Firefox|Chrome)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS browser_zone,
    (SELECT AVG(w2.duration_sec) FROM web_events w2 WHERE w2.session_id = s.session_id) AS avg_web_event_duration_sec
FROM verified s;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "event_time"), "event_type").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
duration_sec_by_session_id = df_web_events.groupBy("session_id").agg(F.avg("duration_sec").alias("avg_web_event_duration_sec"))

with_windows = (
    df_web_events
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(w_hist).alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("duration_sec_percent_rank"),
        F.first("duration_sec", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("first_known_duration_sec"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    with_windows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("b"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.country"), F.col("b.device"), F.col("b.browser"))
)

joined = (
    with_dims
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("d.country") == "UK")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("d.device").alias("session_device"),
        F.col("d.browser").alias("session_browser"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    joined
    .select("event_type", "page")
    .intersect(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("session_id") == 19)
        .select("event_type", "page")
    )
)

verified = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.event_type") == F.col("k.event_type")) & (F.col("s.page") == F.col("k.page")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .join(duration_sec_by_session_id, on="session_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        "duration_sec_bucket",
        "device",
        "browser",
        F.when(F.col("browser").rlike("^(Firefox|Chrome)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("browser_zone"),
        F.col("avg_web_event_duration_sec"),
    )
)

WITH latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) AS rank_in_group
    FROM stores
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        region,
        sqft,
        LAG(sqft) OVER w_part AS prev_sqft,
        LEAD(sqft) OVER w_part AS next_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(sqft) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(opened_date), region ORDER BY rank_in_group ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_sqft
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date ASC, id ASC)
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.region,
        s.next_sqft,
        s.first_known_sqft,
        top1.inventory_last_restock
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.last_restock AS inventory_last_restock
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.last_restock DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
latest_stores AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM with_last
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY first_known_sqft DESC, id ASC) = 1
),
totals AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN next_sqft >= 14448 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS next_sqft_tier,
        MAX(next_sqft) FILTER (WHERE region = 'North') AS north_max_next_sqft,
        ROUND(AVG(next_sqft), 2) AS avg_next_sqft,
        ROUND(AVG(first_known_sqft), 2) AS avg_first_known_sqft,
        ROUND(AVG(first_known_sqft), 2) AS avg_first_known_sqft_2
    FROM latest_stores
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN next_sqft >= 14448 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
)
SELECT
    next_sqft_tier,
    north_max_next_sqft,
    avg_first_known_sqft,
    avg_first_known_sqft_2
FROM totals
ORDER BY avg_first_known_sqft ASC NULLS FIRST, next_sqft_tier DESC
LIMIT 20;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("opened_date"), "region").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.last_restock").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("first_known_sqft").desc(), "id")

latest = (
    df_stores
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "sqft",
        F.lag("sqft").over(w_part).alias("prev_sqft"),
        F.lead("sqft").over(w_part).alias("next_sqft"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("seq_no"),
        F.first("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("first_known_sqft"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.region",
        "s.next_sqft",
        "s.first_known_sqft",
        F.col("c.last_restock").alias("inventory_last_restock"),
    )
)

latest_stores = (
    with_last
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

totals = (
    latest_stores
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("next_sqft") >= 14448, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("next_sqft_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max(F.when(F.col("region") == "North", F.col("next_sqft"))).alias("north_max_next_sqft"),
        F.round(F.avg("next_sqft"), 2).alias("avg_next_sqft"),
        F.round(F.avg("first_known_sqft"), 2).alias("avg_first_known_sqft"),
        F.round(F.avg("first_known_sqft"), 2).alias("avg_first_known_sqft_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "next_sqft_tier",
        "north_max_next_sqft",
        "avg_first_known_sqft",
        "avg_first_known_sqft_2",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("avg_first_known_sqft").asc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("next_sqft_tier").desc(),
    )
    .limit(20)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("quantity", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy("running_max_quantity", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_count_quantity").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("product_id")

latest = (
    df_order_items
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("running_count_quantity"),
        F.avg("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_quantity"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("running_sum_quantity"),
        F.max("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_quantity"),
        F.lead("unit_price", 1).over(w3).alias("next_unit_price"),
    )
)

latest_order_items = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        "dedup_rank",
        "running_count_quantity",
        "running_avg_quantity",
        "running_max_quantity",
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    latest_order_items
    .select("id", "product_id")
    .intersect(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("quantity") < 3)
        .select("id", "product_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest_order_items
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    verified
    .withColumn("order_id_min_running_count_quantity", F.min("running_count_quantity").over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_count_quantity_rank", F.rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("product_id_max_running_count_quantity", F.max("running_count_quantity").over(w7))
    .withColumn("running_count_quantity_share", F.round((F.col("running_count_quantity") / F.sum("running_count_quantity").over(w7)), 4))
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("running_max_quantity").between(4.0, 7.7))

)

result = (

        F.sum(F.col("s.unit_price")).alias("total_unit_price"),
        F.min(F.col("s.running_count_quantity_rank")).alias("min_running_count_quantity_rank"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(opened_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') opened_date_label
    FROM accounts
    WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2023-03-27'
      AND balance >= 43000
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.amount,
        x.transaction_merchant
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.amount, c.merchant AS transaction_merchant
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY balance ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS row_num
    FROM latest_match
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status, id
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT status, id
    FROM accounts
    WHERE balance <= 18000
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT a.*, d.age
    FROM reconciled a
    INNER JOIN customers d
        ON a.customer_id = d.id
    WHERE d.name NOT LIKE 'Mia%'
)
SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    balance,
    opened_date,
    status,
    opened_date_label,
    amount,
    transaction_merchant,
    age
FROM enriched

    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") >= F.lit("2023-03-27").cast("date")) & (F.col("balance") >= 43000))
    .withColumn("opened_date_label", F.date_format("opened_date", "yyyy-MM-dd"))
)

    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.amount"), F.col("c.merchant").alias("transaction_merchant"))
)

deduped = (
    latest_match
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w2))

    .select("status", "id")

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("days_end_date_to_start_date").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "start_date"), "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("days_end_date_to_start_date").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent_2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy("days_end_date_to_start_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w7 = Window.orderBy("days_end_date_to_start_date_percent_rank", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("start_date"), "plan").orderBy("days_end_date_to_start_date_rank", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("first_known_days_end_date_to_start_date", "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("end_date"), "status").orderBy("first_known_days_end_date_to_start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("start_date"), "customer_id").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

        F.first("days_end_date_to_start_date", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_days_end_date_to_start_date"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent_2).alias("row_seq"),
        F.avg("days_end_date_to_start_date").over(w6).alias("days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("days_end_date_to_start_date_percent_rank_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w7))

        F.sum("days_end_date_to_start_date_percent_rank").over(w10).alias("running_days_end_date_to_start_date_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("next_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior").over(w11).alias("cumulative_next_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_subscriptions
    .select(
        "id",
        "end_date",
        "days_end_date_to_start_date_percent_rank",
        "days_end_date_to_start_date_rank",
        "days_end_date_to_start_date_percent_rank_bucket",

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT(email, ', ', city) email_city,
        COALESCE(segment, 'NONE') resolved_segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE segment = 'Consumer'
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        credit_limit,
        SUM(age) OVER w_hist last3_sum_age,
        MIN(age) OVER w_hist last3_min_age,
        COUNT(age) OVER w_hist last3_count_age,
        AVG(age) OVER w_hist last3_avg_age,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_hist_2 age_cume_dist
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY segment, city ORDER BY credit_limit, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_hist_2 AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY age DESC)
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.name,
        s.city,
        s.last3_sum_age,
        s.age_cume_dist,
        latest.opened_date,
        latest.account_type
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.opened_date, c.account_type
            FROM accounts c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.opened_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.started_at < s.opened_date
        )
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY opened_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_type,
        age_cume_dist,
        last3_sum_age
    FROM latest
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR measure IN (age_cume_dist, last3_sum_age)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("segment", "city").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w_hist_2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("age").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.opened_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

base = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("segment") == "Consumer")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat("email", F.lit(", "), "city").alias("email_city"),
        F.coalesce("segment", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_segment"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "credit_limit",
        F.sum("age").over(w_hist).alias("last3_sum_age"),
        F.min("age").over(w_hist).alias("last3_min_age"),
        F.count("age").over(w_hist).alias("last3_count_age"),
        F.avg("age").over(w_hist).alias("last3_avg_age"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist_2).alias("age_cume_dist"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.name",
        "s.city",
        "s.last3_sum_age",
        "s.age_cume_dist",
        F.col("c.opened_date"),
        F.col("c.account_type"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.started_at") < F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_anti")
)

latest = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

result = (
    latest
    .select("id", "account_type", "age_cume_dist", "last3_sum_age")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "account_type"],
        values=["age_cume_dist", "last3_sum_age"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('year', sale_date) AS sale_date_period
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (2, 4, 10)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date DESC, id) AS row_num
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS prev_units,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS prev_revenue,
        LEAD(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS next_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(units, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_units
    FROM ranked
    WHERE units BETWEEN 26 AND 32
),
ranked_store_sales AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked_store_sales
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY next_revenue DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    store_id,
    kpi,
    metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        revenue,
        prev_revenue,
        next_revenue
    FROM latest
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    metric_value FOR kpi IN (revenue, prev_revenue, next_revenue)
)

w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        attr_key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS attr_key, value
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, LOWER(host) AS host_lower
    FROM lines
    WHERE host NOT IN ('h4', 'h1')
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        attr_key,
        value,
        host_lower,
        LENGTH(host) AS host_length,
        CASE WHEN service IN ('checkout', 'billing') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS service_group,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'N/A') AS resolved_attr_key
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE host = 'h3'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        value,
        host_lower,
        host_length,
        resolved_attr_key,
        COUNT(host_length) OVER w_ordered AS last3_count_host_length,
        AVG(host_length) OVER w_ordered AS last3_avg_host_length,
        MAX(host_length) OVER w_ordered AS last3_max_host_length
    FROM valid
    WHERE service <> 'search'
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY host_length ASC, id ASC, attr_key ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        host_lower,
        resolved_attr_key
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY last3_avg_host_length ASC, id ASC, attr_key ASC) AS latest_rank
        FROM enriched
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    attr_key,
    host_lower,
    resolved_attr_key,
    CASE WHEN attr_key RLIKE '^(version|region)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN attr_key RLIKE '^(trace)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS attr_key_zone
FROM ranked
ORDER BY attr_key_zone ASC NULLS FIRST;

with lines as (

    select
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        explode(tier_limits) as val
    from price_tiers
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, length(currency) as currency_length
    from lines
    where effective_from < '2024-10-28'
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, cast(val as string) as val_str
    from cleaned
    where year(effective_from) >= 2024
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        effective_from,
        val,
        currency_length,
        percent_rank() over (partition by currency order by currency_length) as currency_length_percent_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by currency_length nulls first) as currency_length_dense_rank
    from filtered
    where val < 65
),
with_windows_price_tiers as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        percent_rank() over (order by currency_length_dense_rank desc nulls first) as currency_length_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        percent_rank() over w_grp as currency_length_percent_rank_2,
        dense_rank() over (order by currency_length_percent_rank desc) as currency_length_percent_rank_dense_rank,
        avg(val) over w_part as effective_from_year_avg_val,
        rank() over (order by val) as val_rank
    from with_windows
    window w_grp as (order by currency_length desc), w_part as (partition by year(effective_from))
),
totals as (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    select
        date_trunc('quarter', effective_from) as quarter_start,
        percentile_approx(currency_length_dense_rank_percent_rank, 0.95) as currency_length_dense_rank_percent_rank_p95,
        percentile_approx(currency_length_percent_rank_2, 0.9) as currency_length_percent_rank_2_p90,
        percentile_approx(val_rank, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as val_rank_quartiles
    from with_windows_price_tiers
    group by date_trunc('quarter', effective_from)
)
select
    quarter_start,
    currency_length_percent_rank_2_p90,
    val_rank_quartiles
from totals
order by quarter_start desc;

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), order_date) / 365 AS years_since_order_date,
        COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS resolved_channel
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-09-14'
      AND shipping_fee < 15
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM cleaned
    INTERSECT
    SELECT store_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE channel <> 'store'
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id
),
attributed AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM verified e
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON e.channel = pr.channel
       AND e.order_date >= pr.starts_on
       AND e.order_date < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL '7' DAY
),
attributed_orders AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM attributed s
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON s.channel = pr.channel
       AND s.order_date BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        years_since_order_date,
        promo_id,
        promo_code,
        discount_pct,
        promo_id_2,
        promotion_promo_code,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        SUBSTRING(promo_code, 1, 3) AS promo_code_prefix,
        COALESCE(channel, 'DIRECT') AS channel_filled
    FROM attributed_orders
    WHERE order_date > DATE '2023-05-17'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        status,
        amount,
        discount,
        years_since_order_date,
        promo_id,
        promo_code,
        promotion_promo_code,
        CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pending
    FROM base
    WHERE promo_code IN ('SPRING10', 'VIP')
),
base_orders AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(amount, 0) AS amount_rounded,
        TRIM(status) AS clean_status,
        COALESCE(promo_code, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_promo_code
    FROM filtered
    WHERE promotion_promo_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'BUNDLE'
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        promo_code,
        amount,
        amount_rounded,
        discount,
        years_since_order_date
    FROM base_orders
) src
UNPIVOT (
    val FOR metric_name IN (amount, amount_rounded AS AMOUNT_ROUNDED_VAL, discount AS DISCOUNT, years_since_order_date AS YEARS_SINCE_ORDER_DATE)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-09-14").cast("date")) & (F.col("shipping_fee") < 15))
    .withColumn("years_since_order_date", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "order_date") / 365))
    .withColumn("resolved_channel", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")))
)

kept_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("store_id")
    .intersect(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("channel") != "store")
        .select("store_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

attributed = (
    verified
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("e.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("e.order_date") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("e.order_date") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct"),
    )
)

attributed_orders = (
    attributed
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & F.col("s.order_date").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_2"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

base = (
    attributed_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") > F.lit("2023-05-17").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "years_since_order_date",
        "promo_id",
        "promo_code",
        "discount_pct",
        "promo_id_2",
        "promotion_promo_code",
        "promotion_discount_pct",
        F.substring("promo_code", 1, 3).alias("promo_code_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("promo_code").isin(["SPRING10", "VIP"]))
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "years_since_order_date",
        "promo_id",
        "promo_code",
        "promotion_promo_code",
        F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_pending"),
    )
)

base_orders = (
    filtered
    .filter(~F.col("promotion_promo_code").eqNullSafe(F.lit("BUNDLE")))
    .withColumn("amount_rounded", F.round("amount", 0))
    .withColumn("clean_status", F.trim("status"))
    .withColumn("resolved_promo_code", F.coalesce("promo_code", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

result = (
    base_orders
    .select(
        "promo_code",
        "amount",
        F.col("amount_rounded").alias("AMOUNT_ROUNDED_VAL"),
        F.col("discount").alias("DISCOUNT"),
        F.col("years_since_order_date").alias("YEARS_SINCE_ORDER_DATE"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["promo_code"],
        values=["amount", "AMOUNT_ROUNDED_VAL", "DISCOUNT", "YEARS_SINCE_ORDER_DATE"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="val",
    )
    .filter(F.col("val").isNotNull())
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', sale_date) AS sale_date_period,
        GREATEST(units, revenue) AS greatest_units_revenue
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE revenue <= 4000
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(sale_date_period) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date_period ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR sale_date_period > LAG(sale_date_period) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date_period ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM base
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        units,
        sale_date_period,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date_period ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        units,
        island_id,
        AVG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS units_avg_2_prior,
        LEAD(island_id, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY island_id ASC, id ASC) AS next_island_id,
        STDDEV_SAMP(island_id) OVER w_part AS sale_date_period_month_stddev_samp_island_id
    FROM islands
    WHERE units >= 20
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(sale_date_period))
),
enriched_store_sales AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.store_id,
        e.units,
        e.island_id,
        e.units_avg_2_prior,
        e.next_island_id,
        e.sale_date_period_month_stddev_samp_island_id,
        d.city,
        d.opened_date,
        d.region
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN stores d
        ON e.store_id = d.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    island_id,
    region,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(sale_date_period_month_stddev_samp_island_id, 0.9) AS sale_date_period_month_stddev_samp_island_id_p90,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN region = 'East' THEN 1 END) AS east_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT region) AS distinct_regions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS distinct_store_ids
FROM enriched_store_sales
GROUP BY island_id, region
ORDER BY east_count DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date_period", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("units", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("island_id", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy(F.month("sale_date_period"))

base = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("revenue") <= 4000)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "sale_date").alias("sale_date_period"),
        F.greatest("units", "revenue").alias("greatest_units_revenue"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    base
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("sale_date_period").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("sale_date_period") > F.lag("sale_date_period").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "units",
        "sale_date_period",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    islands
    .filter(F.col("units") >= 20)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "units",
        "island_id",
        F.avg("units").over(w3).alias("units_avg_2_prior"),
        F.lead("island_id", 1).over(w4).alias("next_island_id"),
        F.stddev_samp("island_id").over(w_part).alias("sale_date_period_month_stddev_samp_island_id"),
    )
)

enriched_store_sales = (
    enriched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("e.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.store_id",
        "e.units",
        "e.island_id",
        "e.units_avg_2_prior",
        "e.next_island_id",
        "e.sale_date_period_month_stddev_samp_island_id",
        F.col("d.city"),
        F.col("d.opened_date"),
        F.col("d.region"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_store_sales
    .groupBy("island_id", "region")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("sale_date_period_month_stddev_samp_island_id", 0.9).alias("sale_date_period_month_stddev_samp_island_id_p90"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "East", 1)).alias("east_count"),
        F.countDistinct("region").alias("distinct_regions"),
        F.countDistinct("store_id").alias("distinct_store_ids"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("east_count").desc())
)

with exploded as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) e as k, value
),
cleaned as (
    select
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        value,
        case when host = 'h3' then 1 else 0 end is_h3
    from exploded
    where log_ts > to_date('2025-06-01')
),
metrics as (
    select
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        value,
        is_h3,
        cume_dist() over (order by is_h3 desc nulls first) is_h3_cume_dist,
        avg(is_h3) over (partition by month(log_ts), host order by cast(log_ts as bigint) asc range between 3600 preceding and current row) is_h3_avg_1h,
        sum(is_h3) over (partition by host) host_sum_is_h3
    from cleaned
),
enriched as (
    select
        id,
        is_h3,
        is_h3_avg_1h,
        avg(is_h3_cume_dist) over (order by cast(log_ts as bigint) asc range between 1800 preceding and current row) is_h3_cume_dist_avg_30m,
        percent_rank() over (partition by to_date(log_ts), host order by host_sum_is_h3 asc nulls first) host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank,
        rank() over (order by is_h3_cume_dist desc) is_h3_cume_dist_rank,
        stddev_samp(is_h3_avg_1h) over (partition by host) host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h,
        sum(is_h3_avg_1h) over (partition by host) host_sum_is_h3_avg_1h
    from metrics
),
stats as (
    select
        case when is_h3_cume_dist_rank >= 9 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as is_h3_cume_dist_rank_tier,
        case when is_h3 >= 76 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as is_h3_tier,
        percentile_approx(host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h_quartiles,
        percentile_approx(host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h, 0.5) as host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h_p50,
        sum(host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank) as total_host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank,
        grouping(case when is_h3_cume_dist_rank >= 9 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end) as grouping_level
    from enriched
    group by cube (case when is_h3_cume_dist_rank >= 9 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, case when is_h3 >= 76 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end)
    having total_host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank > 0
)
select
    is_h3_cume_dist_rank_tier,
    host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h_quartiles,
    host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h_p50,
    total_host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank,
    grouping_level
from stats
order by is_h3_cume_dist_rank_tier asc

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_h3").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("host")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("log_ts"), "host").orderBy(F.col("host_sum_is_h3").asc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_h3_cume_dist").desc())

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("log_ts") > F.to_date(F.lit("2025-06-01")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "value",
        F.when(F.col("host") == "h3", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_h3"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "value",
        "is_h3",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("is_h3_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("is_h3").over(w2).alias("is_h3_avg_1h"),
        F.sum("is_h3").over(w3).alias("host_sum_is_h3"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_h3",
        "is_h3_avg_1h",
        F.avg("is_h3_cume_dist").over(w4).alias("is_h3_cume_dist_avg_30m"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("is_h3_cume_dist_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("is_h3_avg_1h").over(w3).alias("host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h"),
        F.sum("is_h3_avg_1h").over(w3).alias("host_sum_is_h3_avg_1h"),
    )
)

stats = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_h3_cume_dist_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("is_h3_cume_dist_rank") >= 9, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("is_h3_tier", F.when(F.col("is_h3") >= 76, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .cube("is_h3_cume_dist_rank_tier", "is_h3_tier")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h", 0.5).alias("host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h_p50"),
        F.sum("host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank").alias("total_host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank"),
        F.grouping("is_h3_cume_dist_rank_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("total_host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank") > 0)
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "is_h3_cume_dist_rank_tier",
        "host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h_quartiles",
        "host_stddev_samp_is_h3_avg_1h_p50",
        "total_host_sum_is_h3_percent_rank",
        "grouping_level",
    )
    .orderBy("is_h3_cume_dist_rank_tier")
)

WITH enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        CORR(discount, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, status) AS corr_discount_amount,
        LAG(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id) AS prev_amount,
        AVG(shipping_fee) OVER (ORDER BY shipping_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS shipping_fee_avg_5,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(order_date), channel ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank,
        AVG(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(order_date), channel ORDER BY shipping_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS shipping_fee_avg_2_prior
    FROM orders
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        corr_discount_amount,
        prev_amount,
        amount_rank,
        shipping_fee_avg_2_prior,
        COALESCE(shipping_fee, 0) AS shipping_fee_filled,
        CAST(shipping_fee_avg_5 AS STRING) AS shipping_fee_avg_5_str
    FROM enriched
    WHERE order_date > DATE '2023-03-24'
      AND customer_id IN (5, 15, 28, 30)
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments x
            WHERE x.order_id = s.id
              AND x.carrier = 'Flash'
        )
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        shipping_fee,
        corr_discount_amount,
        prev_amount,
        amount_rank,
        shipping_fee_filled,
        shipping_fee_avg_5_str,
        COUNT(prev_amount) OVER w_hist AS last4_count_prev_amount,
        AVG(prev_amount) OVER w_hist AS last4_avg_prev_amount,
        MIN(prev_amount) OVER w_hist AS last4_min_prev_amount,
        LAST_VALUE(prev_amount, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipping_fee_avg_2_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_prev_amount
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE prev_amount > 920
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY channel, status ORDER BY corr_discount_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.order_id IN (14, 27, 31)
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    status,
    measure,
    val
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        prev_amount,
        last4_avg_prev_amount
    FROM kept
) src
UNPIVOT (
    val FOR measure IN (prev_amount, last4_avg_prev_amount)
) long_rows;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status")

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status").orderBy("corr_discount_amount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

        F.avg("shipping_fee").over(w3).alias("shipping_fee_avg_5"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("amount_rank"),
        F.avg("shipping_fee").over(w5).alias("shipping_fee_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched

        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        "corr_discount_amount",
        "prev_amount",
        "amount_rank",
        "shipping_fee_avg_2_prior",
        F.coalesce("shipping_fee", F.lit(0)).alias("shipping_fee_filled"),

)

not_flagged = (

)

scored = (

    .filter(F.col("prev_amount") > 920)

        "id",
        "status",
        "shipping_fee",
        "corr_discount_amount",
        "prev_amount",
        "amount_rank",
        "shipping_fee_filled",
        "shipping_fee_avg_5_str",
        F.count("prev_amount").over(w_hist).alias("last4_count_prev_amount"),
        F.avg("prev_amount").over(w_hist).alias("last4_avg_prev_amount"),
        F.min("prev_amount").over(w_hist).alias("last4_min_prev_amount"),
        F.last("prev_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("last_known_prev_amount"),
    )
)

kept = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.order_id").isin([14, 27, 31])), "left_semi")
)

result = (
