with cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        initcap(trim(city)) as city_title,
        regexp_extract(email, '@(.+)$', 1) as email_domain
    from customers
    where segment is not null
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching account per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        x.account_opened_date,
        x.account_status
    from cleaned s
    left join lateral (
            select c.opened_date as account_opened_date, c.status as account_status
            from accounts c
            where c.customer_id = s.id
            order by c.balance desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
with_last as (
    -- Latest matching account per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.name,
        s.email,
        s.city,
        s.is_active,
        s.credit_limit,
        s.account_status,
        x.account_opened_date_2,
        x.account_account_type
    from latest_match s
    left join lateral (
            select c.opened_date as account_opened_date_2, c.account_type as account_account_type
            from accounts c
            where c.customer_id = s.id
            order by c.balance desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
ranked as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from with_last
    qualify row_number() over (partition by account_status, city order by credit_limit desc, id asc) = 1
),
latest as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select
        id,
        city,
        credit_limit
    from ranked
    qualify row_number() over (partition by account_status order by account_opened_date_2 desc nulls last, id asc) = 1
),
eligible as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from latest s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from orders x
            where x.customer_id = s.id
              and x.status = 'CANCELLED'
        )
),
not_flagged as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from eligible s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from sessions ch
            where ch.customer_id = s.id
              and ch.country is null
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    city,
    case when credit_limit >= 17600 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as credit_limit_tier,
    sum(credit_limit) filter (where city = 'Berlin') as berlin_total_credit_limit,
    count_if(city = 'Tokyo') as tokyo_events,
    sort_array(collect_set(city)) as city_list,
    round(sum(credit_limit) / nullif(count(case when city = 'New York' then 1 end), 0), 2) as credit_limit_per_new_york,
    percent_rank() over (partition by city order by count_if(city = 'Tokyo') desc) as tokyo_events_percent_rank
from not_flagged
group by city, case when credit_limit >= 17600 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end
order by berlin_total_credit_limit desc;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.balance").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_status", "city").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_status").orderBy(F.col("account_opened_date_2").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("tokyo_events").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("segment").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.initcap(F.trim("city")).alias("city_title"),
        F.regexp_extract("email", "@(.+)$", 1).alias("email_domain"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.opened_date").alias("account_opened_date"),
        F.col("c.status").alias("account_status"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.name",
        "s.email",
        "s.city",
        "s.is_active",
        "s.credit_limit",
        "s.account_status",
        F.col("c.opened_date").alias("account_opened_date_2"),
        F.col("c.account_type").alias("account_account_type"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_last
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

latest = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "city", "credit_limit")
)

eligible = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("x"), (F.col("x.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.status") == "CANCELLED"), "left_semi")
)

not_flagged = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.country").isNull()), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    not_flagged
    .groupBy(
        "city",
        F.when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 17600, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("credit_limit_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", F.col("credit_limit"))).alias("berlin_total_credit_limit"),

WITH with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM web_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    event_type,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time) AS quarter_start,
    CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 374 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS duration_sec_tier,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_event_time,
    SUM(island_id) FILTER (WHERE page = '/checkout') AS checkout_total_island_id,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS event_type_list
FROM islands
GROUP BY CUBE (event_type, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time), CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 374 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
HAVING checkout_total_island_id > 0;

WITH with_last AS (

        s.*,
        x.price,
        x.product_cost
    FROM suppliers s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.price, c.cost AS product_cost
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating DESC) AS row_num
        FROM with_last
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(rating, 2) OVER w_running AS next_rating,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY price DESC NULLS LAST) AS price_rank
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY price, id)
),
latest_suppliers AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY price_rank NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num_2
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY row_num_2 = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT(supplier_name, ' - ', country) AS supplier_name_country,
        ROUND(rating / price, 2) AS rating_per_price,
        COALESCE(city, 'UNKNOWN') AS city_clean
    FROM latest_suppliers
    WHERE LENGTH(supplier_name) > 7
),
with_last_suppliers AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.rating,
        s.price,
        s.supplier_name_country,
        s.rating_per_price,
        s.city_clean,
        latest.product_cost_2
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost AS product_cost_2
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.rating,
        s.supplier_name_country,
        s.city_clean,
        s.product_cost_2,
        x.cost,
        x.brand
    FROM with_last_suppliers s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost, c.brand
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1

)
SELECT

    ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(cost, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS cost_quartiles
FROM latest_match

ORDER BY umbrella_rows_2

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        CEIL(cost) AS cost_whole,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS carrier_clean
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date > DATE '2023-07-02'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        o.shipping_fee,
        o.amount
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON s.order_id <=> o.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost_whole,
        carrier_clean,
        amount
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC, id) = 1
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        shipped_date,
        cost_whole,
        carrier_clean,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(shipped_date) ORDER BY cost_whole DESC NULLS LAST) AS cost_whole_dense_rank,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', delivered_date)) AS delivered_date_period_avg_amount,
        SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_grp AS cost_whole_percent_rank,
        SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY cost_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY cost_whole DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
grouped AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date) AS activity_month,
        CASE WHEN cumulative_amount >= 8776 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS cumulative_amount_tier,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND(AVG(cost_whole_dense_rank), 2) AS avg_cost_whole_dense_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(cost_whole_percent_rank), 2) AS avg_cost_whole_percent_rank,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(delivered_date_period_avg_amount, 0.9) AS delivered_date_period_avg_amount_p90,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        MAX(cost_whole_percent_rank) AS max_cost_whole_percent_rank
    FROM enriched_shipments
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date), CASE WHEN cumulative_amount >= 8776 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
)
SELECT
    activity_month,
    cumulative_amount_tier,
    event_count,
    delivered_date_period_avg_amount_p90,
    max_cost_whole_percent_rank
FROM grouped
ORDER BY activity_month NULLS FIRST, delivered_date_period_avg_amount_p90;

        "carrier",

        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        F.ceil("cost").alias("cost_whole"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("s.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("o.id")), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("o.shipping_fee"), F.col("o.amount"))
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost_whole",
        "carrier_clean",
        "amount",
    )
)

enriched_shipments = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost_whole",
        "carrier_clean",
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("cost_whole_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w4).alias("delivered_date_period_avg_amount"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w5).alias("cumulative_amount"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_grp).alias("cost_whole_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w7).alias("running_amount"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    enriched_shipments
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "shipped_date").alias("activity_month"),
        F.when(F.col("cumulative_amount") >= 8776, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("cumulative_amount_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("cost_whole_dense_rank"), 2).alias("avg_cost_whole_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("cost_whole_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_cost_whole_percent_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("delivered_date_period_avg_amount", 0.9).alias("delivered_date_period_avg_amount_p90"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.max("cost_whole_percent_rank").alias("max_cost_whole_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "activity_month",
        "cumulative_amount_tier",
        "event_count",
        "delivered_date_period_avg_amount_p90",
        "max_cost_whole_percent_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("activity_month").asc_nulls_first(),
        "delivered_date_period_avg_amount_p90",
    )
)

sql:
WITH metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        LEAD(unit_price, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price ASC, id ASC) AS next_unit_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unit_price ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id ASC) AS seq_no
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, event_seq - next_unit_price AS event_seq_minus_next_unit_price
    FROM metrics
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT order_id
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IN (12, 21, 40)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id
),
cleaned_order_items AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(event_seq_minus_next_unit_price * 1.1, 2) AS event_seq_minus_next_unit_price_adjusted
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE next_unit_price > 240
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, seq_no - event_seq AS seq_no_minus_event_seq
    FROM cleaned_order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(next_unit_price * 1.15, 2) AS next_unit_price_scaled
    FROM filtered
    WHERE event_seq_minus_next_unit_price_adjusted BETWEEN 42 AND 72
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT *, COUNT(seq_no_minus_event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id) AS product_id_count_seq_no_minus_event_seq
    FROM valid
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN next_unit_price_scaled >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS next_unit_price_scaled_tier,
    seq_no,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(seq_no_minus_event_seq, 0.5) AS seq_no_minus_event_seq_p50,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN next_unit_price_scaled >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END) AS gid
FROM scored
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN next_unit_price_scaled >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, seq_no), (CASE WHEN next_unit_price_scaled >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), ())
HAVING PERCENTILE_APPROX(seq_no_minus_event_seq, 0.5) > 0
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("unit_price", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id")

metrics = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        F.lead("unit_price", 2).over(w).alias("next_unit_price"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("event_seq") - F.col("next_unit_price")).alias("event_seq_minus_next_unit_price"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("order_id")
    .subtract(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([12, 21, 40]))
        .select("order_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned_order_items = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("next_unit_price") > 240)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("event_seq_minus_next_unit_price") * 1.1), 2).alias("event_seq_minus_next_unit_price_adjusted"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    cleaned_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select("*", (F.col("seq_no") - F.col("event_seq")).alias("seq_no_minus_event_seq"))
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("event_seq_minus_next_unit_price_adjusted").between(42, 72))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("next_unit_price") * 1.15), 2).alias("next_unit_price_scaled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("seq_no_minus_event_seq").over(w4).alias("product_id_count_seq_no_minus_event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .withColumn("next_unit_price_scaled_tier", F.when(F.col("next_unit_price_scaled") >= 81, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["next_unit_price_scaled_tier", "seq_no"], ["next_unit_price_scaled_tier"], []],
        "next_unit_price_scaled_tier",
        "seq_no",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no_minus_event_seq", 0.5).alias("seq_no_minus_event_seq_p50"),
        F.grouping("next_unit_price_scaled_tier").alias("gid"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("seq_no_minus_event_seq_p50") > 0)
)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        supplier_id,
        LOWER(brand) AS brand_lower,
        SUBSTRING(category, 1, 4) AS category_prefix,
        COALESCE(brand, 'OTHER') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products
    WHERE supplier_id IN (12, 24, 30)
      AND launch_date > DATE '2023-03-17'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.category,
        src.brand,
        src.cost,
        src.launch_date,
        src.supplier_id,
        src.brand_lower,
        src.resolved_brand,
        p.city,
        p.rating,
        p.supplier_name
    FROM base src
    INNER JOIN suppliers p
        ON src.supplier_id <=> p.id
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, LENGTH(brand) AS brand_length
    FROM enriched
    WHERE launch_date > DATE '2023-09-07'
      AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.quantity <= 3
        )
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.brand,
        a.launch_date,
        a.supplier_id,
        a.brand_lower,
        a.city,
        a.rating,
        a.brand_length,
        p.country,
        p.supplier_name AS supplier_supplier_name
    FROM kept a
    LEFT JOIN suppliers p
        ON a.supplier_id = p.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(launch_date), brand ORDER BY brand_length DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, country ORDER BY brand_length DESC, id) AS brand_length_bucket
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE rating BETWEEN 2.2 AND 4.1
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT supplier_id
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT supplier_id
    FROM products
    WHERE supplier_id IS NULL
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.supplier_id = k.supplier_id
),
daily AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        city,
        ROUND(SUM(brand_length_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN brand = 'Acme' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS brand_length_bucket_per_acme,
        COUNT_IF(brand = 'Globex') AS globex_events,
        SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'TH' THEN seq_no ELSE 0 END) AS th_seq_no,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(brand)) AS brand_list,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN brand = 'Umbrella' THEN 1 END) AS umbrella_count
    FROM kept_rows
    GROUP BY CUBE (city)
    HAVING ROUND(SUM(brand_length_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN brand = 'Acme' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) > 0
)
SELECT
    city,
    brand_length_bucket_per_acme,
    th_seq_no,
    brand_list,
    umbrella_count,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Berlin|Tokyo)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN city RLIKE '^(Bangkok|Chiang Mai)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS city_zone
FROM daily
ORDER BY umbrella_count, city_zone;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.month("launch_date"), "brand").orderBy(F.col("brand_length").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("brand", "country").orderBy(F.col("brand_length").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("supplier_id").isin([12, 24, 30]) & (F.col("launch_date") > F.lit("2023-03-17").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "brand",
        "price",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "launch_date",
        "supplier_id",
        F.lower("brand").alias("brand_lower"),
        F.substring("category", 1, 4).alias("category_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_brand"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("p"), F.col("src.supplier_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.category",
        "src.brand",
        "src.cost",
        "src.launch_date",
        "src.supplier_id",
        "src.brand_lower",
        "src.resolved_brand",
        F.col("p.city"),
        F.col("p.rating"),
        F.col("p.supplier_name"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") > F.lit("2023-09-07").cast("date")) & F.col("supplier_id").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.length("brand").alias("brand_length"))
)

kept = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.quantity") <= 3), "left_anti")
)

with_dims = (
    kept
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("p"), F.col("a.supplier_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.brand",
        "a.launch_date",
        "a.supplier_id",
        "a.brand_lower",
        "a.city",
        "a.rating",
        "a.brand_length",
        F.col("p.country"),
        F.col("p.supplier_name").alias("supplier_supplier_name"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("rating").between(2.2, 4.1))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("seq_no"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w2).alias("brand_length_bucket"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("supplier_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_products
        .filter(F.col("supplier_id").isNull())
        .select("supplier_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.supplier_id") == F.col("k.supplier_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

daily = (
    kept_rows
    .cube("city")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("brand_length_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("brand") == "Acme", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("brand_length_bucket_per_acme"),
        F.count_if(F.col("brand") == "Globex").alias("globex_events"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "TH", F.col("seq_no")).otherwise(0)).alias("th_seq_no"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("brand")).alias("brand_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("brand") == "Umbrella", 1)).alias("umbrella_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("brand_length_bucket_per_acme") > 0)
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "city",
        "brand_length_bucket_per_acme",
        "th_seq_no",
        "brand_list",
        "umbrella_count",
        F.when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Berlin|Tokyo)$"), "PRIORITY").when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Bangkok|Chiang Mai)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("city_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("umbrella_count", "city_zone")
)

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(discounts) li AS val
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, plan
    FROM flattened
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, plan
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency = 'USD'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM flattened s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.plan = k.plan
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS val_percent_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_stddev_samp_val,
        MAX(val) OVER w_hist AS plan_max_val
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE val > 70
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY val DESC NULLS FIRST), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY plan)
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        val,
        val_percent_rank,
        plan_max_val,
        AVG(val_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_avg_val_percent_rank
    FROM scored
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    plan,
    measure,
    val
FROM (
    SELECT
        plan,
        val_percent_rank,
        val
    FROM scored_price_tiers
) src
UNPIVOT (
    val FOR measure IN (val_percent_rank AS VAL_PERCENT_RANK_VAL, val AS VAL_VAL)
)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("val").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("plan")

flattened = df_price_tiers.select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode("discounts").alias("val"))

matched_keys = (
    flattened
    .select("id", "plan")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
        .select("id", "plan")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.plan") == F.col("k.plan")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("val") > 70)
    .withColumn("val_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("currency_stddev_samp_val", F.stddev_samp("val").over(w2))
    .withColumn("plan_max_val", F.max("val").over(w_hist))
)

scored_price_tiers = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "val",
        "val_percent_rank",
        "plan_max_val",
        F.avg("val_percent_rank").over(w2).alias("currency_avg_val_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .select(
        "plan",
        F.col("val_percent_rank").alias("VAL_PERCENT_RANK_VAL"),
        F.col("val").alias("VAL_VAL"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["plan"],
        values=["VAL_PERCENT_RANK_VAL", "VAL_VAL"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="val",
    )

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").asc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    lines
    .select(
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "v",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit2"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

base = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "flag_bit2",
        "status_code_high",
        F.greatest("latency_ms", "status_code").alias("greatest_latency_ms_status_code"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("greatest_latency_ms_status_code") <= 27)
    .select(
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "flag_bit2",
        "greatest_latency_ms_status_code",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("status_code_high_dense_rank"),
        F.min("status_code_high").over(w2).alias("attr_key_min_status_code_high"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("flag_bit2") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("flag_bit2_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("attr_key_min_status_code_high") >= 2, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("attr_key_min_status_code_high_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("attr_key_min_status_code_high").alias("max_attr_key_min_status_code_high"),
        F.avg("attr_key_min_status_code_high").alias("avg_attr_key_min_status_code_high"),

)

        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,

        CONCAT(email, ', ', level) AS email_level,

    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-08-12'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        email_level,
        salary_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_id ORDER BY hire_date DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id), 4) AS salary_share
    FROM valid
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT job_title
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT
    SELECT job_title
    FROM employees
    WHERE salary BETWEEN 79000 AND 144000
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.job_title = k.job_title
),
kept_keys_2 AS (
    SELECT dept_id
    FROM reconciled
    EXCEPT
    SELECT dept_id
    FROM employees
    WHERE is_remote
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys_2 k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        job_title,
        salary_level,
        salary_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY row_seq NULLS FIRST) AS row_seq_rank
    FROM verified
    WHERE email NOT LIKE '%@company.co'
)
SELECT
    id,
    email,
    salary_level,
    salary_dense_rank,
    row_seq_rank
FROM enriched
ORDER BY row_seq_rank DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        line.qty,
        line.price,
        line.promo
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(items) x AS line
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM exploded
    EXCEPT
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM carts
    WHERE SIZE(coupon_codes) > 1
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM exploded s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.customer_id,
        a.promo,
        p.city,
        p.signup_date
    FROM kept_rows a
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id <=> p.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.customer_id,
        src.signup_date,
        p.country,
        p.email,
        p.age
    FROM joined src
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON src.customer_id = p.id
    WHERE p.signup_date < '2024-05-21'
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN age >= 70 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS age_tier,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list,
    ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS num_countries,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(age, 0.5) AS age_p50,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list_2
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN age >= 70 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY avg_age DESC NULLS LAST;

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("line", F.explode("items"))
    .select(

        F.col("line.qty"),

    .select("customer_id")
    .subtract(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.size("coupon_codes") > 1)

    .alias("s")

    .select("s.*")
)

joined = (

    .alias("a")

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        shipping_fee,
        UPPER(channel) AS channel_upper
    FROM orders
    WHERE channel <> 'partner'
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY shipping_fee, id) = 1
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching payment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, x.amount
    FROM ranked s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.amount
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.paid_at <= s.order_date
            ORDER BY c.paid_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_latest s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments x
            WHERE x.order_id = s.id
              AND x.delivered_date < s.order_date
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        shipping_fee,
        amount
    FROM kept
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, customer_id ORDER BY shipping_fee NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    p.city,
    e.status,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    AVG(e.shipping_fee) AS avg_shipping_fee,
    SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM latest e
INNER JOIN customers p ON e.customer_id = p.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (p.city, e.status)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.paid_at").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").asc_nulls_first(), "id")

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("channel") != "partner")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.upper("channel").alias("channel_upper"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    valid
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

with_latest = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.paid_at") <= F.col("s.order_date")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

)

)

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))

)

        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),

WITH lines AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS key, v
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, MAX(status_code) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_max_15m
    FROM lines
    WHERE log_ts >= '2023-04-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(log_ts) ORDER BY status_code_max_15m NULLS FIRST) AS status_code_max_15m_rank
    FROM enriched
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(status_code_max_15m / SUM(status_code_max_15m) OVER (PARTITION BY key, host), 4) AS status_code_max_15m_share,
        AVG(status_code_max_15m) OVER (PARTITION BY level, key) AS level_avg_status_code_max_15m,
        AVG(status_code_max_15m_rank) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_max_15m_rank_avg_1h,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY status_code_max_15m_rank DESC) AS status_code_max_15m_rank_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
),
enriched_app_logs AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(status_code_max_15m_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY key) AS key_avg_status_code_max_15m_rank,
        SUM(status_code_max_15m_rank) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_max_15m_rank_sum_2h
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    host,
    log_ts,
    status_code_max_15m_share,
    level_avg_status_code_max_15m,
    status_code_max_15m_rank_avg_1h,
    status_code_max_15m_rank_sum_2h,
    CASE WHEN host RLIKE '^(h3|h4)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS host_zone
FROM enriched_app_logs
ORDER BY status_code_max_15m_rank_avg_1h DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, humidity * status_bits AS humidity_times_status_bits
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE status_bits BETWEEN 5 AND 9
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        firmware,
        humidity_times_status_bits,
        COUNT(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', reading_ts) ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS humidity_count_15m,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c ASC, id ASC) AS temp_c_bucket
    FROM filtered
    WHERE status_bits < 6
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC) AS rn
        FROM scored
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
scored_device_readings AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        humidity_times_status_bits,
        humidity_count_15m,
        AVG(humidity_count_15m) OVER (ORDER BY humidity_count_15m ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS humidity_count_15m_avg_3_prior,
        SUM(temp_c_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(reading_ts), device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS temp_c_bucket_sum_15m
    FROM deduped
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(temp_c_bucket_sum_15m) OVER w_grp AS last3_min_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
        MAX(temp_c_bucket_sum_15m) OVER w_grp AS last3_max_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
        COUNT(temp_c_bucket_sum_15m) OVER w_grp AS last3_count_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
        SUM(temp_c_bucket_sum_15m) OVER w_grp AS last3_sum_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m
    FROM scored_device_readings
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC) AS prev_reading_ts
    FROM with_windows
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_reading_ts IS NULL OR reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + INTERVAL 20 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        humidity_times_status_bits,
        humidity_count_15m,
        humidity_count_15m_avg_3_prior,
        temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
        last3_min_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
        last3_max_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
        last3_count_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
        last3_sum_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_gaps_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL 15 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM islands
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps_2
)
SELECT
    id,
    device_code,
    reading_ts,
    humidity_times_status_bits,
    humidity_count_15m_avg_3_prior,
    last3_min_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
    last3_count_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
    last3_sum_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m,
    session_no,
    CASE WHEN device_code RLIKE '^(DV-02|DV-01)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN device_code RLIKE '^(DV-03|DV-04)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS device_code_zone
FROM sessionized
ORDER BY id DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "reading_ts")).orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("temp_c", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("humidity_count_15m", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("reading_ts"), "device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("status_bits").between(5, 9))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("humidity") * F.col("status_bits")).alias("humidity_times_status_bits"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("status_bits") < 6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "firmware",
        "humidity_times_status_bits",
        F.count("humidity").over(w).alias("humidity_count_15m"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w2).alias("temp_c_bucket"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored_device_readings = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "humidity_times_status_bits",
        "humidity_count_15m",
        F.avg("humidity_count_15m").over(w4).alias("humidity_count_15m_avg_3_prior"),
        F.sum("temp_c_bucket").over(w5).alias("temp_c_bucket_sum_15m"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored_device_readings
    .withColumn("last3_min_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m", F.min("temp_c_bucket_sum_15m").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last3_max_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m", F.max("temp_c_bucket_sum_15m").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last3_count_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m", F.count("temp_c_bucket_sum_15m").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last3_sum_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m", F.sum("temp_c_bucket_sum_15m").over(w_grp))
)

with_prev = with_windows.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(w3))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_reading_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.col("prev_reading_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "humidity_times_status_bits",
        "humidity_count_15m",
        "humidity_count_15m_avg_3_prior",
        "temp_c_bucket_sum_15m",
        "last3_min_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m",
        "last3_max_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m",
        "last3_count_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m",
        "last3_sum_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w7).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

with_gaps_2 = (
    islands
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w3) > F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps_2.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w7))

result = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "humidity_times_status_bits",
        "humidity_count_15m_avg_3_prior",
        "last3_min_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m",
        "last3_count_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m",
        "last3_sum_temp_c_bucket_sum_15m",
        "session_no",
        F.when(F.col("device_code").rlike("^(DV-02|DV-01)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("device_code").rlike("^(DV-03|DV-04)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("device_code_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc())
)

WITH with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching shipment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.carrier
    FROM orders s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.carrier
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', order_date) AS year_start,
    MAX(shipping_fee) AS max_shipping_fee,
    SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_total_amount,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
    COUNT_IF(channel = 'mobile') AS mobile_events,
    MAX(discount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETURNED') AS returned_max_discount
FROM with_latest
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', order_date);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.cost").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

with_latest = (
    df_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.carrier"))
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "order_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.max("shipping_fee").alias("max_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", F.col("amount"))).alias("web_total_amount"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.count_if(F.col("channel") == "mobile").alias("mobile_events"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", F.col("discount"))).alias("returned_max_discount"),
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN units >= 37 THEN 'High' WHEN units >= 7 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS units_tier,
        ROUND(revenue / units, 2) AS revenue_per_unit
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE store_id IN (1, 4, 5)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) = 1
),
deduped_store_sales AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue_per_unit DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS rn
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn ASC) AS latest_rank
    FROM deduped_store_sales
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    dim.city,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    ROUND(SUM(s.units), 2) AS total_units
FROM ranked s
INNER JOIN stores dim ON s.store_id = dim.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (dim.city)
ORDER BY rows_total DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("sale_date").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue_per_unit").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("rn")

valid = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([1, 4, 5]))
    .withColumn("units_tier", F.when(F.col("units") >= 37, "High").when(F.col("units") >= 7, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("revenue_per_unit", F.round((F.col("revenue") / F.col("units")), 2))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

deduped_store_sales = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    deduped_store_sales
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("dim"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("dim.id"), "inner")
    .rollup(F.col("dim.city").alias("city"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.col("s.units")), 2).alias("total_units"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("rows_total").desc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(discounts) e AS val
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS val_percent_rank
    FROM lines
    WHERE currency IN ('THB', 'USD', 'EUR')
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(plan, 1, 4) AS plan_prefix
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE plan IN ('starter', 'pro')
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(val_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY currency, plan) AS currency_avg_val_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC NULLS LAST) AS val_percent_rank_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val_percent_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS val_percent_rank_percent_rank
    FROM filtered
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        val,
        plan_prefix,
        currency_avg_val_percent_rank,
        val_percent_rank_2,
        val_percent_rank_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val_percent_rank) AS val_percent_rank_percent_rank_2,
        AVG(val_percent_rank_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_avg_val_percent_rank_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY val NULLS FIRST) AS val_rank
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    id,
    val,
    plan_prefix,
    val_percent_rank_2,
    val_percent_rank_percent_rank_2,
    plan_avg_val_percent_rank_percent_rank
FROM enriched;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency", "plan")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("val_percent_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.orderBy("val_percent_rank")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("val").asc_nulls_first())

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("val"))
)

with_windows = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("currency").isin(["THB", "USD", "EUR"]))
    .withColumn("val_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("plan").isin(["starter", "pro"]))
    .select("*", F.substring("plan", 1, 4).alias("plan_prefix"))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("currency_avg_val_percent_rank", F.avg("val_percent_rank").over(w2))
    .withColumn("val_percent_rank_2", F.percent_rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("val_percent_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w4))
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "val",
        "plan_prefix",
        "currency_avg_val_percent_rank",
        "val_percent_rank_2",
        "val_percent_rank_percent_rank",
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("val_percent_rank_percent_rank_2"),
        F.avg("val_percent_rank_percent_rank").over(w6).alias("plan_avg_val_percent_rank_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w7).alias("val_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "val",
        "plan_prefix",
        "val_percent_rank_2",
        "val_percent_rank_percent_rank_2",
        "plan_avg_val_percent_rank_percent_rank",
    )
)

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        attr_key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS attr_key, value
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT service, id
    FROM lines
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT service, id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE log_ts >= '2025-06-01'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM lines s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.service = k.service AND s.id = k.id
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN service = 'billing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_billing,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'OTHER') AS attr_key_filled
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE log_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 13:00:00'
      AND attr_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'region'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        attr_key,
        value,
        is_billing,
        attr_key_filled,
        SUM(is_billing) OVER w_grp AS is_billing_sum_2h,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY is_billing) AS is_billing_percent_rank
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        attr_key,
        value,
        attr_key_filled,
        is_billing_percent_rank,
        is_billing_sum_2h / NULLIF(is_billing_percent_rank, 0) AS is_billing_sum_2h_per_is_billing_percent_rank
    FROM enriched
    WHERE is_billing <> 72
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY is_billing_sum_2h_per_is_billing_percent_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS is_billing_sum_2h_per_is_billing_percent_rank_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE is_billing_sum_2h_per_is_billing_percent_rank IS NULL
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN is_billing_percent_rank >= 0.78 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_billing_percent_rank_tier,
        attr_key,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attr_key = 'trace') AS trace_rows,

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct_int", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("starts_on_weekofyear").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("running_max_discount_pct_int", "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_max_discount_pct_int").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.orderBy("running_max_discount_pct_int", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_count_discount_pct_int").desc(), "id")

valid = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2023-07-09").cast("date")) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(

        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",

)

)

with_windows = (

    .select(

        "starts_on",

    )
)

with_windows_promotions = (

    .select(

)

        "starts_on",
        "running_min_discount_pct_int",
        "running_max_discount_pct_int",

)

WITH with_windows AS (

        id,
        plan,
        status,
        LEAD(monthly_fee) OVER w_hist AS next_monthly_fee,
        LAG(monthly_fee) OVER w_hist AS prev_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS row_seq,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status), 4) AS monthly_fee_share
    FROM subscriptions
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY start_date, id)

scored AS (

        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY monthly_fee_share DESC, id) AS monthly_fee_share_bucket
    FROM with_windows
),
scored_subscriptions AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_hist AS row_seq_rank,
        AVG(row_seq) OVER (ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS row_seq_avg_3_prior,
        LEAD(next_monthly_fee_share, 2) OVER (ORDER BY monthly_fee_share_bucket, id) AS next_next_monthly_fee_share
    FROM scored
    WHERE monthly_fee_share_bucket <= 4
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY row_seq DESC)
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_seq_avg_3_prior - next_monthly_fee_share AS row_seq_avg_3_prior_minus_next_monthly_fee_share,
        ROUND(next_monthly_fee_share, 0) AS next_monthly_fee_share_rounded
    FROM scored_subscriptions
    WHERE next_next_monthly_fee_share <= 0.6
),
scored_subscriptions_2 AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        row_seq,
        next_monthly_fee_share,
        row_seq_rank,
        row_seq_avg_3_prior,
        next_next_monthly_fee_share,
        row_seq_avg_3_prior_minus_next_monthly_fee_share,
        next_monthly_fee_share_rounded,
        MAX(row_seq_avg_3_prior) OVER (ORDER BY next_monthly_fee_share_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_row_seq_avg_3_prior,
        COUNT(row_seq_avg_3_prior) OVER (ORDER BY next_monthly_fee_share_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_row_seq_avg_3_prior,
        AVG(row_seq_avg_3_prior) OVER (ORDER BY next_monthly_fee_share_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_row_seq_avg_3_prior,
        MIN(row_seq_avg_3_prior) OVER (ORDER BY next_monthly_fee_share_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_row_seq_avg_3_prior,
        AVG(next_monthly_fee) OVER (ORDER BY row_seq_avg_3_prior_minus_next_monthly_fee_share, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS next_monthly_fee_avg_2
    FROM valid
)

    CASE WHEN running_max_row_seq_avg_3_prior >= 6.8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_max_row_seq_avg_3_prior_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_monthly_fee_share_rounded, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_monthly_fee_share_rounded_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,

FROM scored_subscriptions_2

w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("row_seq").desc())

    .select(

        F.count("row_seq_avg_3_prior").over(w8).alias("running_count_row_seq_avg_3_prior"),
        F.avg("row_seq_avg_3_prior").over(w8).alias("running_avg_row_seq_avg_3_prior"),
        F.min("row_seq_avg_3_prior").over(w8).alias("running_min_row_seq_avg_3_prior"),
        F.avg("next_monthly_fee").over(w9).alias("next_monthly_fee_avg_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_subscriptions_2
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("row_seq_avg_3_prior_minus_next_monthly_fee_share") >= 72, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("row_seq_avg_3_prior_minus_next_monthly_fee_share_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("running_max_row_seq_avg_3_prior") >= 6.8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_max_row_seq_avg_3_prior_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("next_monthly_fee_share_rounded", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_monthly_fee_share_rounded_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("row_seq_avg_3_prior_minus_next_monthly_fee_share", 0.95).alias("row_seq_avg_3_prior_minus_next_monthly_fee_share_p95"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(temp_c * 0.85, 2) AS temp_c_adjusted
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE device_code NOT IN ('DV-02', 'DV-03', 'DV-04')
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL '1' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM filtered
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    device_code,
    CASE WHEN session_id >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS session_id_tier,
    CASE WHEN status_bits >= 10 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS status_bits_tier,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS num_device_codes,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-02' THEN 1 END) AS dv_02_count,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY ROLLUP (device_code, CASE WHEN session_id >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN status_bits >= 10 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
HAVING event_count > 1;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    .filter(~F.col("device_code").isin(["DV-02", "DV-03", "DV-04"]))
    .select("*", F.round((F.col("temp_c") * 0.85), 2).alias("temp_c_adjusted"))
)

    filtered
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

result = (
    sessionized
    .rollup(

        F.when(F.col("session_id") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("session_id_tier"),

        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("device_code_list"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > 1)
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        opened_date,
        CAST(balance AS INT) AS balance_int
    FROM accounts
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2023-06-17'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        opened_date,
        balance_int
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY opened_date DESC NULLS FIRST) = 1
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.opened_date,
        s.balance_int,
        top1.transaction_amount,
        top1.txn_type
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.amount AS transaction_amount, c.txn_type
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time <= s.opened_date
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_latest s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.merchant = 'Starbucks'
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY opened_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
    FROM eligible
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    txn_type,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'CREDIT' THEN 1 END) AS credit_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'REFUND' THEN 1 END) AS refund_count,
    AVG(transaction_amount) FILTER (WHERE txn_type = 'CREDIT') AS credit_avg_transaction_amount
FROM latest
GROUP BY txn_type
ORDER BY credit_count

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.txn_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

valid = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2023-06-17").cast("date"))
    .select(

        "customer_id",
        "opened_date",
        F.col("balance").cast("int").alias("balance_int"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "customer_id", "opened_date", "balance_int")
)

with_latest = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.txn_time") <= F.col("s.opened_date")), "inner")

        "s.balance_int",
        F.col("c.amount").alias("transaction_amount"),
        F.col("c.txn_type"),

    .alias("s")

WITH scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        MAX(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_quantity,
        MIN(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_quantity,
        LAG(unit_price, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS prev_unit_price
    FROM order_items
),
scored_order_items AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_min_quantity, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_min_quantity,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_min_quantity) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY running_max_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_min_quantity_2,
        AVG(prev_unit_price) OVER (ORDER BY prev_unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_unit_price_avg_6_prior
    FROM scored
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(prev_unit_price / running_sum_quantity, 2) AS prev_unit_price_per_running_sum_quantity
    FROM scored_order_items
    WHERE prev_unit_price_avg_6_prior BETWEEN 123 AND 284
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM base
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE quantity IS NULL
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    quantity,
    running_min_quantity,
    prev_unit_price,
    first_known_running_min_quantity_2,
    prev_unit_price_avg_6_prior,
    prev_unit_price_per_running_sum_quantity
FROM reconciled
ORDER BY running_min_quantity DESC NULLS FIRST, prev_unit_price_avg_6_prior;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(amount AS INT) amount_int,
        DATE_TRUNC('week', order_date) order_date_period
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND order_date > DATE '2023-07-24'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY amount, id) prev_discount,
        LAG(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY amount, id) prev_shipping_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY amount, id) event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(discount, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount_int, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_discount
    FROM valid
    WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(order_date_period) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY order_date_period, id) AS prev_order_date_period
    FROM metrics
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_order_date_period IS NULL OR order_date_period > prev_order_date_period + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessions_orders AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        order_date_period,
        prev_discount,
        event_seq,
        last_known_discount,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY order_date_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.unit_price,
        latest.order_item_quantity
    FROM sessions_orders s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.unit_price, c.quantity AS order_item_quantity
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        event_seq,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) amount_avg_5,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY CAST(order_date_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) amount_avg_7d,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part row_seq
    FROM with_last
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY status, channel ORDER BY order_item_quantity DESC, id)
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 38 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS shipping_fee_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(shipping_fee, 0.9) AS shipping_fee_p90,
    ROUND(AVG(row_seq), 2) AS avg_row_seq
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 38 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY shipping_fee_p90 DESC

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(method, 1, 3) AS method_prefix,
        COALESCE(method, 'OTHER') AS method_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND method IS DISTINCT FROM 'cash'
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at
    FROM base
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
sessions_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        status,
        method_filled,
        island_id
    FROM sessions_payments
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY island_id DESC, id) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY island_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_amount,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY island_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_amount,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY island_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_amount,
        MAX(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY island_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_amount,
        FIRST_VALUE(amount, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_amount
    FROM latest
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT method, id
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT
    SELECT method, id
    FROM payments
    WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS', 'REFUNDED', 'FAILED')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.method = k.method AND s.id = k.id
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        status,
        method_filled,
        island_id,
        running_avg_amount,
        running_sum_amount,
        first_known_amount,
        COALESCE(running_max_amount, 0) AS running_max_amount_filled,
        running_sum_amount - island_id AS running_sum_amount_minus_island_id
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE running_min_amount BETWEEN 940 AND 1600
),
enriched_payments AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        status,
        method_filled,
        island_id,
        running_avg_amount,
        running_sum_amount,
        first_known_amount,
        running_max_amount_filled,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY first_known_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS first_known_amount_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status, method ORDER BY running_avg_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS running_avg_amount_dense_rank,
        ROUND(running_sum_amount / SUM(running_sum_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id), 4) AS running_sum_amount_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY island_id DESC) AS island_id_dense_rank
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT
    s.order_id,
    s.method,
    s.amount,
    s.status,
    s.island_id,
    s.running_avg_amount,
    s.running_sum_amount,
    s.first_known_amount,
    s.running_max_amount_filled,
    (SELECT SUM(x.cost) FROM shipments x WHERE x.order_id = s.order_id) AS sum_shipment_cost
FROM enriched_payments s;

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(last_restock, 'MMM yyyy') AS last_restock_label,
        CASE WHEN quantity >= 245 THEN 'High' WHEN quantity >= 120 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS quantity_tier
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock > '2024-10-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, id ASC) AS seq_no,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS quantity_avg_6_prior
    FROM filtered
),
with_windows_inventory AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(quantity_avg_6_prior) OVER w_grp AS running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        MAX(quantity_avg_6_prior) OVER w_grp AS running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        MIN(quantity_avg_6_prior) OVER w_grp AS running_min_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        AVG(quantity_avg_6_prior) OVER w_grp AS running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_recent AS quantity_bucket
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE seq_no <= 7
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC)
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        quantity_tier,
        running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        running_min_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        quantity_bucket
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_bucket ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) AS latest_rank
        FROM with_windows_inventory
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
with_windows_inventory_2 AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior, 1) OVER w_ordered AS next_running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        AVG(quantity) OVER w_grp AS quantity_avg_6_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        LAG(running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior, 2) OVER w_ordered AS prev_running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_hist AS running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior_bucket
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior ASC, id ASC), w_grp AS (ORDER BY quantity_bucket ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), w_hist AS (ORDER BY running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior DESC, id ASC)
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior >= 239 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior_tier,
    CASE WHEN first_known_running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior >= 253 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS first_known_running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior_bucket, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior_bucket_quartiles,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM with_windows_inventory_2
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior >= 239 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN first_known_running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior >= 253 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
HAVING SUM(quantity) > 0;
