w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_bucket").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior", "id")
w7 = Window.orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w8 = Window.orderBy("running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") > "2024-10-01")
    .withColumn("last_restock_label", F.date_format("last_restock", "MMM yyyy"))
    .withColumn("quantity_tier", F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 245, "High").when(F.col("quantity") >= 120, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("seq_no"),
        F.avg("quantity").over(w2).alias("quantity_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

with_windows_inventory = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") <= 7)
    .withColumn("running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior", F.sum("quantity_avg_6_prior").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior", F.max("quantity_avg_6_prior").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("running_min_quantity_avg_6_prior", F.min("quantity_avg_6_prior").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior", F.avg("quantity_avg_6_prior").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("quantity_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w_recent))
)

latest = (

        "running_min_quantity_avg_6_prior",
        "running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior",
        "quantity_bucket",
    )
)

with_windows_inventory_2 = (

    .withColumn("quantity_avg_6_prior", F.avg("quantity").over(w7))
    .withColumn("first_known_running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior", F.first("running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior", ignorenulls=True).over(w8))
    .withColumn("prev_running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior", F.lag("running_sum_quantity_avg_6_prior", 2).over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w_hist))
)

result = (
    with_windows_inventory_2
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior") >= 239, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_max_quantity_avg_6_prior_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("first_known_running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior") >= 253, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("first_known_running_avg_quantity_avg_6_prior_tier"),

WITH latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits) AS rn
    FROM device_readings
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        rn,
        AVG(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS humidity_avg_5,
        SUM(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY status_bits, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_temp_c,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c DESC NULLS LAST) AS temp_c_rank,
        COUNT(humidity) OVER w_ordered AS device_code_count_humidity
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY device_code)
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        rn,
        humidity_avg_5,
        cumulative_temp_c,
        CASE WHEN firmware IN ('1.1.0', '1.0.3') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS firmware_group
    FROM scored
    WHERE temp_c_rank = 6
),
latest_device_readings AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        pressure,
        firmware,
        rn,
        cumulative_temp_c
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits, id) AS row_num
        FROM base
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
scored_device_readings AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        pressure,
        cumulative_temp_c,
        COUNT(cumulative_temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_cumulative_temp_c,
        SUM(cumulative_temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_cumulative_temp_c,
        MIN(cumulative_temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_cumulative_temp_c
    FROM latest_device_readings
    WHERE firmware IN ('1.1.0', '2.0.1')
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM scored_device_readings
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE device_code IN ('DV-02', 'DV-01', 'DV-03')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored_device_readings s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
totals AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN running_count_cumulative_temp_c >= 15 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_count_cumulative_temp_c_tier,
        MAX(running_count_cumulative_temp_c) AS max_running_count_cumulative_temp_c,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(running_min_cumulative_temp_c, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_min_cumulative_temp_c_quartiles
    FROM verified
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN running_count_cumulative_temp_c >= 15 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
)
SELECT running_count_cumulative_temp_c_tier, max_running_count_cumulative_temp_c
FROM totals
ORDER BY running_count_cumulative_temp_c_tier NULLS LAST, max_running_count_cumulative_temp_c

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("status_bits")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc_nulls_last())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("status_bits", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

latest = (
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "rn",
        F.avg("humidity").over(w2).alias("humidity_avg_5"),
        F.sum("temp_c").over(w3).alias("cumulative_temp_c"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("temp_c_rank"),
        F.count("humidity").over(w_ordered).alias("device_code_count_humidity"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("temp_c_rank") == 6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "rn",
        "humidity_avg_5",
        "cumulative_temp_c",
        F.when(F.col("firmware").isin(["1.1.0", "1.0.3"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("firmware_group"),
    )
)

latest_device_readings = (
    base
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "device_code", "pressure", "firmware", "rn", "cumulative_temp_c")
)

scored_device_readings = (
    latest_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("firmware").isin(["1.1.0", "2.0.1"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "pressure",
        "cumulative_temp_c",
        F.count("cumulative_temp_c").over(w7).alias("running_count_cumulative_temp_c"),
        F.sum("cumulative_temp_c").over(w7).alias("running_sum_cumulative_temp_c"),
        F.min("cumulative_temp_c").over(w7).alias("running_min_cumulative_temp_c"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored_device_readings
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("device_code").isin(["DV-02", "DV-01", "DV-03"]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    scored_device_readings
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

totals = (
    verified
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_count_cumulative_temp_c") >= 15, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_count_cumulative_temp_c_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("running_count_cumulative_temp_c").alias("max_running_count_cumulative_temp_c"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_min_cumulative_temp_c", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_min_cumulative_temp_c_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "running_count_cumulative_temp_c_tier",
        "max_running_count_cumulative_temp_c",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("running_count_cumulative_temp_c_tier").asc_nulls_last(),
        "max_running_count_cumulative_temp_c",
    )
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        attr_key,
        value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(attributes) li AS attr_key, value
),
lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT created_at, EXPLODE_OUTER(coupon_codes) AS value_2
    FROM flattened
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN value_2 = 'WELCOME5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_welcome5,
        TRIM(value_2) AS clean_value_2,
        COALESCE(value_2, 'N/A') AS resolved_value_2
    FROM lines
    WHERE created_at > TO_DATE('2025-03-02')
      AND value_2 IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT *, SUM(is_welcome5) OVER (PARTITION BY value_2) AS value_2_sum_is_welcome5
    FROM cleaned
)
SELECT
    created_at,
    value_2,
    is_welcome5,
    clean_value_2,
    value_2_sum_is_welcome5
FROM enriched
ORDER BY created_at NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("value_2")

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode_outer("attributes").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

lines = flattened.select("created_at", F.explode_outer("coupon_codes").alias("value_2"))

cleaned = (
    lines
    .filter((F.col("created_at") > F.to_date(F.lit("2025-03-02"))) & F.col("value_2").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("value_2") == "WELCOME5", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_welcome5"),
        F.trim("value_2").alias("clean_value_2"),
        F.coalesce("value_2", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_value_2"),
    )
)

enriched = cleaned.withColumn("value_2_sum_is_welcome5", F.sum("is_welcome5").over(w))

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "created_at",
        "value_2",
        "is_welcome5",
        "clean_value_2",
        "value_2_sum_is_welcome5",
    )

)

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT s.*, o.order_date
    FROM order_items s
    INNER JOIN orders o
        ON s.order_id = o.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.launch_date,
        b.cost,
        b.product_name
    FROM joined a
    INNER JOIN products b
        ON a.product_id = b.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS prev_unit_price,
        LEAD(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS next_unit_price,
        LEAD(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS next_quantity,
        LAG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS prev_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS row_seq
    FROM with_dims
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS row_seq_2,
        STDDEV_SAMP(next_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id) AS product_id_stddev_samp_next_quantity
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY next_quantity ASC, id ASC)
),
scored_order_items AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY prev_unit_price ASC, id ASC) AS prev_unit_price_bucket,
        LEAD(next_unit_price, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(order_date) ORDER BY unit_price ASC, id ASC) AS next_next_unit_price,
        LAG(prev_quantity, 2) OVER (ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS prev_prev_quantity
    FROM with_windows
),
scored_order_items_2 AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY prev_prev_quantity DESC) AS prev_prev_quantity_cume_dist,
        ROUND(prev_prev_quantity / SUM(prev_prev_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id), 4) AS prev_prev_quantity_share
    FROM scored_order_items
    WHERE next_unit_price >= 190
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN cost >= 560 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cost_tier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_product_ids,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(prev_unit_price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS prev_unit_price_quartiles,
        BIT_OR(quantity) AS quantity_bit_or,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(prev_prev_quantity_share, 0.9) AS prev_prev_quantity_share_p90
    FROM scored_order_items_2
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN cost >= 560 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
)
SELECT
    cost_tier,
    prev_unit_price_quartiles,
    prev_prev_quantity_share_p90
FROM daily

WITH flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) > INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM transactions
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time) AS activity_month,
    ROUND(AVG(new_group_flag), 2) AS avg_new_group_flag,
    ROUND(SUM(new_group_flag) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'REFUND' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS new_group_flag_per_refund,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(merchant)) AS num_merchants,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 END) AS debit_count
FROM islands
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time));

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CAST(discount_pct AS INT) AS discount_pct_int
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'partner'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM cleaned
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
ranked_promotions AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct) AS latest_rank_2
        FROM ranked
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank_2 = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        latest_rank,
        latest_rank_2,
        SUM(discount_pct_int) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code) AS promo_code_sum_discount_pct_int,
        AVG(discount_pct_int) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY latest_rank_2, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS discount_pct_int_avg_6,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(channel) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(starts_on), promo_code ORDER BY starts_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_channel
    FROM ranked_promotions
    WHERE promo_code != 'WELCOME5'
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        discount_pct,
        latest_rank_2,
        promo_code_sum_discount_pct_int,
        first_known_channel,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY event_seq DESC) AS event_seq_rank,
        LAG(discount_pct_int_avg_6, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY latest_rank, id) AS prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct_int_avg_6, id) AS seq_no
    FROM metrics
),
scored_promotions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        promo_code,
        discount_pct,
        latest_rank_2,
        prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6,
        COUNT(prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY event_seq_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_count_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6,
        SUM(prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY event_seq_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_sum_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6,
        AVG(prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY event_seq_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_avg_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6
    FROM scored
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        promo_code,
        last3_avg_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6,
        last3_sum_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6,
        discount_pct
    FROM scored_promotions
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR measure IN (last3_avg_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6, last3_sum_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6, discount_pct)
) long_rows;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id")

w3 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("latest_rank_2", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("starts_on"), "promo_code").orderBy("starts_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("latest_rank", "id")
w9 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct_int_avg_6", "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("event_seq_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("partner")))
    .withColumn("discount_pct_int", F.col("discount_pct").cast("int"))
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

ranked_promotions = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("latest_rank_2", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank_2") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked_promotions
    .filter(F.col("promo_code") != "WELCOME5")
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "latest_rank",
        "latest_rank_2",
        F.sum("discount_pct_int").over(w3).alias("promo_code_sum_discount_pct_int"),
        F.avg("discount_pct_int").over(w4).alias("discount_pct_int_avg_6"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
        F.first("channel", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("first_known_channel"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "discount_pct",
        "latest_rank_2",
        "promo_code_sum_discount_pct_int",
        "first_known_channel",
        F.rank().over(w7).alias("event_seq_rank"),
        F.lag("discount_pct_int_avg_6", 1).over(w8).alias("prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6"),
        F.row_number().over(w9).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

scored_promotions = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "promo_code",
        "discount_pct",
        "latest_rank_2",
        "prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6",
        F.count("prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6").over(w10).alias("last3_count_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6"),
        F.sum("prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6").over(w10).alias("last3_sum_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6"),
        F.avg("prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6").over(w10).alias("last3_avg_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_promotions
    .select(
        "id",
        "promo_code",
        "last3_avg_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6",
        "last3_sum_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6",
        "discount_pct",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "promo_code"],
        values=["last3_avg_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6", "last3_sum_prev_discount_pct_int_avg_6", "discount_pct"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(city) AS city_lower,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), opened_date) / 365 AS years_since_opened_date,
        COALESCE(region, 'NONE') AS region_filled
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2023-08-06'
      AND city <> 'Berlin'
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales ch
            WHERE ch.store_id = s.id
              AND ch.units IS NOT NULL
        )
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT city
    FROM not_flagged
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT city
    FROM stores
    WHERE city <> 'Tokyo'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.city = k.city
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(years_since_opened_date / sqft, 2) AS years_since_opened_date_per_sqft
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'East'
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    city,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date) AS quarter_start,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities,
    ROUND(AVG(years_since_opened_date_per_sqft), 2) AS avg_years_since_opened_date_per_sqft,
    AVG(years_since_opened_date) AS avg_years_since_opened_date,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Tokyo' THEN 1 END) AS tokyo_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list
FROM valid
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((city, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date)), (city));
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") >= F.lit("2023-08-06").cast("date")) & (F.col("city") != "Berlin"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lower("city").alias("city_lower"),
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "opened_date") / 365).alias("years_since_opened_date"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("NONE")).alias("region_filled"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.units").isNotNull()), "left_anti")
)

kept_keys = (
    not_flagged
    .select("city")
    .exceptAll(
        df_stores
        .filter(F.col("city") != "Tokyo")
        .select("city")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("region").eqNullSafe(F.lit("East")))
    .withColumn("years_since_opened_date_per_sqft", F.round((F.col("years_since_opened_date") / F.col("sqft")), 2))
)

result = (
    valid
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "opened_date"))
    .groupingSets([["city", "quarter_start"], ["city"]], "city", "quarter_start")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("city")).alias("num_cities"),
        F.round(F.avg("years_since_opened_date_per_sqft"), 2).alias("avg_years_since_opened_date_per_sqft"),
        F.avg("years_since_opened_date").alias("avg_years_since_opened_date"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Tokyo", 1)).alias("tokyo_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_dense_rank,
        AVG(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY status_code, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS status_code_avg_6_prior,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY status_code, id, k) AS status_code_bucket
    FROM exploded
    WHERE status_code = 267
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_avg_6_prior NULLS FIRST, id, k) AS row_num
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
deduped_app_logs AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        status_code_dense_rank,
        status_code_avg_6_prior,
        status_code_bucket
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code_dense_rank DESC, id, k) AS rn
        FROM deduped
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
metrics_app_logs AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_grp AS status_code_bucket_bucket,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_part AS status_code_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        AVG(status_code_dense_rank) OVER w_recent AS status_code_dense_rank_avg_6,
        SUM(status_code_avg_6_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_status_code_avg_6_prior
    FROM deduped_app_logs
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY status_code_bucket, id, k), w_part AS (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY status_code_dense_rank NULLS FIRST), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY status_code, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(status_code_bucket_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code_dense_rank_avg_6, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS status_code_bucket_bucket_avg_6_prior,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY status_code_dense_rank NULLS FIRST) AS status_code_dense_rank_dense_rank
    FROM metrics_app_logs
),
metrics_app_logs_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_dense_rank_avg_6 DESC) AS status_code_dense_rank_avg_6_percent_rank,
        ROUND(cumulative_status_code_avg_6_prior / SUM(cumulative_status_code_avg_6_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY service), 4) AS cumulative_status_code_avg_6_prior_share,
        AVG(status_code_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_avg_status_code_dense_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY status_code_dense_rank_avg_6 DESC NULLS FIRST) AS status_code_dense_rank_avg_6_percent_rank_2,
        LAG(status_code_dense_rank_percent_rank, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_dense_rank_avg_6, id, k) AS prev_status_code_dense_rank_percent_rank
    FROM enriched
),
daily AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT

)

    service,
    h4_status_code_bucket_bucket
FROM daily
ORDER BY h4_status_code_bucket_bucket DESC NULLS FIRST

w9 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("status_code", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), sale_date) days_since_sale_date,
        ROUND(units, 2) units_rounded
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE units BETWEEN 20 AND 32
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date DESC, id ASC) = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, days_since_sale_date - units_rounded days_since_sale_date_minus_units_rounded
    FROM latest
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-02-21'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units_rounded,
        COUNT(revenue) OVER w_grp running_count_revenue,
        AVG(revenue) OVER w_grp running_avg_revenue,
        MIN(revenue) OVER w_grp running_min_revenue,
        MAX(revenue) OVER w_grp running_max_revenue
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE days_since_sale_date = 46
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY units_rounded ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        units_rounded,
        running_min_revenue,
        MIN(running_avg_revenue) OVER w_recent last7_min_running_avg_revenue,
        MAX(running_avg_revenue) OVER w_recent last7_max_running_avg_revenue,
        SUM(running_avg_revenue) OVER w_recent last7_sum_running_avg_revenue,
        COUNT(running_avg_revenue) OVER w_recent last7_count_running_avg_revenue,
        LEAD(running_avg_revenue, 2) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_revenue ASC, id ASC) next_running_avg_revenue
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY units_rounded ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY units_rounded DESC) units_rounded_cume_dist,
        LAG(next_running_avg_revenue, 2) OVER (ORDER BY last7_count_running_avg_revenue ASC, id ASC) prev_next_running_avg_revenue
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN next_running_avg_revenue >= 4400 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS next_running_avg_revenue_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    AVG(last7_min_running_avg_revenue) AS avg_last7_min_running_avg_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(units_rounded_cume_dist), 2) AS avg_units_rounded_cume_dist
FROM scored_store_sales
GROUP BY CASE WHEN next_running_avg_revenue >= 4400 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY next_running_avg_revenue_tier DESC NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("sale_date").desc(), "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("units_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("units_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("running_min_revenue", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("units_rounded").desc())
w6 = Window.orderBy("last7_count_running_avg_revenue", "id")

base = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("units").between(20, 32))
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",

        "revenue",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "sale_date").alias("days_since_sale_date"),
        F.round("units", 2).alias("units_rounded"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

cleaned = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-02-21").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("days_since_sale_date_minus_units_rounded", (F.col("days_since_sale_date") - F.col("units_rounded")))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("days_since_sale_date") == 46)
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units_rounded",
        F.count("revenue").over(w_grp).alias("running_count_revenue"),
        F.avg("revenue").over(w_grp).alias("running_avg_revenue"),
        F.min("revenue").over(w_grp).alias("running_min_revenue"),
        F.max("revenue").over(w_grp).alias("running_max_revenue"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "units_rounded",
        "running_min_revenue",
        F.min("running_avg_revenue").over(w_recent).alias("last7_min_running_avg_revenue"),
        F.max("running_avg_revenue").over(w_recent).alias("last7_max_running_avg_revenue"),
        F.sum("running_avg_revenue").over(w_recent).alias("last7_sum_running_avg_revenue"),
        F.count("running_avg_revenue").over(w_recent).alias("last7_count_running_avg_revenue"),
        F.lead("running_avg_revenue", 2).over(w4).alias("next_running_avg_revenue"),
    )
)

scored_store_sales = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("units_rounded_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w5))
    .withColumn("prev_next_running_avg_revenue", F.lag("next_running_avg_revenue", 2).over(w6))
)

result = (

    .groupBy(

    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.avg("last7_min_running_avg_revenue").alias("avg_last7_min_running_avg_revenue"),

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        line.product_id,
        line.price,
        line.promo
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(items) li AS line
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(created_at), promo ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_percent_rank,
        MAX(product_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo) AS promo_max_product_id,
        AVG(product_id) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(created_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS product_id_avg_1h
    FROM flattened
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(price * 100, 2) AS price_adjusted
    FROM enriched
    WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 12:00:00'
      AND promo IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(promo_max_product_id AS STRING) AS promo_max_product_id_str,
        COALESCE(promo, 'N/A') AS promo_clean
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE promo IS DISTINCT FROM 'SPRING10'
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo ORDER BY promo_max_product_id DESC) AS promo_max_product_id_percent_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(price) OVER (PARTITION BY promo) AS promo_stddev_samp_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY promo ORDER BY product_id DESC NULLS LAST) AS product_id_cume_dist
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    id,
    created_at,
    product_id,
    promo,
    promo_max_product_id,
    product_id_avg_1h,
    price_adjusted,
    promo_clean,
    promo_max_product_id_percent_rank,
    CASE WHEN promo RLIKE '^(VIP|BUNDLE)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN promo RLIKE '^(SPRING10|WELCOME5)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS promo_zone
FROM scored
ORDER BY promo_zone DESC NULLS FIRST;

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(discounts) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(effective_from), plan ORDER BY tier_value DESC) AS tier_value_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value) AS tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM lines
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_SUB(effective_from, 61) AS effective_from_minus_61d,
        GREATEST(tier_value, tier_value_dense_rank) AS greatest_tier_value_tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM metrics
    WHERE effective_from > DATE '2024-05-03'
      AND tier_value <= 52
),
metrics_price_tiers AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        effective_from,
        tier_value_rank,
        tier_value_rank_2,
        greatest_tier_value_tier_value_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value_rank_2 DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_rank_2_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE plan IN ('starter', 'pro', 'enterprise')
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, DATE_ADD(effective_from, 26) AS effective_from_plus_26d
    FROM metrics_price_tiers
    WHERE tier_value_rank_2_cume_dist BETWEEN 0.6 AND 0.79
)
SELECT
    effective_from,
    tier_value_rank,
    tier_value_rank_2,
    greatest_tier_value_tier_value_dense_rank,
    tier_value_rank_2_cume_dist,
    effective_from_plus_26d
FROM valid;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.month("effective_from"), "plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.orderBy("tier_value")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_rank_2").desc_nulls_last())

    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode("discounts").alias("tier_value"),
    )

    lines
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("tier_value_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("tier_value_rank_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("tier_value_dense_rank"),
    )

cleaned = (
    metrics

with eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from orders s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from shipments ch
            where ch.order_id = s.id
              and ch.shipped_date < s.order_date
        )
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 else 0 end as is_completed
    from eligible
    where customer_id is not null
      and shipping_fee < 21
),
eligible_orders as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from base s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from shipments c
            where c.order_id = s.id
              and c.carrier in ('DHL', 'Flash', 'Kerry')
        )
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        stddev_samp(shipping_fee) over (partition by channel) as channel_stddev_samp_shipping_fee,
        lag(is_completed, 1) over (partition by customer_id, status order by discount, id) as prev_is_completed
    from eligible_orders
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when prev_is_completed >= 83 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as prev_is_completed_tier,
    case when shipping_fee >= 38 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as shipping_fee_tier,
    count(distinct store_id) as distinct_store_ids,
    round(avg(channel_stddev_samp_shipping_fee), 2) as avg_channel_stddev_samp_shipping_fee,
    sum(case when channel = 'web' then discount else 0 end) as web_discount,
    count(*) filter (where channel = 'store') as store_rows
from scored
group by case when prev_is_completed >= 83 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, case when shipping_fee >= 38 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
order by store_rows;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy("discount", "id")

eligible = (
    df_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.shipped_date") < F.col("s.order_date")), "left_anti")
)

base = (
    eligible
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("shipping_fee") < 21))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_completed"),
    )
)

eligible_orders = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.carrier").isin(["DHL", "Flash", "Kerry"])), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    eligible_orders
    .select(
        "*",
        F.stddev_samp("shipping_fee").over(w).alias("channel_stddev_samp_shipping_fee"),
        F.lag("is_completed", 1).over(w2).alias("prev_is_completed"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_is_completed") >= 83, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("prev_is_completed_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 38, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("shipping_fee_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("store_id").alias("distinct_store_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("channel_stddev_samp_shipping_fee"), 2).alias("avg_channel_stddev_samp_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", F.col("discount")).otherwise(0)).alias("web_discount"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", 1)).alias("store_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy("store_rows")
)

WITH unpacked AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        payload_json,
        context,
        context['region'] AS region,
        COALESCE(context['region'], 'direct') AS region_or_default
    FROM app_logs
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts) AS activity_day,
    CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 1821 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS latency_ms_tier,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.9) AS latency_ms_p90,
    MAX(log_ts) AS last_seen,
    MIN(log_ts) AS started_at,
    ROUND(AVG(latency_ms), 2) AS avg_latency_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(latency_ms), 2) AS avg_latency_ms_2
FROM unpacked
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts), CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 1821 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY avg_latency_ms NULLS FIRST;

unpacked = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",

        "payload_json",
        "context",
        F.col("context").getItem("region").alias("region"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("context")["region"], F.lit("direct")).alias("region_or_default"),
    )

    unpacked
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("DAY", "log_ts").alias("activity_day"),

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN cost >= 96 THEN 'High' WHEN cost >= 32 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END cost_tier,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') carrier_filled
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date > TO_DATE('2023-06-06')
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
),
base_shipments AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), shipped_date) days_since_shipped_date,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') resolved_carrier
    FROM base
    WHERE delivered_date > DATE '2023-06-23'
      AND carrier IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(carrier) clean_carrier,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') carrier_filled_2
    FROM base_shipments
    WHERE order_id = 4
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(delivered_date, shipped_date) / 7 weeks_shipped_date_to_delivered_date,
        UPPER(carrier) carrier_upper
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE status NOT IN ('LOST', 'RETURNED', 'DELIVERED')
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    o.channel,
    a.carrier,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    MAX(a.cost) AS max_cost,
    AVG(a.days_since_shipped_date) AS avg_days_since_shipped_date
FROM valid a
INNER JOIN orders o ON a.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.channel, a.carrier
ORDER BY carrier
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-06"))) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("cost_tier", F.when(F.col("cost") >= 96, "High").when(F.col("cost") >= 32, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("carrier_filled", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

base_shipments = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-06-23").cast("date")) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("days_since_shipped_date", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "shipped_date"))
    .withColumn("resolved_carrier", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

cleaned = (
    base_shipments
    .filter(F.col("order_id") == 4)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("carrier").alias("clean_carrier"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_filled_2"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["LOST", "RETURNED", "DELIVERED"]))
    .withColumn("weeks_shipped_date_to_delivered_date", (F.datediff("delivered_date", "shipped_date") / 7))
    .withColumn("carrier_upper", F.upper("carrier"))
)

result = (
    valid
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(F.col("o.channel").alias("channel"), F.col("a.carrier").alias("carrier"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.max(F.col("a.cost")).alias("max_cost"),
        F.avg(F.col("a.days_since_shipped_date")).alias("avg_days_since_shipped_date"),
    )
    .orderBy("carrier")
)

WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS k, attr_value
),
unpacked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        k,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM lines
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        k,
        status_code + status_code_high AS status_code_plus_status_code_high
    FROM unpacked
    WHERE k IS DISTINCT FROM 'version'
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        k,
        status_code_plus_status_code_high
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_plus_status_code_high DESC NULLS FIRST, id, k) AS latest_rank
        FROM cleaned
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        k,
        status_code_plus_status_code_high,
        SUM(status_code_plus_status_code_high) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_sum_status_code_plus_status_code_high,
        LAG(status_code_plus_status_code_high, 1) OVER w_recent AS prev_status_code_plus_status_code_high,
        LEAD(status_code_plus_status_code_high, 2) OVER w_recent AS next_status_code_plus_status_code_high,
        LAST_VALUE(status_code_plus_status_code_high) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_plus_status_code_high, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_status_code_plus_status_code_high,
        LEAD(status_code_plus_status_code_high, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_plus_status_code_high, id, k) AS next_status_code_plus_status_code_high_2
    FROM latest
    WHERE k IN ('trace', 'region', 'version')
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY status_code_plus_status_code_high, id, k)
),
metrics_app_logs AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        k,
        next_status_code_plus_status_code_high,
        last_known_status_code_plus_status_code_high,
        next_status_code_plus_status_code_high_2,
        MAX(last_known_status_code_plus_status_code_high) OVER w_running AS k_max_last_known_status_code_plus_status_code_high,

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("year_start").orderBy(F.col("session_no_p90").desc())

gaps = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "paid_at").alias("year_start"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "paid_at").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "SUCCESS", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("success_amount"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)).alias("failed_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_no", 0.9).alias("session_no_p90"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)).alias("failed_count"),
        F.min("paid_at").alias("first_paid_at"),
    )
    .withColumn("session_no_p90_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
)

with enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        lag(sqft, 1, 0) over (order by opened_date asc, id asc) as prev_sqft,
        max(sqft) over (partition by region) as region_max_sqft,
        round(sqft / sum(sqft) over (partition by region, city), 4) as sqft_share
    from stores
    where sqft >= 14775
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from enriched s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from orders c
            where c.store_id = s.id
              and c.store_id = 40
        )
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, sqft_share + region_max_sqft as sqft_share_plus_region_max_sqft
    from eligible
    where length(store_name) > 5
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching order per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select s.*, top1.order_date
    from filtered s
    left join lateral (
            select c.order_date
            from orders c
            where c.store_id = s.id
              and c.order_date <= s.opened_date
            order by c.order_date desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
kept as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from latest_match s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from orders x
            where x.store_id = s.id
              and x.order_date < s.opened_date
        )
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        region_max_sqft,
        order_date
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by city order by sqft desc nulls first, id asc) as latest_rank
        from kept
    ) ranked
    where latest_rank = 1
)
select
    id,
    city,
    opened_date,
    sqft,
    region_max_sqft,
    case when city rlike '^(Singapore|London)$' then 'GROUP_B' when city rlike '^(Bangkok|Chiang Mai)$' then 'GROUP_A' else 'EXTENDED' end as city_zone
from ranked
order by city_zone desc nulls last

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_failed,
        COALESCE(method, 'UNKNOWN') AS method_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(method) AS clean_method,
        is_failed * amount AS is_failed_times_amount,
        COALESCE(method, 'N/A') AS resolved_method
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-09-24 14:00:00'
      AND method IS NOT NULL
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM filtered
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM islands
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= '2024-05-30'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_count_7d,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_sum_7d
    FROM reconciled
),
cleaned_payments AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN method = 'card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_card
    FROM enriched
    WHERE paid_at >= DATE '2023-09-22'
      AND method IS NOT NULL
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    p.status AS order_status,
    p.channel,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(s.island_id) AS min_island_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM cleaned_payments s
JOIN orders p ON s.order_id = p.id
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.status, p.channel), (p.status), ())

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(account_type) AS account_type_upper,
        ROUND(balance, 2) AS balance_rounded
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'OPEN'
      AND opened_date >= DATE '2023-05-27'
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT account_type, id
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT account_type, id
    FROM accounts
    WHERE account_type IN ('CHECKING', 'LOAN', 'CREDIT')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.account_type = k.account_type AND s.id = k.id
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions x
            WHERE x.account_id = s.id
              AND x.txn_time >= s.opened_date
        )
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        status,
        account_type_upper,
        balance_rounded,
        SUBSTRING(account_type, 1, 2) AS account_type_prefix,
        LOWER(status) AS status_lower
    FROM kept
    WHERE status IN ('CLOSED', 'FROZEN', 'OPEN')
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        status,
        balance_rounded,
        account_type_prefix,
        status_lower,
        MAX(balance_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_max_balance_rounded,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY balance DESC) AS balance_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, account_type ORDER BY balance NULLS LAST) AS balance_percent_rank
    FROM filtered
    WHERE account_type = 'SAVINGS'
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    status,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'CLOSED') AS closed_events,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE account_type = 'LOAN') AS loan_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(balance_rounded), 2) AS avg_balance_rounded,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY ROLLUP (status)
HAVING closed_events >= 1
ORDER BY loan_rows

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        FLOOR(quantity) AS quantity_whole,
        COALESCE(unit_price, 0) AS unit_price_filled
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND order_id IN (3, 23, 32, 39)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(quantity_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_avg_quantity_whole,
        FIRST_VALUE(quantity) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_quantity
    FROM filtered
),
metrics_order_items AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS quantity_bucket,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id) AS unit_price_bucket,
        AVG(unit_price) OVER w_grp AS unit_price_avg_5,
        STDDEV_SAMP(first_known_quantity) OVER w_part AS product_id_stddev_samp_first_known_quantity
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_part AS (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.order_id,
        s.product_id,
        s.quantity,
        s.unit_price,
        s.unit_price_filled,
        s.unit_price_bucket,
        s.unit_price_avg_5,
        s.product_id_stddev_samp_first_known_quantity,
        p.stock_qty,
        p.category,
        p.brand
    FROM metrics_order_items s
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON s.product_id = p.id
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CEIL(product_id_stddev_samp_first_known_quantity) AS product_id_stddev_samp_first_known_quantity_whole,
        stock_qty + unit_price_avg_5 AS stock_qty_plus_unit_price_avg_5
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE unit_price_avg_5 >= 190
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    p.brand AS product_brand,
    s.brand AS order_item_brand,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(s.product_id_stddev_samp_first_known_quantity) AS min_product_id_stddev_samp_first_known_quantity,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM base s
INNER JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY CUBE (p.brand, s.brand)
ORDER BY min_product_id_stddev_samp_first_known_quantity DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.order_id,
        e.amount,
        p.amount AS order_amount,
        p.order_date
    FROM payments e
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON e.order_id <=> p.id
    WHERE p.shipping_fee <= 32
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS amount_avg_6_prior,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_amount DESC) AS order_amount_percent_rank,
        LAG(order_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(order_date), order_id ORDER BY amount, id) AS prev_order_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_date DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date), order_id) AS order_date_period_sum_amount
    FROM enriched
),
enriched_payments AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        SUM(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY prev_order_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_sum_row_seq,
        MIN(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY prev_order_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_min_row_seq,
        MAX(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY prev_order_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_max_row_seq
    FROM with_windows
),
enriched_payments_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(last4_max_row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last4_sum_row_seq, id) AS prev_last4_max_row_seq,
        LEAD(last4_max_row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last4_sum_row_seq, id) AS next_last4_max_row_seq,
        LEAD(last4_min_row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last4_sum_row_seq, id) AS next_last4_min_row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last4_sum_row_seq, id) AS event_seq
    FROM enriched_payments
),
with_windows_payments AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        last4_min_row_seq,
        last4_max_row_seq,
        next_last4_max_row_seq,
        event_seq,
        LAG(last4_min_row_seq, 1) OVER w_grp AS prev_last4_min_row_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(last4_max_row_seq, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY event_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_last4_max_row_seq,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_hist AS next_last4_min_row_seq_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY next_last4_max_row_seq NULLS FIRST) AS next_last4_max_row_seq_percent_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(last4_max_row_seq) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_part AS first_known_last4_max_row_seq_2
    FROM enriched_payments_2
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last4_max_row_seq, id), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY next_last4_min_row_seq NULLS FIRST), w_part AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last4_min_row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(event_seq) OVER (ORDER BY last4_min_row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_count_event_seq,
        MIN(event_seq) OVER (ORDER BY last4_min_row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_min_event_seq,
        AVG(event_seq) OVER (ORDER BY last4_min_row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_avg_event_seq
    FROM with_windows_payments
)

    CASE WHEN last3_avg_event_seq >= 7.6 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS last3_avg_event_seq_tier,
    CASE WHEN prev_last4_min_row_seq >= 6.8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_last4_min_row_seq_tier,
    CASE WHEN next_last4_min_row_seq_percent_rank >= 0.8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS next_last4_min_row_seq_percent_rank_tier,
    AVG(event_seq) AS avg_event_seq,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(first_known_last4_max_row_seq_2, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS first_known_last4_max_row_seq_2_quartiles,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM scored
GROUP BY last3_avg_event_seq_tier, prev_last4_min_row_seq_tier, next_last4_min_row_seq_percent_rank_tier;

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(sqft, 0) AS sqft_rounded
    FROM stores
    WHERE region NOT IN ('West', 'North', 'South')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        sqft_rounded,
        LOWER(store_name) AS store_name_lower,
        COALESCE(region, 'NONE') AS resolved_region
    FROM base
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2023-09-30'
      AND city IN ('Berlin', 'New York', 'Singapore')
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.inventory_last_restock,
        latest.inventory_quantity
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.last_restock AS inventory_last_restock, c.quantity AS inventory_quantity
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.last_restock DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        region,
        sqft_rounded,
        store_name_lower,
        resolved_region,
        inventory_last_restock,
        inventory_quantity,
        AVG(sqft_rounded) OVER (ORDER BY sqft_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sqft_rounded_avg_5_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY inventory_last_restock DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        AVG(sqft_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(inventory_last_restock), region ORDER BY inventory_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sqft_rounded_avg_6_prior,
        SUM(sqft_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY inventory_last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sqft_rounded,
        SUM(inventory_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY inventory_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_inventory_quantity
    FROM latest_match
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        region,
        store_name_lower,
        inventory_quantity,
        event_seq,
        cumulative_sqft_rounded,
        running_inventory_quantity,

        AVG(cumulative_sqft_rounded) OVER (ORDER BY running_inventory_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sqft_rounded_avg_2
    FROM with_windows
)
-- Grouped metrics

    CASE WHEN running_inventory_quantity >= 1166 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_inventory_quantity_tier,

FROM scored
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cumulative_sqft_rounded_avg_2_per_tokyo DESC;

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        last_restock,
        ROUND(quantity * 1.1, 2) AS adjusted_quantity
    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity > 75
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_restock NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(adjusted_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior,
        SUM(adjusted_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY adjusted_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_adjusted_quantity
    FROM deduped
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM enriched
    INTERSECT
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity >= 136
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id AND s.id = k.id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        last_restock,
        adjusted_quantity,
        running_adjusted_quantity,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(last_restock), store_id ORDER BY adjusted_quantity DESC NULLS FIRST) AS adjusted_quantity_cume_dist,
        MIN(running_adjusted_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_min_running_adjusted_quantity,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY running_adjusted_quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS running_adjusted_quantity_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(last_restock) ORDER BY adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior DESC NULLS FIRST) AS adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior DESC NULLS FIRST) AS adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior_dense_rank
    FROM reconciled
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_restock) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(adjusted_quantity_cume_dist, 0.95) AS adjusted_quantity_cume_dist_p95,
    SUM(adjusted_quantity) AS total_adjusted_quantity,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior_dense_rank, 0.5) AS adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior_dense_rank_p50,
    ROUND(AVG(adjusted_quantity_cume_dist), 2) AS avg_adjusted_quantity_cume_dist
FROM metrics
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_restock)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("adjusted_quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("last_restock"), "store_id").orderBy(F.col("adjusted_quantity").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id")

w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_restock")).orderBy(F.col("adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior").desc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior").desc_nulls_first())

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("quantity") > 75)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.round((F.col("quantity") * 1.1), 2).alias("adjusted_quantity"),
    )
)

deduped = (

)

matched_keys = (

    .select("store_id", "id")
    .intersect(

        .filter(F.col("quantity") >= 136)
        .select("store_id", "id")
    )

    .alias("s")

)

metrics = (

        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w8).alias("adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "last_restock").alias("activity_month"))

        F.sum("adjusted_quantity").alias("total_adjusted_quantity"),
        F.percentile_approx("adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior_dense_rank", 0.5).alias("adjusted_quantity_avg_6_prior_dense_rank_p50"),

    )
)

with with_last as (

    select
        s.*,
        x.quantity,
        x.order_item_unit_price
    from orders s
    join lateral (
            select c.quantity, c.unit_price as order_item_unit_price
            from order_items c
            where c.order_id = s.id
            order by c.quantity desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        first_value(amount, true) over (order by discount, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_amount,
        lag(discount, 1) over (partition by store_id, customer_id order by order_item_unit_price, id) as prev_discount,
        max(discount) over (partition by channel) as channel_max_discount,
        cume_dist() over (partition by channel order by order_item_unit_price desc nulls last) as order_item_unit_price_cume_dist,
        row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by order_item_unit_price desc, id) as seq_no
    from with_last
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching payment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select s.*, x.payment_amount
    from with_windows s
    left join lateral (
            select c.amount as payment_amount
            from payments c
            where c.order_id = s.id
            order by c.paid_at desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from latest_match
    qualify rank() over (partition by store_id order by order_item_unit_price_cume_dist) = 1
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_SUB(order_date, 45) AS order_date_minus_45d,
        shipping_fee + discount AS shipping_fee_plus_discount,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') AS resolved_channel
    FROM orders
    WHERE channel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'store'
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.status = 'LOST'
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, channel ORDER BY discount, id) AS discount_bucket,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_hist AS discount_cume_dist
    FROM kept
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY discount DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        amount,
        discount,
        order_date_minus_45d,
        discount_bucket,
        discount_cume_dist,
        LEAD(discount_bucket) OVER w_part AS next_discount_bucket,
        LAG(amount) OVER w_part AS prev_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS row_seq,
        AVG(discount) OVER w_grp AS discount_avg_6_prior
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY shipping_fee, id), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(order_date), customer_id ORDER BY order_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(discount_cume_dist) OVER w_running AS last7_max_discount_cume_dist,
        SUM(discount_cume_dist) OVER w_running AS last7_sum_discount_cume_dist,
        MIN(discount_cume_dist) OVER w_running AS last7_min_discount_cume_dist,
        COUNT(discount_cume_dist) OVER w_running AS last7_count_discount_cume_dist,
        SUM(discount_avg_6_prior) OVER w_recent AS running_discount_avg_6_prior
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE customer_id IN (6, 13, 24)
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY next_discount_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.discount,
        s.discount_bucket,
        s.discount_cume_dist,
        s.prev_amount,
        s.last7_max_discount_cume_dist,
        s.last7_sum_discount_cume_dist,
        p.city,
        p.email,
        p.credit_limit
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON s.customer_id <=> p.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.customer_id,
        a.discount,
        a.discount_bucket,
        a.last7_max_discount_cume_dist,
        a.last7_sum_discount_cume_dist,
        a.city,
        a.email,
        a.credit_limit,
        p.segment,
        p.age
    FROM with_dims a
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id <=> p.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    city,
    CASE WHEN discount >= 0.44 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS discount_tier,
    AVG(last7_max_discount_cume_dist) AS avg_last7_max_discount_cume_dist,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Chiang Mai') AS chiang_mai_rows,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
    MAX(last7_max_discount_cume_dist) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Bangkok') AS bangkok_max_last7_max_discount_cume_dist,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list_2,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Chiang Mai') DESC) AS chiang_mai_rows_dense_rank
FROM joined
GROUP BY city, CASE WHEN discount >= 0.44 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "channel").orderBy("discount", "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc_nulls_first())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date"), "customer_id").orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("next_discount_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("chiang_mai_rows").desc())

base = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("store")))
    .withColumn("order_date_minus_45d", F.date_sub("order_date", 45))
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_plus_discount", (F.col("shipping_fee") + F.col("discount")))
    .withColumn("resolved_channel", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

kept = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.status") == "LOST"), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    kept
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(w).alias("discount_bucket"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist).alias("discount_cume_dist"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "order_date_minus_45d",
        "discount_bucket",
        "discount_cume_dist",
        F.lead("discount_bucket").over(w_part).alias("next_discount_bucket"),
        F.lag("amount").over(w_part).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("row_seq"),
        F.avg("discount").over(w_grp).alias("discount_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([6, 13, 24]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("discount_cume_dist").over(w_running).alias("last7_max_discount_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("discount_cume_dist").over(w_running).alias("last7_sum_discount_cume_dist"),
        F.min("discount_cume_dist").over(w_running).alias("last7_min_discount_cume_dist"),
        F.count("discount_cume_dist").over(w_running).alias("last7_count_discount_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("discount_avg_6_prior").over(w_recent).alias("running_discount_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("s.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.discount",
        "s.discount_bucket",
        "s.discount_cume_dist",
        "s.prev_amount",
        "s.last7_max_discount_cume_dist",
        "s.last7_sum_discount_cume_dist",
        F.col("p.city"),
        F.col("p.email"),
        F.col("p.credit_limit"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_dims
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.customer_id",
        "a.discount",
        "a.discount_bucket",
        "a.last7_max_discount_cume_dist",
        "a.last7_sum_discount_cume_dist",
        "a.city",
        "a.email",
        "a.credit_limit",
        F.col("p.segment"),
        F.col("p.age"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy(
        "city",
        F.when(F.col("discount") >= 0.44, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("discount_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("last7_max_discount_cume_dist").alias("avg_last7_max_discount_cume_dist"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Chiang Mai", 1)).alias("chiang_mai_rows"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", F.col("last7_max_discount_cume_dist"))).alias("bangkok_max_last7_max_discount_cume_dist"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list_2"),
    )
    .withColumn("chiang_mai_rows_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w7))
)
