with with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        lag(amount, 1) over w_running as prev_amount,
        corr(discount, amount) over (partition by customer_id, store_id) as corr_discount_amount,
        ntile(10) over (partition by month(order_date) order by shipping_fee, id) as shipping_fee_bucket,
        row_number() over w_hist as event_seq
    from orders
    where store_id = 14
    window w_running as (order by shipping_fee, id), w_hist as (partition by month(order_date), channel order by discount desc, id)
),
with_last as (
    -- Latest matching shipment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        top1.shipment_status,
        top1.shipment_shipped_date
    from with_windows s
    join lateral (
            select c.status as shipment_status, c.shipped_date as shipment_shipped_date
            from shipments c
            where c.order_id = s.id
              and c.shipped_date <= s.order_date
            order by c.shipped_date desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from with_last s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from order_items x
            where x.order_id = s.id
              and x.unit_price between 150 and 370
        )
),
with_windows_orders as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        corr_discount_amount,
        event_seq,
        shipment_status,
        shipment_shipped_date,
        lag(discount) over w_recent as prev_discount,
        lead(discount) over w_recent as next_discount,
        lead(amount) over w_recent as next_amount,
        lag(amount) over w_recent as prev_amount_2,
        row_number() over w_recent as event_seq_2
    from eligible
    window w_recent as (partition by channel order by shipping_fee, id)
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching payment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        top1.payment_amount,
        top1.payment_method
    from with_windows_orders s
    join lateral (
            select c.amount as payment_amount, c.method as payment_method
            from payments c
            where c.order_id = s.id
            order by c.paid_at desc, c.id desc

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "store_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date")).orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date"), "channel").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.shipped_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.paid_at").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

with_windows = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("store_id") == 14)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("amount", 1).over(w_running).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.corr("discount", "amount").over(w2).alias("corr_discount_amount"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w3).alias("shipping_fee_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w_hist).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))

    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.status").alias("shipment_status"),
        F.col("c.shipped_date").alias("shipment_shipped_date"),
    )
)

eligible = (

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, COALESCE(quantity, 0) quantity_filled
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock > '2025-02-23'
),
filtered_inventory AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        quantity + quantity_filled quantity_plus_quantity_filled,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_restock) / 365 years_since_last_restock
    FROM filtered
    WHERE store_id IN (1, 4, 5, 6)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        last_restock,
        quantity_filled,
        quantity_plus_quantity_filled,
        AVG(years_since_last_restock) OVER w_hist years_since_last_restock_avg_6,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY years_since_last_restock DESC NULLS LAST) years_since_last_restock_dense_rank
    FROM filtered_inventory
    WHERE MONTH(last_restock) IN (1, 5, 9)
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY years_since_last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE product_id IN (4, 8)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id AND s.id = k.id
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, store_id
    FROM kept_rows
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id, store_id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE product_id = 5
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.store_id = k.store_id
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    p.region,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(e.years_since_last_restock_dense_rank), 2) AS total_years_since_last_restock_dense_rank,
    ROUND(SUM(e.quantity_plus_quantity_filled), 2) AS total_quantity_plus_quantity_filled
FROM reconciled e
INNER JOIN stores p ON e.store_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.region

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.orderBy("years_since_last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("years_since_last_restock").desc_nulls_last())

filtered = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") > "2025-02-23")
    .withColumn("quantity_filled", F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)))
)

filtered_inventory = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([1, 4, 5, 6]))
    .withColumn("quantity_plus_quantity_filled", (F.col("quantity") + F.col("quantity_filled")))
    .withColumn("years_since_last_restock", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "last_restock") / 365))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered_inventory
    .filter(F.month("last_restock").isin([1, 5, 9]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_filled",
        "quantity_plus_quantity_filled",
        F.avg("years_since_last_restock").over(w_hist).alias("years_since_last_restock_avg_6"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("years_since_last_restock_dense_rank"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("store_id", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([4, 8]))
        .select("store_id", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

matched_keys = (
    kept_rows
    .select("id", "store_id")
    .subtract(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("product_id") == 5)
        .select("id", "store_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("e.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(F.col("p.region").alias("region"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.col("e.years_since_last_restock_dense_rank")), 2).alias("total_years_since_last_restock_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.col("e.quantity_plus_quantity_filled")), 2).alias("total_quantity_plus_quantity_filled"),
    )
)

with joined as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.product_id,
        a.unit_price,
        d.stock_qty
    from order_items a
    left join products d
        on a.product_id <=> d.id
    where d.launch_date between '2024-07-01' and '2025-08-01'
),
valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, round(unit_price, 0) as unit_price_rounded
    from joined
    where product_id is not null
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        product_id,
        unit_price,
        stock_qty,
        unit_price_rounded,
        ntile(5) over (order by unit_price_rounded, id) as unit_price_rounded_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by order_id order by unit_price_rounded, id) as row_seq
    from valid
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        stock_qty,
        unit_price_rounded
    from enriched
    qualify row_number() over (partition by product_id order by unit_price_rounded desc, id) = 1
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        sum(unit_price_rounded) over w_running as running_sum_unit_price_rounded,
        max(unit_price_rounded) over w_running as running_max_unit_price_rounded,
        avg(unit_price_rounded) over w_running as running_avg_unit_price_rounded,
        row_number() over (order by stock_qty desc, id) as event_seq
    from ranked
    window w_running as (order by unit_price_rounded, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
)
select
    id,
    stock_qty,
    running_sum_unit_price_rounded,
    running_avg_unit_price_rounded
from metrics
order by running_sum_unit_price_rounded nulls last;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("unit_price_rounded", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price_rounded", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price_rounded").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy("unit_price_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").desc(), "id")

joined = (
    df_order_items
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("a.product_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.launch_date").between("2024-07-01", "2025-08-01"))
    .select("a.id", "a.order_id", "a.product_id", "a.unit_price", F.col("d.stock_qty"))
)

valid = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("unit_price_rounded", F.round("unit_price", 0))
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        "stock_qty",
        "unit_price_rounded",
        F.ntile(5).over(w).alias("unit_price_rounded_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "stock_qty", "unit_price_rounded")
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("running_sum_unit_price_rounded", F.sum("unit_price_rounded").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("running_max_unit_price_rounded", F.max("unit_price_rounded").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("running_avg_unit_price_rounded", F.avg("unit_price_rounded").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w5))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "stock_qty",
        "running_sum_unit_price_rounded",
        "running_avg_unit_price_rounded",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("running_sum_unit_price_rounded").asc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) x as k, value
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, cast(status_code as double) status_code_str
    from exploded
    where k is not distinct from 'version'
      and level = 'ERROR'
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select *, sum(status_code_str) over (partition by k) k_sum_status_code_str
    from filtered
    where level in ('DEBUG', 'INFO', 'WARN')
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, status_code / nullif(k_sum_status_code_str, 0) status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str
    from with_windows
    where level in ('ERROR', 'DEBUG', 'INFO')
),
with_windows_app_logs as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        stddev_samp(status_code_str) over (partition by k) k_stddev_samp_status_code_str,
        percent_rank() over (partition by service order by k_sum_status_code_str desc nulls first) k_sum_status_code_str_percent_rank
    from base
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        dense_rank() over (partition by service, k order by k_stddev_samp_status_code_str desc) k_stddev_samp_status_code_str_dense_rank,
        sum(status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str) over (partition by level) level_sum_status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str,
        cume_dist() over (order by k_sum_status_code_str desc nulls first) k_sum_status_code_str_cume_dist
    from with_windows_app_logs
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id
    from metrics
    except
    select id
    from app_logs
    where service = 'auth'
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics s
    join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when status_code_str >= 77 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as status_code_str_tier,
    case when status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str >= 85 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str_tier,
    bit_or(status_code) as status_code_bit_or,
    sum(k_stddev_samp_status_code_str) filter (where host = 'h1') as h1_total_k_stddev_samp_status_code_str,
    count(case when host = 'h3' then 1 end) as h3_count
from reconciled
group by grouping sets ((case when status_code_str >= 77 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, case when status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str >= 85 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end), (case when status_code_str >= 77 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end))
having bit_or(status_code) > 1
order by status_code_str_tier desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("k_sum_status_code_str").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service", "k").orderBy(F.col("k_stddev_samp_status_code_str").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("k_sum_status_code_str").desc_nulls_first())

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    exploded
    .filter((F.col("k").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version"))) & (F.col("level") == "ERROR"))
    .select("*", F.col("status_code").cast("double").alias("status_code_str"))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("level").isin(["DEBUG", "INFO", "WARN"]))
    .withColumn("k_sum_status_code_str", F.sum("status_code_str").over(w))
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("level").isin(["ERROR", "DEBUG", "INFO"]))
    .withColumn("status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str", (F.col("status_code") / F.nullif("k_sum_status_code_str", F.lit(0))))
)

with_windows_app_logs = (
    base
    .withColumn("k_stddev_samp_status_code_str", F.stddev_samp("status_code_str").over(w))
    .withColumn("k_sum_status_code_str_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w2))
)

metrics = (
    with_windows_app_logs
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("k_stddev_samp_status_code_str_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str").over(w4).alias("level_sum_status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("k_sum_status_code_str_cume_dist"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("service") == "auth")
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("status_code_str_tier", F.when(F.col("status_code_str") >= 77, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str_tier", F.when(F.col("status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str") >= 85, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["status_code_str_tier", "status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str_tier"], ["status_code_str_tier"]],
        "status_code_str_tier",
        "status_code_per_k_sum_status_code_str_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.bit_or("status_code").alias("status_code_bit_or"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("host") == "h1", F.col("k_stddev_samp_status_code_str"))).alias("h1_total_k_stddev_samp_status_code_str"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("host") == "h3", 1)).alias("h3_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("status_code_bit_or") > 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("status_code_str_tier").desc())
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        CAST(amount AS INT) AS amount_int,
        COALESCE(method, 'OTHER') AS method_clean
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        d.channel,
        d.amount AS order_amount
    FROM base e
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON e.order_id <=> d.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        channel,
        order_amount,
        LEAD(amount_int) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_amount, id) AS next_amount_int,
        LAG(order_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_amount, id) AS prev_order_amount,
        LEAD(order_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_amount, id) AS next_order_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_amount, id) AS event_seq
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE TO_DATE(paid_at) >= '2025-07-28'
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        channel,
        order_amount,
        prev_order_amount,
        next_order_amount,
        event_seq,
        prev_order_amount + order_amount AS prev_order_amount_plus_order_amount,
        LEAST(next_order_amount, order_amount) AS least_next_order_amount_order_amount
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
      AND channel = 'store'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY least_next_order_amount_order_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY next_order_amount DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        STDDEV_SAMP(least_next_order_amount_order_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, status) AS channel_stddev_samp_least_next_order_amount_order_amount
    FROM valid
),
with_windows_payments AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        next_order_amount,
        prev_order_amount_plus_order_amount,
        running_event_seq,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY status, channel ORDER BY running_event_seq, id) AS running_event_seq_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, channel ORDER BY least_next_order_amount_order_amount DESC, id) AS seq_no_2
    FROM scored
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(channel, 'unassigned') AS channel_filled,
        COALESCE(channel, 'DIRECT') AS channel_clean
    FROM with_windows_payments
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
      AND seq_no_2 = 4
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN seq_no_2 >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS seq_no_2_tier,
    CASE WHEN next_order_amount >= 1690 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS next_order_amount_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(running_event_seq_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS running_event_seq_bucket_per_store
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN seq_no_2 >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN next_order_amount >= 1690 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (CASE WHEN seq_no_2 >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), ())
ORDER BY next_order_amount_tier DESC NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("order_amount", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("least_next_order_amount_order_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_order_amount").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status", "channel").orderBy("running_event_seq", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status", "channel").orderBy(F.col("least_next_order_amount_order_amount").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.col("amount").cast("int").alias("amount_int"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("e.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.channel"), F.col("d.amount").alias("order_amount"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.to_date("paid_at") >= "2025-07-28")
    .select(
        "id",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "order_amount",
        F.lead("amount_int").over(w).alias("next_amount_int"),
        F.lag("order_amount").over(w).alias("prev_order_amount"),
        F.lead("order_amount").over(w).alias("next_order_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull() & (F.col("channel") == "store"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "order_amount",
        "prev_order_amount",
        "next_order_amount",
        "event_seq",
        (F.col("prev_order_amount") + F.col("order_amount")).alias("prev_order_amount_plus_order_amount"),
        F.least("next_order_amount", "order_amount").alias("least_next_order_amount_order_amount"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .withColumn("running_event_seq", F.sum("event_seq").over(w2))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .withColumn("channel_stddev_samp_least_next_order_amount_order_amount", F.stddev_samp("least_next_order_amount_order_amount").over(w4))
)

with_windows_payments = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "next_order_amount",
        "prev_order_amount_plus_order_amount",
        "running_event_seq",
        F.ntile(5).over(w5).alias("running_event_seq_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("seq_no_2"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_windows_payments
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull() & (F.col("seq_no_2") == 4))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("channel_filled"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("seq_no_2_tier", F.when(F.col("seq_no_2") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("next_order_amount_tier", F.when(F.col("next_order_amount") >= 1690, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["seq_no_2_tier", "next_order_amount_tier"], ["seq_no_2_tier"], []],
        "seq_no_2_tier",
        "next_order_amount_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", 1)).alias("store_rows"),
        F.round(F.sum("running_event_seq_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_event_seq_bucket_per_store"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("next_order_amount_tier").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        INITCAP(TRIM(supplier_name)) AS supplier_name_title,
        LOWER(country) AS country_lower,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') AS city_filled
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE supplier_name LIKE 'P%'
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.stock_qty <> 126
        )
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        supplier_name_title,
        city_filled,
        CONCAT(supplier_name, '/', country) AS supplier_name_country
    FROM kept
    WHERE supplier_name IS NOT NULL
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.supplier_name_title,
        s.supplier_name_country,
        latest.product_launch_date
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.launch_date AS product_launch_date
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
kept_suppliers AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.product_name LIKE 'C%'
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', product_launch_date) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM kept_suppliers
GROUP BY activity_month
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

filtered = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("supplier_name").like("P%"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name",
        "country",
        F.initcap(F.trim("supplier_name")).alias("supplier_name_title"),
        F.lower("country").alias("country_lower"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("city_filled"),
    )
)

kept = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.stock_qty") != 126), "left_anti")
)

cleaned = (
    kept
    .filter(F.col("supplier_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name",
        "country",
        "supplier_name_title",
        "city_filled",
        F.concat("supplier_name", F.lit("/"), "country").alias("supplier_name_country"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.supplier_name",
        "s.supplier_name_title",
        "s.supplier_name_country",
        F.col("c.launch_date").alias("product_launch_date"),
    )
)

kept_suppliers = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.product_name").like("C%")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept_suppliers
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "product_launch_date").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_count") >= 1)
)

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_limits,
        ELEMENT_AT(tier_prices, 1) AS entry_price,
        AGGREGATE(tier_prices, 0.0D, (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> ROUND(acc / SIZE(tier_prices), 2)) AS avg_tier_price,
        SLICE(tier_limits, 1, 2) AS first_two_limits
    FROM price_tiers
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN avg_tier_price >= 32 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS avg_tier_price_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT plan) AS distinct_plans,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(avg_tier_price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS avg_tier_price_quartiles,
    COUNT_IF(plan = 'enterprise') AS enterprise_events,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan = 'basic') AS basic_rows,
    COUNT_IF(currency = 'EUR') AS eur_events
FROM parsed
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN avg_tier_price >= 32 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
ORDER BY avg_tier_price_tier ASC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

parsed = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "tier_limits",
        F.element_at("tier_prices", 1).alias("entry_price"),
        F.aggregate("tier_prices", F.lit(0.0), lambda acc, p: acc + p, lambda acc: F.round(acc / F.size("tier_prices"), 2)).alias("avg_tier_price"),
        F.slice("tier_limits", 1, 2).alias("first_two_limits"),
    )
)

result = (
    parsed
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("avg_tier_price") >= 32, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("avg_tier_price_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("plan").alias("distinct_plans"),
        F.percentile_approx("avg_tier_price", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("avg_tier_price_quartiles"),
        F.count_if(F.col("plan") == "enterprise").alias("enterprise_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "basic", 1)).alias("basic_rows"),
        F.count_if(F.col("currency") == "EUR").alias("eur_events"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_tier_price_tier").asc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(cost, 0) AS cost_filled,
        COALESCE(brand, 'DIRECT') AS brand_clean
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date > TO_DATE('2023-03-04')
      AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        cost,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        cost_filled,
        brand_clean,
        AVG(price) OVER w_running AS price_avg_2_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY stock_qty DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        LAST_VALUE(cost) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_grp AS last_known_cost,
        CORR(price, stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY brand) AS corr_price_stock_qty,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, category ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY brand, supplier_id ORDER BY launch_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, category ORDER BY cost NULLS FIRST) AS rank_in_group
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT e.*, b.rating
    FROM ranked e
    LEFT JOIN suppliers b
        ON e.supplier_id <=> b.id
),
wide AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            supplier_id,
            category,
            cost
        FROM with_dims
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        AVG(cost) AS total,
        COUNT(1) AS n
        FOR category IN ('Books', 'Electronics', 'Grocery')
    )
)
SELECT
    supplier_id,
    Books_total,
    Electronics_total,
    Electronics_n,
    Grocery_total,
    Grocery_n
FROM wide
ORDER BY Electronics_n NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("brand", "supplier_id").orderBy("launch_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").desc(), "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("brand")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id", "category").orderBy(F.col("price").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id", "category").orderBy(F.col("cost").asc_nulls_first())

cleaned = (
    df_products
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-04"))) & F.col("supplier_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("cost_filled", F.coalesce("cost", F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("brand_clean", F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_name",
        "category",
        "cost",
        "tags",
        "supplier_id",
        "cost_filled",
        "brand_clean",
        F.avg("price").over(w_running).alias("price_avg_2_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
        F.last("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(w_grp).alias("last_known_cost"),
        F.corr("price", "stock_qty").over(w4).alias("corr_price_stock_qty"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("price_dense_rank"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

with_dims = (
    ranked
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("b"), F.col("e.supplier_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.rating"))
)

wide = (
    with_dims
    .groupBy("supplier_id")
    .pivot("category", ["Books", "Electronics", "Grocery"])

WITH scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        budget,
        LAG(budget) OVER w_running AS prev_budget,
        LEAD(budget) OVER w_running AS next_budget,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS seq_no
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget BETWEEN 3267000 AND 3316000
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY dept_name, location ORDER BY budget, id)
),
scored_departments AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        budget,
        prev_budget,
        LEAD(prev_budget, 1) OVER (ORDER BY prev_budget, id) AS next_prev_budget,
        LAG(next_budget, 2) OVER (ORDER BY next_budget, id) AS prev_next_budget,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prev_budget, id) AS event_seq
    FROM scored
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        budget,
        prev_budget,
        event_seq,
        CAST(prev_next_budget AS INT) AS prev_next_budget_int
    FROM scored_departments
    WHERE next_prev_budget >= 2560000
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        budget,
        prev_budget,
        CAST(prev_next_budget_int AS DOUBLE) AS prev_next_budget_int_str
    FROM filtered
    WHERE event_seq BETWEEN 6 AND 7
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.is_remote
        )
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM kept
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM departments
    WHERE location NOT IN ('Tokyo', 'Berlin', 'New York')
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget >= 3701000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS budget_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(budget), 2) AS avg_budget,
    MAX(prev_budget) AS max_prev_budget
FROM reconciled
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_budget DESC NULLS FIRST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy("budget", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("prev_budget", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("next_budget", "id")

scored = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget").between(3267000, 3316000))
    .select(
        "id",
        "budget",
        F.lag("budget").over(w_running).alias("prev_budget"),
        F.lead("budget").over(w_running).alias("next_budget"),
        F.row_number().over(w_running).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

scored_departments = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "budget",
        "prev_budget",
        F.lead("prev_budget", 1).over(w2).alias("next_prev_budget"),
        F.lag("next_budget", 2).over(w3).alias("prev_next_budget"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored_departments
    .filter(F.col("next_prev_budget") >= 2560000)
    .select(
        "id",
        "budget",
        "prev_budget",
        "event_seq",
        F.col("prev_next_budget").cast("int").alias("prev_next_budget_int"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("event_seq").between(6, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "budget",
        "prev_budget",
        F.col("prev_next_budget_int").cast("double").alias("prev_next_budget_int_str"),
    )
)

kept = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.is_remote")), "left_anti")
)

kept_keys = (
    kept
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_departments
        .filter(~F.col("location").isin(["Tokyo", "Berlin", "New York"]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3701000, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("budget_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("budget"), 2).alias("avg_budget"),
        F.max("prev_budget").alias("max_prev_budget"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_budget").desc_nulls_first())
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

scored = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isin(["/home", "/search", "/checkout"]))
    .withColumn("running_min_duration_sec", F.min("duration_sec").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_avg_duration_sec", F.avg("duration_sec").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_sum_duration_sec", F.sum("duration_sec").over(w_part))

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        rating,
        COALESCE(supplier_name, 'N/A') AS supplier_name_filled,
        LOWER(city) AS city_lower,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') AS city_clean
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND city IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'London'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name_filled,
        city_lower,
        city_clean,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rating NULLS FIRST) AS rating_rank,
        AVG(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS rating_avg_2_prior,
        SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_rating
    FROM valid
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.city_clean,
        s.rating_rank,
        s.rating_avg_2_prior,
        s.cumulative_rating,
        x.product_price,
        x.cost
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.price AS product_price, c.cost
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(rating_avg_2_prior) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY product_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_rating_avg_2_prior,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rating_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS rating_rank_dense_rank,
        SUM(cumulative_rating) OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cumulative_rating,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC) AS cost_dense_rank
    FROM with_last
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.rating_avg_2_prior,
        s.cumulative_rating,
        s.last_known_rating_avg_2_prior,
        s.rating_rank_dense_rank,
        s.cumulative_cumulative_rating,
        s.cost_dense_rank,
        latest.product_price_2
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.price AS product_price_2
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    cumulative_rating,
    last_known_rating_avg_2_prior,
    rating_rank_dense_rank,
    cumulative_cumulative_rating,
    cost_dense_rank,
    product_price_2
FROM latest_match;

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CONCAT(supplier_name, ', ', city) AS supplier_name_city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE country IN ('US', 'TH', 'DE')
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.brand = 'Initech'
        )
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.product_launch_date
    FROM eligible s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.launch_date AS product_launch_date
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.stock_qty DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM with_last
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(rating) OVER w_grp AS prev_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rank_in_group, id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    supplier_name,
    country,
    supplier_name_city,
    product_launch_date
FROM metrics;

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS key, v
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, host
    FROM exploded
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, host
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE level IN ('ERROR', 'INFO')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM exploded s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.host = k.host
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        v,
        SUM(latency_ms) OVER w_grp AS service_sum_latency_ms
    FROM kept_rows
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY service)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        key,
        v,
        service_sum_latency_ms,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(log_ts), host ORDER BY latency_ms ASC NULLS FIRST) AS latency_ms_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service, host ORDER BY latency_ms ASC) AS latency_ms_percent_rank_2
    FROM enriched
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN key = 'trace' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_trace,
        COALESCE(key, 'DIRECT') AS key_filled
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'region'
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    key,
    CASE WHEN is_trace >= 89 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS is_trace_tier,
    COUNT_IF(key = 'version') AS version_events,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(is_trace, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS is_trace_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS distinct_keys,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(key)) AS key_list,
    ROUND(SUM(latency_ms_percent_rank) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN key = 'trace' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS latency_ms_percent_rank_per_trace,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE key = 'version') AS version_rows,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM base
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((key, CASE WHEN is_trace >= 89 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (key), ())
ORDER BY is_trace_tier DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("service")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "host").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service", "host").orderBy("latency_ms")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    exploded
    .select("id", "host")
    .intersectAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("level").isin(["ERROR", "INFO"]))
        .select("id", "host")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    exploded
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.host") == F.col("k.host")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "key",
        "v",
        F.sum("latency_ms").over(w_grp).alias("service_sum_latency_ms"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "key",
        "v",
        "service_sum_latency_ms",
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("latency_ms_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("latency_ms_percent_rank_2"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("region")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("key") == "trace", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_trace"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("key_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .withColumn("is_trace_tier", F.when(F.col("is_trace") >= 89, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets([["key", "is_trace_tier"], ["key"], []], "key", "is_trace_tier")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("key") == "version").alias("version_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_trace", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("is_trace_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("key").alias("distinct_keys"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("key")).alias("key_list"),
        F.round(F.sum("latency_ms_percent_rank") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("key") == "trace", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("latency_ms_percent_rank_per_trace"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("key") == "version", 1)).alias("version_rows"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_trace_tier").desc())
)

sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT id, customer_id, device, browser, started_at, INITCAP(TRIM(device)) device_title FROM sessions WHERE started_at > DATE '2023-08-01' AND country IS NOT NULL), with_gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id) > INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst FROM valid), sessionized AS (SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id FROM with_gaps) SELECT session_id, CASE WHEN session_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS session_id_tier, MIN(session_id) AS min_session_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(is_new_burst, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS is_new_burst_quartiles, SUM(CASE WHEN browser = 'Firefox' THEN is_new_burst ELSE 0 END) AS firefox_is_new_burst, GROUPING(session_id) AS grouping_id FROM sessionized GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((session_id, CASE WHEN session_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (session_id)) HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN browser = 'Firefox' THEN is_new_burst ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY session_id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-08-01").cast("date")) & F.col("country").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        F.initcap(F.trim("device")).alias("device_title"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    valid
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

result = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("session_id_tier", F.when(F.col("session_id") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["session_id", "session_id_tier"], ["session_id"]],
        "session_id",
        "session_id_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("session_id").alias("min_session_id"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_new_burst", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("is_new_burst_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Firefox", F.col("is_new_burst")).otherwise(0)).alias("firefox_is_new_burst"),
        F.grouping("session_id").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("firefox_is_new_burst") > 0)
    .orderBy("session_id")
)

WITH with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.product_id,
        src.unit_price,
        p.order_date,
        p.amount
    FROM order_items src
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON src.order_id = p.id

metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        order_date,
        STDDEV_SAMP(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(order_date), product_id) AS order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(order_date), order_id), 4) AS amount_share
    FROM with_dims
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount,
        amount_share,
        MIN(order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount) OVER w_ordered AS last4_min_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount,
        COUNT(order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount) OVER w_ordered AS last4_count_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount,
        AVG(order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount) OVER w_ordered AS last4_avg_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount,
        SUM(order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount) OVER w_ordered AS last4_sum_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        amount_share,
        last4_avg_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount,
        SUM(amount_share) OVER (ORDER BY order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount_share,
        AVG(amount_share) OVER (ORDER BY order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_share_avg_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        AVG(order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount) OVER (ORDER BY amount_share, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount_avg_2,
        LAG(last4_sum_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY last4_count_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount, id) AS prev_last4_sum_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    id,
    amount_share,
    cumulative_amount_share,
    amount_share_avg_2,
    row_seq,
    order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount_avg_2,
    prev_last4_sum_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount
FROM with_windows;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date"), "product_id")

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

w5 = Window.orderBy("order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.orderBy("amount_share", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.orderBy("last4_count_order_date_month_stddev_samp_amount", "id")

with_dims = (

    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(region)) AS num_regions,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM not_flagged
GROUP BY ROLLUP (region)

        sale_date,
        revenue,
        ceil(units) as units_whole
    from store_sales
    where units <> 17

        src.id,
        src.store_id,
        src.product_id,
        src.revenue,
        src.units_whole,
        p.product_name
    from base src
    left join products p
        on src.product_id = p.id

deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *, row_number() over (partition by store_id order by units_whole nulls first, id) as rn
    from enriched
    qualify rn = 1

metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        revenue,
        units_whole,
        rn,
        row_number() over (partition by product_id order by revenue, id) as event_seq,
        percent_rank() over (order by revenue desc nulls first) as revenue_percent_rank,
        ntile(4) over w_running as revenue_bucket,
        sum(revenue) over (partition by store_id, product_id order by rn, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_revenue,
        avg(units_whole) over (partition by store_id order by units_whole, id rows between 6 preceding and current row) as units_whole_avg_6
    from deduped
    where product_id = 9
    window w_running as (partition by store_id order by revenue desc, id)
),

    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        units_whole,
        rn,
        revenue_percent_rank,
        revenue_bucket,
        units_whole_avg_6,
        row_number() over (order by revenue_percent_rank desc, id) as seq_no,
        round(running_revenue / sum(running_revenue) over (partition by store_id), 4) as running_revenue_share
    from metrics
)

    case when running_revenue_share >= 0.86 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as running_revenue_share_tier,
    round(avg(units_whole), 2) as avg_units_whole,
    count(*) as num_rows,
    avg(units_whole) as avg_units_whole_2
from with_windows

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, temp_c + status_bits AS temp_c_plus_status_bits
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts > TO_DATE('2025-09-01')
      AND TO_DATE(reading_ts) < '2023-11-01'
),
filtered_device_readings AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        temp_c_plus_status_bits,
        ROUND(humidity, 0) AS humidity_rounded
    FROM filtered
    WHERE reading_ts > DATE '2025-09-01'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        LAG(temp_c_plus_status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity_rounded ASC, id ASC) AS prev_temp_c_plus_status_bits,
        LAG(temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity_rounded ASC, id ASC) AS prev_temp_c,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity_rounded ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq
    FROM filtered_device_readings
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM metrics
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag_2
    FROM sessionized
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag_2) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts) AS activity_day,
    CASE WHEN session_start_flag_2 >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS session_start_flag_2_tier,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS num_device_codes,
    MIN(reading_ts) AS first_reading_ts,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(temp_c, 0.5) AS temp_c_p50,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-02' THEN session_start_flag ELSE 0 END) AS dv_02_session_start_flag,
    ROUND(AVG(prev_temp_c), 2) AS avg_prev_temp_c
FROM islands
GROUP BY activity_day, session_start_flag_2_tier
HAVING num_device_codes < 1000

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        firmware,
        CEIL(status_bits) AS status_bits_whole
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 07:00:00'
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) AS prev_reading_ts
    FROM cleaned
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_reading_ts IS NULL OR reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
sessions_device_readings AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        humidity,
        firmware,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_gaps_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL '45' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM sessions_device_readings
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        firmware,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps_2
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        SUM(burst_id) OVER w_running AS running_sum_burst_id,
        COUNT(burst_id) OVER w_running AS running_count_burst_id,
        MIN(burst_id) OVER w_running AS running_min_burst_id,
        MAX(burst_id) OVER w_running AS running_max_burst_id
    FROM islands
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        running_min_burst_id,
        running_max_burst_id
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY running_max_burst_id DESC, id) = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(running_min_burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY running_min_burst_id, id) AS prev_running_min_burst_id,
        LEAD(running_min_burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY running_min_burst_id, id) AS next_running_min_burst_id,
        LAG(running_max_burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY running_min_burst_id, id) AS prev_running_max_burst_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY running_min_burst_id, id) AS seq_no,
        SUM(running_max_burst_id) OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_running_max_burst_id
    FROM ranked
),
totals AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts) AS activity_day,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(reading_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(reading_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        GROUPING(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts)) AS gid
    FROM scored
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts))
)
SELECT activity_day, event_count
FROM totals
ORDER BY activity_day DESC, event_count;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("running_max_burst_id").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("running_min_burst_id", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01 07:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "firmware",
        F.ceil("status_bits").alias("status_bits_whole"),
    )
)

prev_events = cleaned.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_reading_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.col("prev_reading_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_device_readings = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "humidity",
        "firmware",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

with_gaps_2 = (
    sessions_device_readings
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "firmware",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        F.sum("burst_id").over(w2).alias("running_sum_burst_id"),
        F.count("burst_id").over(w2).alias("running_count_burst_id"),
        F.min("burst_id").over(w2).alias("running_min_burst_id"),
        F.max("burst_id").over(w2).alias("running_max_burst_id"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "running_min_burst_id",
        "running_max_burst_id",
    )
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("running_min_burst_id").over(w4).alias("prev_running_min_burst_id"),
        F.lead("running_min_burst_id").over(w4).alias("next_running_min_burst_id"),
        F.lag("running_max_burst_id").over(w4).alias("prev_running_max_burst_id"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("seq_no"),
        F.sum("running_max_burst_id").over(w5).alias("running_running_max_burst_id"),
    )
)

totals = (
    scored
    .withColumn("activity_day", F.date_trunc("DAY", "reading_ts"))
    .rollup("activity_day")
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("reading_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("reading_ts"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.grouping("activity_day").alias("gid"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select("activity_day", "event_count")
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_day").desc(), "event_count")
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', sale_date) AS sale_date_period,
        CAST(units AS DOUBLE) AS units_str
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date > DATE '2023-04-13'
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.store_id,
        s.product_id,
        s.sale_date,
        s.units,
        s.revenue,
        s.units_str,
        p.region
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON s.store_id = p.id
    WHERE p.city IN ('Bangkok', 'New York')
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        units_str,
        region,
        CAST(units_str AS INT) AS units_str_int,
        COALESCE(region, 'N/A') AS region_filled
    FROM joined
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-08-24'
      AND region IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY units_str DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM base
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        store_id,
        region,
        revenue
    FROM deduped
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(revenue) AS total
    FOR region IN ('South', 'East', 'West')
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("units_str").desc(), "id")

valid = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") > F.lit("2023-04-13").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "sale_date").alias("sale_date_period"),
        F.col("units").cast("double").alias("units_str"),
    )
)

joined = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.city").isin(["Bangkok", "New York"]))
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.store_id",
        "s.product_id",
        "s.sale_date",
        "s.units",
        "s.revenue",
        "s.units_str",
        F.col("p.region"),
    )
)

base = (
    joined
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-08-24").cast("date")) & F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        "units_str",
        "region",
        F.col("units_str").cast("int").alias("units_str_int"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("N/A")).alias("region_filled"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy("store_id")
    .pivot("region", ["South", "East", "West"])
    .agg(F.avg("revenue").alias("total"))
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, 'yyyy-MM') paid_at_label
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= DATE '2023-08-19'
      AND method IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'promptpay'
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM cleaned
),
sessions_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.amount,
        a.paid_at,
        o.discount,
        o.amount AS order_amount,
        o.order_date
    FROM sessions_payments a
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON a.order_id = o.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT src.*, p.amount AS order_amount_2
    FROM joined src
    INNER JOIN orders p
        ON src.order_id = p.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id), 4) amount_share,
        AVG(order_amount) OVER w_running order_amount_avg_7d,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_ordered discount_bucket
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY discount, id)
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    kpi,
    metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        order_amount_2,
        amount_share,
        amount
    FROM metrics
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    metric_value FOR kpi IN (order_amount_2 AS ORDER_AMOUNT_2, amount_share AS AMOUNT_SHARE, amount AS AMOUNT_VAL)
) unp

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("discount", "id")

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-08-19").cast("date")) & (F.col("method").eqNullSafe(F.lit("promptpay"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.date_format("paid_at", "yyyy-MM").alias("paid_at_label"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

joined = (
    sessions_payments
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.order_id",
        "a.amount",
        "a.paid_at",
        F.col("o.discount"),
        F.col("o.amount").alias("order_amount"),
        F.col("o.order_date"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.amount").alias("order_amount_2"))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("amount_share", F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w3)), 4))
    .withColumn("order_amount_avg_7d", F.avg("order_amount").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("discount_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w_ordered))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        F.col("order_amount_2").alias("ORDER_AMOUNT_2"),
        F.col("amount_share").alias("AMOUNT_SHARE"),
        F.col("amount").alias("AMOUNT_VAL"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "order_id"],
        values=["ORDER_AMOUNT_2", "AMOUNT_SHARE", "AMOUNT_VAL"],
        variableColumnName="kpi",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS k, value
),
parsed AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        value,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged
    FROM exploded
    WHERE service IN ('checkout', 'billing')
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        STDDEV_SAMP(is_flagged) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_stddev_samp_is_flagged,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY is_flagged) AS is_flagged_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY is_flagged) AS is_flagged_rank
    FROM parsed
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(is_flagged_dense_rank / is_flagged_rank, 2) AS is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE is_flagged_dense_rank < 8
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        is_flagged_dense_rank,
        is_flagged_rank,
        is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank,
        CEIL(is_flagged_dense_rank) AS is_flagged_dense_rank_whole
    FROM valid
    WHERE is_flagged_rank > 7
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(is_flagged_dense_rank, 2) AS is_flagged_dense_rank_rounded
    FROM filtered
    WHERE is_flagged_dense_rank_whole > 75
),
base_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        is_flagged_rank,
        is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank,
        is_flagged_dense_rank_whole,
        is_flagged_dense_rank_rounded,
        CAST(is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank AS INT) AS is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank_int,
        CAST(is_flagged_dense_rank AS STRING) AS is_flagged_dense_rank_str
    FROM base
    WHERE is_flagged_rank <> 7
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank >= 79 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM base_app_logs
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) < 1000
ORDER BY event_count DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service")
w2 = Window.orderBy("is_flagged")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("is_flagged")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

parsed = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("service").isin(["checkout", "billing"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "value",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    parsed
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        F.stddev_samp("is_flagged").over(w).alias("service_stddev_samp_is_flagged"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("is_flagged_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("is_flagged_rank"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged_dense_rank") < 8)
    .withColumn("is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank", F.round((F.col("is_flagged_dense_rank") / F.col("is_flagged_rank")), 2))
)

filtered = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged_rank") > 7)
    .select(
        "is_flagged_dense_rank",
        "is_flagged_rank",
        "is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank",
        F.ceil("is_flagged_dense_rank").alias("is_flagged_dense_rank_whole"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged_dense_rank_whole") > 75)
    .withColumn("is_flagged_dense_rank_rounded", F.round("is_flagged_dense_rank", 2))
)

base_app_logs = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged_rank") != 7)
    .select(
        "is_flagged_rank",
        "is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank",
        "is_flagged_dense_rank_whole",
        "is_flagged_dense_rank_rounded",
        F.col("is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank").cast("int").alias("is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank_int"),
        F.col("is_flagged_dense_rank").cast("string").alias("is_flagged_dense_rank_str"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_app_logs
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank") >= 79, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("is_flagged_dense_rank_per_is_flagged_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("event_count").desc_nulls_first())
)

    FROM customers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL

    FROM cleaned s

            FROM accounts c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.opened_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM accounts ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.opened_date > '2024-07-01'
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        age,
        name_length,
        city_clean,
        account_opened_date,
        LEAD(name_length) OVER w_grp AS next_name_length,
        LAG(age) OVER w_grp AS prev_age,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS seq_no
    FROM kept
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY credit_limit, id)
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', account_opened_date) AS week_start,
        country,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', account_opened_date) AS year_start,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        COUNT_IF(city = 'Singapore') AS singapore_events,
        SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'London' THEN age ELSE 0 END) AS london_age
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
    week_start,
    country,
    year_start,
    num_rows,
    singapore_events,
    CASE WHEN country RLIKE '^(JP|US)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' WHEN country RLIKE '^(TH|SG)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'CORE' END AS country_zone
FROM daily;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.opened_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("credit_limit", "id")

    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",

    .join(df_accounts.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.opened_date").alias("account_opened_date"))
)

kept = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.opened_date") > "2024-07-01"), "left_semi")
)

        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "account_opened_date").alias("week_start"),
        "country",
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "account_opened_date").alias("year_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.count_if(F.col("city") == "Singapore").alias("singapore_events"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", F.col("age")).otherwise(0)).alias("london_age"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "week_start",
        "country",
        "year_start",
        "num_rows",
        "singapore_events",
        F.when(F.col("country").rlike("^(JP|US)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").when(F.col("country").rlike("^(TH|SG)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("CORE").alias("country_zone"),
    )
)

)

    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
