WITH scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(quantity) OVER w_ordered AS prev_quantity,
        LEAD(quantity) OVER w_ordered AS next_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS seq_no
    FROM inventory
    WHERE store_id IN (4, 5)
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity, id)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        next_quantity,
        seq_no,
        DATE_ADD(last_restock, 42) AS last_restock_plus_42d
    FROM scored
    WHERE prev_quantity >= 102
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.region,
        b.store_name
    FROM filtered e
    JOIN stores b
        ON e.store_id = b.id
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, region ORDER BY quantity NULLS FIRST) AS rn
        FROM with_dims
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.product_id,
    s.quantity,
    s.last_restock,
    s.next_quantity,
    s.seq_no,
    s.region,
    s.store_name,
    s.rn,
    CASE WHEN region RLIKE '^(West|North)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' WHEN region RLIKE '^(South|East)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS region_zone,
    (SELECT MIN(s2.units) FROM store_sales s2 WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id) AS min_store_sale_units
FROM latest s

WITH not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM orders s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.order_id IN (17, 33, 37, 40)
        )
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 41 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS shipping_fee_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS week_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', order_date) AS year_start,
    MAX(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SHIPPED') AS shipped_max_amount,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
    STDDEV_SAMP(shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee_stddev,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 41 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END ORDER BY STDDEV_SAMP(shipping_fee) DESC) AS shipping_fee_stddev_rank
FROM not_flagged
GROUP BY shipping_fee_tier, week_start, year_start

WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        latency_ms,
        attr_key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS attr_key, v
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        attr_key,
        v,
        CASE WHEN host IN ('h4', 'h3') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS host_group,
        ROUND(latency_ms * 100, 2) AS latency_ms_scaled
    FROM lines
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
),
base_app_logs AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        v,
        host_group,
        latency_ms_scaled,
        UPPER(attr_key) AS attr_key_upper,
        UPPER(host) AS host_upper
    FROM base
    WHERE attr_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'region'
      AND latency_ms_scaled >= 71
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key_upper,
        host_upper,
        MIN(latency_ms_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS host_min_latency_ms_scaled,
        STDDEV_SAMP(latency_ms_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY latency_ms_scaled DESC NULLS LAST) AS latency_ms_scaled_dense_rank
    FROM base_app_logs
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY host_min_latency_ms_scaled DESC NULLS LAST) AS host_min_latency_ms_scaled_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled DESC NULLS FIRST) AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled) AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2
    FROM with_windows
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        attr_key_upper,
        latency_ms_scaled_dense_rank,
        host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist,
        host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_running AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled DESC NULLS LAST) AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_hist AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_running AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2_rank
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2 DESC NULLS FIRST), w_hist AS (ORDER BY host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled)
)
SELECT
    host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2_dense_rank,
    host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_rank,
    host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2_rank,
    CUME_DIST() OVER w_hist AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_dense_rank_cume_dist,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist) AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_cume_dist_2_rank_rank
FROM enriched
WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_scaled_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST);

        F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1)).alias("debit_rows"),

WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM payments
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM sessionized
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY island_id, id) = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id ORDER BY paid_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS row_num
        FROM ranked
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
ranked_payments AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY paid_at DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
        FROM latest
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', paid_at) AS week_start,
    CASE WHEN island_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS island_id_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(amount, 0.95) AS amount_p95,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids,
    MAX(island_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success_max_island_id
FROM ranked_payments
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', paid_at), CASE WHEN island_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY success_max_island_id DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("island_id", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

gaps = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

latest = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

ranked_payments = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

result = (
    ranked_payments
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "paid_at").alias("week_start"),
        F.when(F.col("island_id") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("island_id_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("amount", 0.95).alias("amount_p95"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("status") == "SUCCESS", F.col("island_id"))).alias("success_max_island_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("success_max_island_id").desc())
)

WITH with_windows AS (

        *,
        SUM(sqft) OVER w_recent AS running_sum_sqft,
        COUNT(sqft) OVER w_recent AS running_count_sqft,
        MIN(sqft) OVER w_recent AS running_min_sqft,
        AVG(sqft) OVER w_recent AS running_avg_sqft,
        FIRST_VALUE(sqft) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_grp AS first_known_sqft
    FROM stores
    WHERE store_name LIKE '%Old%'
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_avg_sqft >= 15100 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS running_avg_sqft_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(sqft), 2) AS avg_sqft,
    COUNT_IF(region = 'South') AS south_events,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(sqft, 0.9) AS sqft_p90
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN running_avg_sqft >= 15100 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END;

WITH scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_duration_sec,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_duration_sec_2
    FROM web_events
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, event_type ORDER BY cumulative_duration_sec_2 ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS latest_rank
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        cumulative_duration_sec
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY cumulative_duration_sec ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank_in_group
        FROM deduped
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT src.*, s.browser
    FROM ranked src
    INNER JOIN sessions s
        ON src.session_id = s.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        cumulative_duration_sec,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY cumulative_duration_sec DESC NULLS LAST) AS cumulative_duration_sec_cume_dist,
        MIN(cumulative_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY browser, session_id) AS browser_min_cumulative_duration_sec
    FROM joined
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    session_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/home' THEN 1 END) AS home_count,
    ROUND(AVG(cumulative_duration_sec_cume_dist), 2) AS avg_cumulative_duration_sec_cume_dist,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(cumulative_duration_sec, 0.5) AS cumulative_duration_sec_p50
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY home_count DESC NULLS FIRST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("end_date")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("end_date"), "plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "start_date"), "plan").orderBy("monthly_fee_filled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("last_known_monthly_fee_filled", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "start_date"), "plan")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_bucket").asc_nulls_last())

cleaned = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("start_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-29"))) & (F.col("end_date") <= "2023-03-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.coalesce("monthly_fee", F.lit(0)).alias("monthly_fee_filled"),
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") * 0.85), 2).alias("adjusted_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        F.ntile(4).over(w2).alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
        F.last("monthly_fee_filled", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_monthly_fee_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("monthly_fee_bucket").over(w4).alias("monthly_fee_bucket_avg_5"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee_bucket").over(w5).alias("start_date_period_avg_monthly_fee_bucket"),
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("monthly_fee_bucket_rank"),
    )
)

summary = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("start_date_period_avg_monthly_fee_bucket") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("start_date_period_avg_monthly_fee_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("last_known_monthly_fee_filled").alias("max_last_known_monthly_fee_filled"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_rows") >= 1)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select("start_date_period_avg_monthly_fee_bucket_tier")
    .orderBy(F.col("start_date_period_avg_monthly_fee_bucket_tier").asc_nulls_first())
    .limit(10)
)

FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY year_start
HAVING row_count < 1000;

with with_last as (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.opened_date,
        latest.amount,
        latest.transaction_txn_time
    from accounts s
    left join lateral (
            select c.amount, c.txn_time as transaction_txn_time
            from transactions c
            where c.account_id = s.id
            order by c.amount desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) latest on true
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        opened_date,
        transaction_txn_time
    from with_last
    qualify row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by transaction_txn_time desc nulls last, id asc) = 1
),
with_last_accounts as (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select s.*, top1.transaction_txn_time_2
    from ranked s
    left join lateral (
            select c.txn_time as transaction_txn_time_2
            from transactions c
            where c.account_id = s.id
              and c.txn_time <= s.transaction_txn_time
            order by c.txn_time desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select *, row_number() over (order by opened_date desc, id asc) as row_seq
    from with_last_accounts
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id
    from scored
    except
    select id
    from accounts
    where status in ('CLOSED', 'FROZEN', 'OPEN')
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        opened_date,
        transaction_txn_time,
        transaction_txn_time_2,
        round(row_seq * 0.85, 2) as row_seq_scaled
    from reconciled
    where to_date(transaction_txn_time_2) >= '2024-05-01'
)
select
    id,
    opened_date,
    transaction_txn_time,
    transaction_txn_time_2,
    row_seq_scaled
from filtered
order by id desc nulls last;

with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, case when status in ('IN_TRANSIT', 'LOST') then 'Core' else 'Other' end as status_group
    from shipments
    where carrier is distinct from 'Kerry'
      and order_id is null
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select e.*, p.status as order_status
    from valid e
    left join orders p
        on e.order_id <=> p.id
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        avg(cost) over w_running as last3_avg_cost,
        sum(cost) over w_running as last3_sum_cost,
        max(cost) over w_running as last3_max_cost
    from joined
    window w_running as (partition by order_id order by delivered_date, id rows between 2 preceding and current row)
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        last3_sum_cost + cost as last3_sum_cost_plus_cost,
        coalesce(order_status, 'DIRECT') as order_status_filled
    from enriched
    where shipped_date >= date '2023-04-28'
      and carrier is not distinct from 'DHL'
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when cost >= 77 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as cost_tier,
    avg(last3_sum_cost_plus_cost) as avg_last3_sum_cost_plus_cost,
    percentile_approx(cost, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as cost_quartiles,
    count_if(order_status = 'CANCELLED') as cancelled_events
from filtered
group by cost_tier
order by avg_last3_sum_cost_plus_cost desc

    df_shipments
    .filter((~F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Kerry"))) & F.col("order_id").isNull())
    .select(

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) li AS k, value
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(k, 1, 2) AS k_prefix
    FROM flattened
    WHERE log_ts > TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-06-01 11:00:00')
      AND k IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        value,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host, k), 4) AS status_code_share,
        MIN(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_min_latency_ms
    FROM base
    WHERE service IN ('auth', 'checkout')
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM scored
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE service NOT IN ('search', 'checkout', 'auth')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN status_code_share >= 0.68 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS status_code_share_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN host = 'h4' THEN status_code_share ELSE 0 END) AS h4_status_code_share,
    ROUND(AVG(k_min_latency_ms), 2) AS avg_k_min_latency_ms,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(status_code_share, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS status_code_share_quartiles
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_k_min_latency_ms DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("host", "k")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

base = (
    flattened
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") > F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2025-06-01 11:00:00"))) & F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("k_prefix", F.substring("k", 1, 2))
)

scored = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("service").isin(["auth", "checkout"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "value",
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
        F.min("latency_ms").over(w2).alias("k_min_latency_ms"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    scored
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(~F.col("service").isin(["search", "checkout", "auth"]))
        .select("id")
    )

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_code_share") >= 0.68, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("status_code_share_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("host") == "h4", F.col("status_code_share")).otherwise(0)).alias("h4_status_code_share"),
        F.round(F.avg("k_min_latency_ms"), 2).alias("avg_k_min_latency_ms"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_code_share", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("status_code_share_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_k_min_latency_ms").desc())
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        status,
        COALESCE(amount, 0) AS amount_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-19 07:00:00'
      AND method IS NOT NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.method,
        a.status,
        a.amount_filled,
        o.discount
    FROM base a
    INNER JOIN orders o
        ON a.order_id <=> o.id
    WHERE o.channel NOT IN ('web', 'mobile', 'store')
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM with_dims
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount_filled) = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.order_id,
        s.method,
        s.discount,
        p.shipping_fee,
        p.channel,
        p.amount
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN orders p
        ON s.order_id = p.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        channel,
        amount,
        rn,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY amount, id) AS amount_bucket,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, order_id ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS amount_rank
    FROM ranked
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, channel ORDER BY rn, id) AS prev_amount,
        LAG(amount_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, channel ORDER BY rn, id) AS prev_amount_bucket,
        LEAD(amount_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, channel ORDER BY rn, id) AS next_amount_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, channel ORDER BY rn, id) AS row_seq
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    channel,
    amount,
    rn,
    amount_bucket,
    amount_rank,
    prev_amount,
    prev_amount_bucket
FROM enriched
ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("amount_filled")

w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("amount", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "channel").orderBy("rn", "id")

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-05-19 07:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("method").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        F.coalesce("amount", F.lit(0)).alias("amount_filled"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("a.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("o.id")), "inner")
    .filter(~F.col("o.channel").isin(["web", "mobile", "store"]))
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.order_id",
        "a.method",
        "a.status",
        "a.amount_filled",
        F.col("o.discount"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

joined = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.order_id",
        "s.method",
        "s.discount",
        F.col("p.shipping_fee"),
        F.col("p.channel"),
        F.col("p.amount"),
    )

ranked = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "rn",
        F.ntile(4).over(w3).alias("amount_bucket"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("amount_rank"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("amount").over(w5).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.lag("amount_bucket").over(w5).alias("prev_amount_bucket"),
        F.lead("amount_bucket").over(w5).alias("next_amount_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "rn",
        "amount_bucket",
        "amount_rank",
        "prev_amount",
        "prev_amount_bucket",

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        GREATEST(unit_price, quantity) AS greatest_unit_price_quantity,
        ROUND(unit_price * 1.1, 2) AS unit_price_adjusted
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id = 16
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        unit_price,
        unit_price_adjusted,
        LAG(unit_price, 1) OVER (ORDER BY greatest_unit_price_quantity, id) AS prev_unit_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS quantity_cume_dist
    FROM base
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY prev_unit_price, id) = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        unit_price,
        unit_price_adjusted,
        prev_unit_price,
        quantity_cume_dist,
        CASE WHEN prev_unit_price >= 420 THEN 'High' WHEN prev_unit_price >= 170 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS prev_unit_price_band
    FROM ranked
    WHERE order_id IN (3, 17, 35)
),
cleaned_order_items AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        unit_price,
        quantity_cume_dist,
        unit_price - quantity_cume_dist AS unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE prev_unit_price <= 390
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity_cume_dist,
        unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist,
        LEAD(unit_price, 2, 0) OVER w_hist AS next_unit_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS row_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(unit_price) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_unit_price
    FROM cleaned_order_items
    WHERE quantity_cume_dist <= 0.41
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity_cume_dist,
        next_unit_price,
        row_seq,
        last_known_unit_price,
        LAG(row_seq) OVER (ORDER BY last_known_unit_price, id) AS prev_row_seq,
        LEAD(unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist) OVER (ORDER BY last_known_unit_price, id) AS next_unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist,
        LAG(unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist) OVER (ORDER BY last_known_unit_price, id) AS prev_unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY last_known_unit_price, id) AS event_seq
    FROM scored
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN prev_unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist >= 67 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS prev_unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist_tier,
    CASE WHEN next_unit_price >= 390 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS next_unit_price_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(next_unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist), 2) AS avg_next_unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist,
    ROUND(AVG(last_known_unit_price), 2) AS avg_last_known_unit_price,
    SUM(last_known_unit_price) AS total_last_known_unit_price
FROM enriched

w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price_minus_quantity_cume_dist", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    )
)

metrics = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "unit_price",
        "unit_price_adjusted",
        F.lag("unit_price", 1).over(w).alias("prev_unit_price"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("quantity_cume_dist"),
    )
)

ranked = (

    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)

)

cleaned = (

    )

deduped AS (

scored AS (

        quantity_rounded,
        rank_in_group,
        LEAD(quantity_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY rank_in_group ASC, id ASC) AS next_quantity_rounded,

    FROM scored
    WHERE rank_in_group > 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY prev_quantity_rounded DESC NULLS LAST) AS dedup_rank
        FROM base_inventory
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
valid_inventory AS (

    .withColumn("is_checkout", F.when(F.col("page") == "/checkout", 1).otherwise(0))
)

remaining_keys = (
    base
    .select("page")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(~F.col("event_type").isin(["search", "purchase"]))
        .select("page")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.page") == F.col("k.page")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",

with_windows = (

    )
)

daily = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_checkout_cume_dist") >= 0.84, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("is_checkout_cume_dist_tier"),

    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("page")).alias("page_list"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.round(F.sum("is_checkout_cume_dist") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/search", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("is_checkout_cume_dist_per_search"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_checkout_cume_dist", 0.9).alias("is_checkout_cume_dist_p90"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("page") == "/home", F.col("is_checkout_cume_dist"))).alias("home_avg_is_checkout_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "is_checkout_cume_dist_tier",
        "page_list",
        "num_rows",
        "is_checkout_cume_dist_per_search",
        "is_checkout_cume_dist_p90",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("is_checkout_cume_dist_p90").asc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("is_checkout_cume_dist_tier").desc(),
    )

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), end_date) AS days_since_end_date,
        CASE WHEN plan = 'standard' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_standard
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE monthly_fee > 90
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM base e
    INNER JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON e.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND e.start_date >= sub.start_date
       AND e.start_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL '14' DAY
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, plan ORDER BY subscription_id, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_count_monthly_fee,
        MIN(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, plan ORDER BY subscription_id, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_min_monthly_fee,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, plan ORDER BY subscription_id, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_avg_monthly_fee
    FROM matched
    WHERE subscription_monthly_fee BETWEEN 210 AND 220
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        c.age,
        c.credit_limit
    FROM scored e
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON e.customer_id = c.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        is_standard,
        subscription_id,
        subscription_monthly_fee,
        last3_count_monthly_fee,
        last3_min_monthly_fee,
        last3_avg_monthly_fee,
        credit_limit,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan), 4) AS monthly_fee_share,
        SUM(last3_count_monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY subscription_id, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_last3_count_monthly_fee
    FROM joined
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY last3_min_monthly_fee NULLS FIRST, id, subscription_id) AS rn
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
enriched_subscriptions AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        subscription_id,
        last3_count_monthly_fee,
        last3_avg_monthly_fee,
        credit_limit,
        cumulative_last3_count_monthly_fee,
        SUM(cumulative_last3_count_monthly_fee) OVER w_ordered AS end_date_year_sum_cumulative_last3_count_monthly_fee,
        AVG(subscription_id) OVER (PARTITION BY status, plan ORDER BY last3_avg_monthly_fee, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS subscription_id_avg_2
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(end_date), status)
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        subscription_id,
        status,
        last3_avg_monthly_fee,
        credit_limit
    FROM enriched_subscriptions
) src
UNPIVOT (
    val FOR metric IN (last3_avg_monthly_fee, credit_limit)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "plan").orderBy("subscription_id", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("subscription_id", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("last3_min_monthly_fee").asc_nulls_first(), "id", "subscription_id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy(F.year("end_date"), "status")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy("last3_avg_monthly_fee", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee") > 90)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date").alias("days_since_end_date"),
        F.when(F.col("plan") == "standard", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_standard"),
    )
)

matched = (
    base
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("e.start_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("e.start_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

scored = (
    matched
    .filter(F.col("subscription_monthly_fee").between(210, 220))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("last3_count_monthly_fee"),
        F.min("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("last3_min_monthly_fee"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("last3_avg_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

joined = (
    scored
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("c.age"), F.col("c.credit_limit"))
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        "is_standard",
        "subscription_id",
        "subscription_monthly_fee",
        "last3_count_monthly_fee",
        "last3_min_monthly_fee",
        "last3_avg_monthly_fee",
        "credit_limit",
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") / F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w2)), 4).alias("monthly_fee_share"),
        F.sum("last3_count_monthly_fee").over(w3).alias("cumulative_last3_count_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

enriched_subscriptions = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "status",
        "subscription_id",
        "last3_count_monthly_fee",
        "last3_avg_monthly_fee",
        "credit_limit",
        "cumulative_last3_count_monthly_fee",
        F.sum("cumulative_last3_count_monthly_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("end_date_year_sum_cumulative_last3_count_monthly_fee"),
        F.avg("subscription_id").over(w6).alias("subscription_id_avg_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_subscriptions
    .select("id", "subscription_id", "status", "last3_avg_monthly_fee", "credit_limit")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "subscription_id", "status"],
        values=["last3_avg_monthly_fee", "credit_limit"],
        variableColumnName="metric",
        valueColumnName="val",
    )
    .filter(F.col("val").isNotNull())
)

WITH with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT a.*, c.city
    FROM accounts a
    JOIN customers c
        ON a.customer_id = c.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        FIRST_VALUE(balance) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_ordered AS first_known_balance,
        LEAD(balance, 2) OVER w_recent AS next_balance,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY balance NULLS LAST) AS balance_dense_rank
    FROM with_dims
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(opened_date), status ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance, id)
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions x
            WHERE x.account_id = s.id
              AND x.amount >= 1700
        )
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(balance_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY next_balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS balance_dense_rank_avg_3,
        FIRST_VALUE(status) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY first_known_balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_status,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY first_known_balance DESC, id) AS first_known_balance_bucket
    FROM not_flagged
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        balance,
        status,
        first_known_balance,
        next_balance,
        balance_dense_rank,
        LAG(balance_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY balance, id) AS prev_balance_dense_rank,
        LEAD(balance_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY balance, id) AS next_balance_dense_rank,
        LAG(next_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY balance, id) AS prev_next_balance,
        LEAD(next_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY balance, id) AS next_next_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY balance, id) AS seq_no
    FROM scored
    WHERE first_known_balance <= 22000
)
SELECT
    id,
    balance,
    first_known_balance,
    next_balance,
    prev_balance_dense_rank,
    next_balance_dense_rank,
    next_next_balance,
    seq_no
FROM metrics

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy(F.month("opened_date"), "status").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("balance", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("balance").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status", "account_type").orderBy("next_balance", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("first_known_balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("first_known_balance").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status", "account_type").orderBy("balance", "id")

with_dims = (
    df_accounts
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("c.city"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        "status",
        F.first("balance", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered).alias("first_known_balance"),
        F.lead("balance", 2).over(w_recent).alias("next_balance"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("balance_dense_rank"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.amount") >= 1700), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    not_flagged
    .withColumn("balance_dense_rank_avg_3", F.avg("balance_dense_rank").over(w4))
    .withColumn("first_known_status", F.first("status", ignorenulls=True).over(w5))
    .withColumn("first_known_balance_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w6))
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("first_known_balance") <= 22000)
    .select(
        "id",
        "balance",
        "status",
        "first_known_balance",
        "next_balance",
        "balance_dense_rank",
        F.lag("balance_dense_rank").over(w7).alias("prev_balance_dense_rank"),
        F.lead("balance_dense_rank").over(w7).alias("next_balance_dense_rank"),
        F.lag("next_balance").over(w7).alias("prev_next_balance"),
        F.lead("next_balance").over(w7).alias("next_next_balance"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "balance",
        "first_known_balance",
        "next_balance",
        "prev_balance_dense_rank",
        "next_balance_dense_rank",
        "next_next_balance",
        "seq_no",
    )
)

with filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, date_format(opened_date, 'MMM yyyy') as opened_date_label
    from stores
    where opened_date >= date '2023-07-27'
      and opened_date >= '2023-05-21'
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        sum(sqft) over (partition by month(opened_date), city order by opened_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_sqft,
        row_number() over (partition by month(opened_date), region order by sqft desc, id) as row_seq,
        ntile(10) over (order by sqft desc, id) as sqft_bucket,
        sum(sqft) over (order by sqft, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_sqft_2,
        ntile(4) over (partition by date_trunc('WEEK', opened_date) order by sqft desc, id) as sqft_bucket_2
    from filtered
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from orders c
            where c.store_id = s.id
              and c.store_id = 40
        )
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        running_sqft,
        sqft_bucket,
        running_sqft_2,
        row_number() over (partition by region order by sqft_bucket, id) as seq_no,
        first_value(sqft_bucket, true) over (partition by city, region order by sqft_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_sqft_bucket
    from eligible
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select
        id,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        running_sqft,
        sqft_bucket,
        first_known_sqft_bucket
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by region order by sqft desc nulls last, id) as rn
        from scored
    ) ranked
    where rn = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    date_trunc('quarter', opened_date) as quarter_start,
    case when sqft_bucket >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as sqft_bucket_tier,
    count(*) filter (where region = 'North') as north_rows,
    avg(sqft) filter (where region = 'South') as south_avg_sqft
from ranked
group by grouping sets ((date_trunc('quarter', opened_date), case when sqft_bucket >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end), (date_trunc('quarter', opened_date)), ())
order by south_avg_sqft

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.month("opened_date"), "city").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("opened_date"), "region").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "opened_date")).orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft_bucket", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("sqft_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") >= F.lit("2023-07-27").cast("date")) & (F.col("opened_date") >= "2023-05-21"))
    .withColumn("opened_date_label", F.date_format("opened_date", "MMM yyyy"))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("running_sqft", F.sum("sqft").over(w))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("sqft_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_sqft_2", F.sum("sqft").over(w4))
    .withColumn("sqft_bucket_2", F.ntile(4).over(w5))
)

eligible = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.store_id") == 40), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        "running_sqft",
        "sqft_bucket",
        "running_sqft_2",
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("seq_no"),
        F.first("sqft_bucket", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("first_known_sqft_bucket"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        "running_sqft",
        "sqft_bucket",
        "first_known_sqft_bucket",
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("quarter", "opened_date"))
    .withColumn("sqft_bucket_tier", F.when(F.col("sqft_bucket") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["quarter_start", "sqft_bucket_tier"], ["quarter_start"], []],
        "quarter_start",
        "sqft_bucket_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "North", 1)).alias("north_rows"),

    )
    .orderBy("south_avg_sqft")
)

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE account_id IN (7, 8, 18, 28)
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.account_id,
        s.amount,
        s.txn_time,
        s.is_flagged,
        s.is_flagged_flag,
        s.resolved_merchant,
        b.account_type,
        b.balance
    FROM filtered s
    LEFT JOIN accounts b
        ON s.account_id = b.id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type) AS account_type_count_balance,
        LEAD(amount, 1) OVER w_hist AS next_amount
    FROM with_dims
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(txn_time), account_id ORDER BY balance, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(next_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, account_type ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id) AS prev_next_amount,
        LAG(account_type_count_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, account_type ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id) AS prev_account_type_count_balance,
        LEAD(account_type_count_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, account_type ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id) AS next_account_type_count_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, account_type ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id) AS row_seq,
        LAG(balance, 1) OVER (ORDER BY account_type_count_balance, id) AS prev_balance
    FROM metrics
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) > INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM with_windows
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
),
flagged_2 AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM sessionized
),
sessionized_transactions AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged_2
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, account_type ORDER BY prev_balance NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM sessionized_transactions
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
)
SELECT
    a.account_type AS account_account_type,
    s.account_type AS transaction_account_type,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    MIN(s.account_type_count_balance) AS min_account_type_count_balance
FROM deduped s
INNER JOIN accounts a ON s.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (a.account_type, s.account_type)
ORDER BY rows_total DESC NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_type")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy("balance", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "account_type").orderBy("is_flagged_flag", "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("account_type_count_balance", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "account_type").orderBy(F.col("prev_balance").asc_nulls_last(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([7, 8, 18, 28]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.col("is_flagged").cast("int").alias("is_flagged_flag"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("b"), F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.account_id",
        "s.amount",
        "s.txn_time",
        "s.is_flagged",
        "s.is_flagged_flag",
        "s.resolved_merchant",
        F.col("b.account_type"),
        F.col("b.balance"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("account_type_count_balance", F.count("balance").over(w))
    .withColumn("next_amount", F.lead("amount", 1).over(w_hist))
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("prev_next_amount", F.lag("next_amount").over(w3))
    .withColumn("prev_account_type_count_balance", F.lag("account_type_count_balance").over(w3))
    .withColumn("next_account_type_count_balance", F.lead("account_type_count_balance").over(w3))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .withColumn("prev_balance", F.lag("balance", 1).over(w4))
)

flagged = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("txn_time") - F.lag("txn_time").over(w5) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w6))

deduped = (

result = (

    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "inner")

    .orderBy(F.col("rows_total").desc_nulls_last())

with valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, concat_ws('-', merchant, txn_type) as merchant_txn_type_key
    from transactions
    where merchant is not null
      and txn_type not in ('DEBIT', 'REFUND', 'FEE')
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        sum(amount) over (partition by merchant order by amount, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_amount,
        max(amount) over (partition by account_id order by cast(txn_time as bigint) range between 2592000 preceding and current row) as amount_max_30d
    from valid
),
base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        merchant_txn_type_key,
        amount_max_30d,
        least(amount_max_30d, amount) as least_amount_max_30d_amount,
        round(amount, 2) as amount_rounded,
        coalesce(merchant, 'OTHER') as resolved_merchant
    from scored
    where not is_flagged
),
latest as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant_txn_type_key,
        amount_rounded,
        resolved_merchant
    from (
        select *, rank() over (partition by txn_type order by least_amount_max_30d_amount desc) as rn
        from base
    ) x
    where rn = 1
),
scored_transactions as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        cume_dist() over w_hist as amount_rounded_cume_dist,
        avg(amount) over (partition by year(txn_time), txn_type order by amount_rounded, id rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding) as amount_avg_6_prior
    from latest
    where amount > 1500
    window w_hist as (partition by account_id order by amount_rounded nulls first)
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        amount,
        merchant_txn_type_key,
        amount_rounded,
        resolved_merchant,
        ntile(4) over (partition by to_date(txn_time), account_id order by amount_avg_6_prior, id) as amount_avg_6_prior_bucket,
        count(amount_rounded_cume_dist) over (partition by account_id order by cast(txn_time as bigint) range between 7776000 preceding and current row) as amount_rounded_cume_dist_count_90d
    from scored_transactions
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        case when amount_avg_6_prior_bucket >= 8 then 'High' when amount_avg_6_prior_bucket >= 3 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as amount_avg_6_prior_bucket_tier,
        case when amount >= 3800 then 'High' when amount >= 1300 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as amount_tier
    from metrics
    where amount_rounded >= 40
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
select *
from (
    select
        id,
        amount,
        amount_rounded
    from cleaned
) src
unpivot (
    val for kpi in (amount, amount_rounded as AMOUNT_ROUNDED_VAL)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("least_amount_max_30d_amount").desc())
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("amount_rounded").asc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "txn_type").orderBy("amount_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy("amount_avg_6_prior", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & ~F.col("txn_type").isin(["DEBIT", "REFUND", "FEE"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", "merchant", "txn_type").alias("merchant_txn_type_key"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("amount").over(w).alias("running_amount"),
        F.max("amount").over(w2).alias("amount_max_30d"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(~F.col("is_flagged"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_txn_type_key",
        "amount_max_30d",
        F.least("amount_max_30d", "amount").alias("least_amount_max_30d_amount"),
        F.round("amount", 2).alias("amount_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant_txn_type_key",
        "amount_rounded",
        "resolved_merchant",
    )
)

scored_transactions = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("amount") > 1500)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist).alias("amount_rounded_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w5).alias("amount_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "merchant_txn_type_key",
        "amount_rounded",
        "resolved_merchant",
        F.ntile(4).over(w6).alias("amount_avg_6_prior_bucket"),
        F.count("amount_rounded_cume_dist").over(w7).alias("amount_rounded_cume_dist_count_90d"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("amount_rounded") >= 40)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("amount_avg_6_prior_bucket") >= 8, "High").when(F.col("amount_avg_6_prior_bucket") >= 3, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("amount_avg_6_prior_bucket_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 3800, "High").when(F.col("amount") >= 1300, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("amount_tier"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .select("id", "amount", F.col("amount_rounded").alias("AMOUNT_ROUNDED_VAL"))
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["amount", "AMOUNT_ROUNDED_VAL"],
        variableColumnName="kpi",
        valueColumnName="val",
    )
    .filter(F.col("val").isNotNull())
)

WITH filtered AS (

    FROM products

        s.product_name,
        s.category,
        s.price,

        x.inventory_last_restock
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.last_restock AS inventory_last_restock
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.price,
        top1.order_item_unit_price
    FROM with_last s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.unit_price AS order_item_unit_price
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_latest_products AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.price,
        latest.inventory_last_restock,
        latest.quantity
    FROM with_latest s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.last_restock AS inventory_last_restock, c.quantity
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(price, 2) OVER (ORDER BY quantity, id) AS prev_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_grp AS price_cume_dist
    FROM with_latest_products
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY price DESC)
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM products
    WHERE cost <= 680
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
enriched_products AS (
    SELECT
        price,
        inventory_last_restock,
        prev_price,
        price_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price_cume_dist NULLS FIRST) AS price_cume_dist_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY quantity DESC NULLS FIRST) AS quantity_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY price) AS price_cume_dist_2
    FROM reconciled
)
SELECT
    price,
    price_cume_dist_dense_rank,
    price_cume_dist_2
FROM enriched_products
ORDER BY price_cume_dist_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.quantity").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy("quantity", "id")
w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("price").desc())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("price_cume_dist").asc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy("price")

filtered = (
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("launch_date") > F.lit("2023-09-20").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("tags_count", F.size("tags"))
)

with_last = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.product_name",
        "s.category",
        "s.price",
        "s.tags_count",
        F.col("c.last_restock").alias("inventory_last_restock"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.id", "s.price", F.col("c.unit_price").alias("order_item_unit_price"))
)

with_latest_products = (
    with_latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.price",
        F.col("c.last_restock").alias("inventory_last_restock"),
        F.col("c.quantity"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_latest_products
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("price", 2).over(w2).alias("prev_price"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_grp).alias("price_cume_dist"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_products
        .filter(F.col("cost") <= 680)
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched_products = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "price",
        "inventory_last_restock",
        "prev_price",
        "price_cume_dist",
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("price_cume_dist_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("quantity_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("price_cume_dist_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_products
    .select("price", "price_cume_dist_dense_rank", "price_cume_dist_2")
    .orderBy(F.col("price_cume_dist_dense_rank").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), shipped_date) / 7 AS weeks_since_shipped_date
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date > TO_DATE('2023-03-29')
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        CAST(weeks_since_shipped_date AS INT) AS weeks_since_shipped_date_int,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS resolved_carrier
    FROM filtered
    WHERE delivered_date >= DATE '2023-03-08'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT e.*, d.discount
    FROM valid e
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON e.order_id = d.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.carrier,
        a.cost,
        a.status,
        a.weeks_since_shipped_date_int,
        a.resolved_carrier,
        a.discount,
        b.channel,
        b.discount AS order_discount
    FROM enriched a
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON a.order_id = b.id
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(discount AS INT) AS discount_int,
        CASE WHEN cost >= 98 THEN 'High' WHEN cost >= 23 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS cost_tier
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE cost BETWEEN 35 AND 52
),
base_shipments AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        cost,
        status,
        weeks_since_shipped_date_int,
        resolved_carrier,
        order_discount,
        discount_int,
        INITCAP(TRIM(carrier)) AS carrier_title,
        SUBSTRING(status, 1, 4) AS status_prefix
    FROM base
    WHERE status IN ('RETURNED', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'LOST')
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        order_discount,
        cost
    FROM base_shipments
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    val FOR kpi IN (order_discount AS ORDER_DISCOUNT, cost AS COST_VAL)
) long_rows

WITH latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.employee_hire_date
    FROM departments s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.hire_date AS employee_hire_date
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget, id) AS prev_budget,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY budget, id) AS budget_bucket
    FROM latest_match
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        employee_hire_date,
        budget_bucket
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget_bucket DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        employee_hire_date,
        budget_bucket,
        LAG(budget_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY employee_hire_date, id) AS prev_budget_bucket,
        LEAD(budget_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY employee_hire_date, id) AS next_budget_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY employee_hire_date, id) AS event_seq
    FROM ranked
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.budget_bucket,
        s.prev_budget_bucket,
        s.event_seq,
        top1.hire_date
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.hire_date
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
grouped AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN prev_budget_bucket >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_budget_bucket_tier,
        CASE WHEN event_seq >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS event_seq_tier,
        CASE WHEN budget_bucket >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS budget_bucket_tier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids_2,
        ROUND(AVG(budget_bucket), 2) AS avg_budget_bucket,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(budget_bucket, 0.95) AS budget_bucket_p95
    FROM with_latest
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN prev_budget_bucket >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN event_seq >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN budget_bucket >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
)
SELECT
    budget_bucket_tier,
    distinct_ids,
    distinct_ids_2
FROM grouped;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.salary").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy("budget", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("budget", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget_bucket").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("employee_hire_date", "id")

latest_match = (
    df_departments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.hire_date").alias("employee_hire_date"))
)

with_windows = (
    latest_match
    .withColumn("prev_budget", F.lag("budget").over(w2))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("budget_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w3))
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "employee_hire_date", "budget_bucket")
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "employee_hire_date",
        "budget_bucket",
        F.lag("budget_bucket").over(w5).alias("prev_budget_bucket"),
        F.lead("budget_bucket").over(w5).alias("next_budget_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.budget_bucket",
        "s.prev_budget_bucket",
        "s.event_seq",
        F.col("c.hire_date"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    with_latest
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("prev_budget_bucket") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("prev_budget_bucket_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("event_seq_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("budget_bucket") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("budget_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
        F.round(F.avg("budget_bucket"), 2).alias("avg_budget_bucket"),
        F.percentile_approx("budget_bucket", 0.95).alias("budget_bucket_p95"),
    )
)

result = grouped.select("budget_bucket_tier", "distinct_ids", "distinct_ids_2")

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        CONCAT(device, ' ', browser) AS device_browser,
        COALESCE(country, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-06-21 09:00:00')
      AND TO_DATE(started_at) >= '2023-11-05'
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM cleaned
),
islands AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT e.*, b.credit_limit
    FROM islands e
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON e.customer_id = b.id
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) AS prev_started_at
    FROM with_dims
),
gaps_2 AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps_2
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        CASE WHEN burst_id >= 7 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS burst_id_tier,
        CASE WHEN session_no >= 6 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS session_no_tier,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(browser)) AS num_browsers,
        AVG(is_new_burst) AS avg_is_new_burst,
        COUNT_IF(device = 'mobile') AS mobile_events
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    burst_id_tier,
    session_no_tier,
    num_browsers,
    mobile_events
FROM summary

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-06-21 09:00:00"))) & (F.to_date("started_at") >= "2023-11-05"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.concat("device", F.lit(" "), "browser").alias("device_browser"),
        F.coalesce("country", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_country"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

with_dims = (
    islands
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.credit_limit"))
)

with_prev = with_dims.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w3))

gaps_2 = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps_2.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w4))

summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy(
        "customer_id",
        F.when(F.col("burst_id") >= 7, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("burst_id_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("session_no") >= 6, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("session_no_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("browser")).alias("num_browsers"),
        F.avg("is_new_burst").alias("avg_is_new_burst"),
        F.count_if(F.col("device") == "mobile").alias("mobile_events"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "burst_id_tier",
        "session_no_tier",
        "num_browsers",
        "mobile_events",
    )
)
