WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(level) AS clean_level,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'NONE') AS job_title_clean
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-06-13'
      AND dept_id = 37
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, job_title ORDER BY salary DESC, id) AS rn
    FROM base
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        is_remote,
        level,
        clean_level,
        rn,
        LAG(salary, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY rn, id) AS prev_salary,
        LAST_VALUE(level) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, job_title ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_level
    FROM ranked
    WHERE dept_id IN (13, 33)
),
ranked_employees AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level, job_title ORDER BY rn, id) AS rn_2
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY rn_2 = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY prev_salary DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn_3
    FROM ranked_employees
    QUALIFY rn_3 = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN prev_salary >= 130000 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS prev_salary_tier,
    CASE WHEN salary >= 121000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS salary_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE level = 'L5') AS l5_rows,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS level_list
FROM deduped
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY salary_tier DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("manager_id", "job_title").orderBy(F.col("salary").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("rn", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "job_title").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level", "job_title").orderBy("rn", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy(F.col("prev_salary").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

base = (
    df_employees
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-13").cast("date")) & (F.col("dept_id") == 37))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("level").alias("clean_level"),
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("NONE")).alias("job_title_clean"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("dept_id").isin([13, 33]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "is_remote",
        "level",
        "clean_level",
        "rn",
        F.lag("salary", 1).over(w2).alias("prev_salary"),
        F.last("level", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_level"),
    )
)

ranked_employees = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rn_2", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn_2") == 1)
)

deduped = (
    ranked_employees
    .withColumn("rn_3", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn_3") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_salary") >= 130000, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("prev_salary_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("salary") >= 121000, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("salary_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "L5", 1)).alias("l5_rows"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("level")).alias("level_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("salary_tier").desc())
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("budget").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy("latest_rank", "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_first())
w_running_2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy("budget_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy("dept_name_min_budget", "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("prev_budget", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget_bucket").desc(), "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("prev_budget").desc(), "id")

ranked = (
    df_departments
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("location").isin(["Bangkok", "Singapore", "Chiang Mai"]))
    .withColumn("budget_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w2))
    .withColumn("prev_budget", F.lag("budget", 1, 0).over(w3))
    .withColumn("budget_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_running))
    .withColumn("dept_name_min_budget", F.min("budget").over(w_running_2))

    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "location",
        "budget",

        "budget_bucket",

        "dept_name_min_budget",

        F.lead("budget_bucket", 1).over(w7).alias("next_budget_bucket"),
        F.avg("budget_percent_rank").over(w_recent).alias("budget_percent_rank_avg_6"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w9).alias("budget_bucket_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w10).alias("row_seq"),

WITH exploded AS (

        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS key, v
)
SELECT
    key,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts) AS activity_day,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE key = 'trace') AS trace_rows,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(service)) AS num_services,
    COUNT_IF(service = 'billing') AS billing_events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS distinct_keys,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(key)) AS key_list
FROM exploded
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((key, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts)), (key))
HAVING billing_events >= 1
ORDER BY activity_day DESC

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        ROUND(amount * 1.15, 2) AS adjusted_amount
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
      AND txn_time > DATE '2023-11-11'
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.account_id,
        a.txn_time,
        a.is_flagged,
        d.opened_date,
        d.status
    FROM valid a
    INNER JOIN accounts d
        ON a.account_id = d.id
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_dims
),
sessions_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS prev_session_id,
        LEAD(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS next_session_id,
        LAG(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS prev_new_group_flag,
        LEAD(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS next_new_group_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS event_seq
    FROM sessions_transactions
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        status,
        new_group_flag
    FROM scored
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(new_group_flag)
    FOR status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED')
);

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("opened_date", "id")

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & (F.col("txn_time") > F.lit("2023-11-11").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.col("is_flagged").cast("int").alias("is_flagged_flag"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") * 1.15), 2).alias("adjusted_amount"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    valid
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("d"), F.col("a.account_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.account_id",
        "a.txn_time",
        "a.is_flagged",
        F.col("d.opened_date"),
        F.col("d.status"),
    )
)

    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

scored = (

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        units,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_revenue,
        MIN(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY units DESC, id) AS row_seq
    FROM store_sales
),
enriched_store_sales AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        row_seq,
        AVG(running_min_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY running_sum_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_min_revenue_avg_3_prior,
        LAG(running_min_revenue, 2) OVER (ORDER BY running_sum_revenue, id) AS prev_running_min_revenue,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_min_revenue) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_recent AS first_known_running_min_revenue
    FROM enriched
    WHERE units BETWEEN 15 AND 20
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY running_sum_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        prev_running_min_revenue,
        first_known_running_min_revenue,
        SUM(prev_running_min_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_revenue_avg_3_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_prev_running_min_revenue,
        MAX(prev_running_min_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_revenue_avg_3_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_prev_running_min_revenue,
        COUNT(prev_running_min_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_revenue_avg_3_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_prev_running_min_revenue
    FROM enriched_store_sales
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        prev_running_min_revenue,
        first_known_running_min_revenue,
        running_max_prev_running_min_revenue,
        MIN(running_count_prev_running_min_revenue) OVER w_recent AS last7_min_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue,
        SUM(running_count_prev_running_min_revenue) OVER w_recent AS last7_sum_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue,
        AVG(running_count_prev_running_min_revenue) OVER w_recent AS last7_avg_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue,
        MAX(running_count_prev_running_min_revenue) OVER w_recent AS last7_max_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY running_count_prev_running_min_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    id,
    prev_running_min_revenue,
    last7_sum_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue,
    last7_avg_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue,
    last7_max_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY last7_avg_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue DESC NULLS FIRST, prev_running_min_revenue DESC;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

w6 = Window.orderBy("running_min_revenue_avg_3_prior", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

enriched = (

        F.lag("running_min_revenue", 2).over(w4).alias("prev_running_min_revenue"),
        F.first("running_min_revenue", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("first_known_running_min_revenue"),

)

        F.max("running_count_prev_running_min_revenue").over(w7).alias("last7_max_running_count_prev_running_min_revenue"),

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT e.*, b.channel
    FROM shipments e
    INNER JOIN orders b
        ON e.order_id <=> b.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(shipped_date) ORDER BY cost, id) AS row_seq,
        SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) AS cost_share,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier, channel) AS carrier_sum_cost
    FROM joined
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        cost,
        status,
        channel,
        row_seq,
        cumulative_cost,
        carrier_sum_cost,
        UPPER(channel) AS channel_upper,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), shipped_date) / 7 AS weeks_since_shipped_date,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS resolved_carrier
    FROM metrics
    WHERE delivered_date > TO_DATE('2023-05-09')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(carrier_sum_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY carrier_sum_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_carrier_sum_cost,
        COUNT(carrier_sum_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY carrier_sum_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_carrier_sum_cost,
        AVG(carrier_sum_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY carrier_sum_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_carrier_sum_cost,
        MIN(carrier_sum_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY carrier_sum_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_carrier_sum_cost,
        AVG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY carrier_sum_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_2_prior
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE order_id IN (4, 27, 36, 37)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY running_sum_carrier_sum_cost DESC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM enriched
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(running_min_carrier_sum_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY running_min_carrier_sum_cost, id) AS next_running_min_carrier_sum_cost,
        LAG(running_min_carrier_sum_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY running_min_carrier_sum_cost, id) AS prev_running_min_carrier_sum_cost,
        LEAD(cost_avg_2_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY running_min_carrier_sum_cost, id) AS next_cost_avg_2_prior,
        LAG(cost_avg_2_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY running_min_carrier_sum_cost, id) AS prev_cost_avg_2_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY running_min_carrier_sum_cost, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY running_sum_carrier_sum_cost DESC, id) AS running_sum_carrier_sum_cost_bucket
    FROM deduped
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    order_id,
    channel,
    CASE WHEN running_sum_carrier_sum_cost >= 2040 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS running_sum_carrier_sum_cost_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN carrier_sum_cost ELSE 0 END) AS web_carrier_sum_cost,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DELIVERED') AS delivered_rows
FROM scored
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((order_id, channel, CASE WHEN running_sum_carrier_sum_cost >= 2040 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (order_id, channel), (order_id), ())

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.month("shipped_date")).orderBy("cost", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "channel")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("carrier_sum_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("carrier_sum_cost", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("running_sum_carrier_sum_cost").desc())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("running_min_carrier_sum_cost", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("running_sum_carrier_sum_cost").desc(), "id")

joined = (
    df_shipments
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("e.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.channel"))
)

metrics = (
    joined
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("cumulative_cost", F.sum("cost").over(w2))
    .withColumn("cost_share", F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w3)), 4))
    .withColumn("carrier_sum_cost", F.sum("cost").over(w4))
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("delivered_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-09")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "row_seq",
        "cumulative_cost",
        "carrier_sum_cost",
        F.upper("channel").alias("channel_upper"),
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "shipped_date") / 7).alias("weeks_since_shipped_date"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([4, 27, 36, 37]))
    .withColumn("running_sum_carrier_sum_cost", F.sum("carrier_sum_cost").over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_count_carrier_sum_cost", F.count("carrier_sum_cost").over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_avg_carrier_sum_cost", F.avg("carrier_sum_cost").over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_min_carrier_sum_cost", F.min("carrier_sum_cost").over(w5))
    .withColumn("cost_avg_2_prior", F.avg("cost").over(w6))
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("next_running_min_carrier_sum_cost", F.lead("running_min_carrier_sum_cost").over(w8))
    .withColumn("prev_running_min_carrier_sum_cost", F.lag("running_min_carrier_sum_cost").over(w8))
    .withColumn("next_cost_avg_2_prior", F.lead("cost_avg_2_prior").over(w8))
    .withColumn("prev_cost_avg_2_prior", F.lag("cost_avg_2_prior").over(w8))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .withColumn("running_sum_carrier_sum_cost_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w9))
)

result = (
    scored
    .withColumn("running_sum_carrier_sum_cost_tier", F.when(F.col("running_sum_carrier_sum_cost") >= 2040, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["order_id", "channel", "running_sum_carrier_sum_cost_tier"], ["order_id", "channel"], ["order_id"], []],
        "order_id",
        "channel",
        "running_sum_carrier_sum_cost_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", F.col("carrier_sum_cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("web_carrier_sum_cost"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "DELIVERED", 1)).alias("delivered_rows"),
    )
)

WITH unpacked AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        payload_json,
        context,
        COALESCE(context['region'], 'direct') AS region_or_default,
        context['trace'] AS trace,
        CAST((status_code & 2) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit2,
        FROM_JSON(payload_json, 'STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>').retries AS retry_count,
        GET_JSON_OBJECT(payload_json, '$.duration') AS duration_text
    FROM app_logs
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    level,
    MAX(flag_bit2) FILTER (WHERE host = 'h2') AS h2_max_flag_bit2,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'DEBUG' THEN 1 END) AS debug_count,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(flag_bit2, 0.9) AS flag_bit2_p90,
    ROUND(AVG(retry_count), 2) AS avg_retry_count
FROM unpacked
GROUP BY level
HAVING MAX(flag_bit2) FILTER (WHERE host = 'h2') < 1000000;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

unpacked = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "payload_json",
        "context",
        F.coalesce(F.col("context")["region"], F.lit("direct")).alias("region_or_default"),
        F.col("context")["trace"].alias("trace"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit2"),
        F.from_json("payload_json", "STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>")["retries"].alias("retry_count"),
        F.get_json_object("payload_json", "$.duration").alias("duration_text"),
    )
)

result = (
    unpacked
    .groupBy("level")
    .agg(
        F.max(F.when(F.col("host") == "h2", F.col("flag_bit2"))).alias("h2_max_flag_bit2"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "DEBUG", 1)).alias("debug_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("flag_bit2", 0.9).alias("flag_bit2_p90"),
        F.round(F.avg("retry_count"), 2).alias("avg_retry_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("h2_max_flag_bit2") < 1000000)
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        CASE WHEN carrier IN ('UPS', 'DHL') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS carrier_group,
        CONCAT(status, ', ', carrier) AS status_carrier,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') AS carrier_filled
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date > DATE '2023-03-13'
      AND carrier IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'UPS'
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        carrier_group,
        status_carrier,
        carrier_filled,
        ADD_MONTHS(delivered_date, 12) AS delivered_date_plus_months
    FROM filtered
    WHERE carrier = 'Kerry'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY delivered_date_plus_months NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, carrier ORDER BY shipped_date DESC, id) AS rn
        FROM deduped
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', delivered_date_plus_months) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DELIVERED') AS delivered_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(cost), 2) AS avg_cost
FROM latest
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY delivered_rows DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("delivered_date_plus_months").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status", "carrier").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-03-13").cast("date")) & (F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("UPS"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("carrier").isin(["UPS", "DHL"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("carrier_group"),
        F.concat("status", F.lit(", "), "carrier").alias("status_carrier"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("carrier") == "Kerry")
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "carrier_group",
        "status_carrier",
        "carrier_filled",
        F.add_months("delivered_date", 12).alias("delivered_date_plus_months"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "delivered_date_plus_months").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "DELIVERED", 1)).alias("delivered_rows"),

    select

        service,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) x as attr_key, value

unpacked as (
    -- Higher-order array functions
    select
        id,
        latency_ms,
        cast((status_code & 1) != 0 as int) as is_flagged,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high
    from flattened
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        latency_ms,
        is_flagged,
        status_code_high,
        rank() over (order by status_code_high nulls last) as status_code_high_rank,
        cume_dist() over (order by status_code_high desc) as status_code_high_cume_dist,
        percent_rank() over (order by latency_ms nulls first) as latency_ms_percent_rank
    from unpacked
    where latency_ms = 1649
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        latency_ms,
        is_flagged,
        status_code_high,
        status_code_high_rank,
        status_code_high_cume_dist,
        latency_ms_percent_rank,
        latency_ms_percent_rank - latency_ms as latency_ms_percent_rank_minus_latency_ms,
        status_code_high_rank / nullif(latency_ms_percent_rank, 0) as status_code_high_rank_per_latency_ms_percent_rank
    from scored
    where status_code_high_rank between 4 and 6
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,

        dense_rank() over (order by latency_ms_percent_rank desc nulls first) as latency_ms_percent_rank_dense_rank,
        dense_rank() over w_grp as status_code_high_cume_dist_dense_rank
    from valid
    window w_hist as (order by status_code_high_rank_per_latency_ms_percent_rank desc), w_grp as (order by status_code_high_cume_dist)

    from metrics
    where status_code_high_rank_cume_dist >= 0.32
)

    status_code_high_rank_cume_dist,

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        ADD_MONTHS(sale_date, 12) AS sale_date_plus_months
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date > '2024-11-01'
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        sale_date_plus_months,
        QUARTER(sale_date_plus_months) AS sale_date_plus_months_quarter,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), sale_date) AS days_since_sale_date
    FROM filtered
    WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2023-03-01' AND '2023-05-01'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        units,
        revenue,
        sale_date_plus_months_quarter,
        days_since_sale_date,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY revenue, id) AS revenue_bucket,
        AVG(sale_date_plus_months_quarter) OVER (ORDER BY sale_date_plus_months, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sale_date_plus_months_quarter_avg_3_prior,
        SUM(days_since_sale_date) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(sale_date_plus_months) ORDER BY days_since_sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_days_since_sale_date
    FROM filtered_store_sales
),
scored_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(cumulative_days_since_sale_date) OVER w_hist AS prev_cumulative_days_since_sale_date,
        LEAD(cumulative_days_since_sale_date) OVER w_hist AS next_cumulative_days_since_sale_date,
        LAG(revenue_bucket) OVER w_hist AS prev_revenue_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS seq_no
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY cumulative_days_since_sale_date, id)
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM scored_store_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id = 6
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored_store_sales s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    seq_no,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(days_since_sale_date), 2) AS avg_days_since_sale_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY seq_no DESC NULLS FIRST;

w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("sale_date_plus_months")).orderBy("days_since_sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.orderBy("cumulative_days_since_sale_date", "id")

filtered = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") > "2024-11-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "sale_date",

        "revenue",

    )
)

filtered_store_sales = (

    .filter(F.col("sale_date").between("2023-03-01", "2023-05-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        "sale_date_plus_months",
        F.quarter("sale_date_plus_months").alias("sale_date_plus_months_quarter"),
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "sale_date").alias("days_since_sale_date"),
    )

    .withColumn("prev_revenue_bucket", F.lag("revenue_bucket").over(w_hist))

    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_hist AS adjusted_status_code_rank,

        AVG(latency_ms) OVER w_hist_2 AS k_avg_latency_ms,

        CASE WHEN corr_latency_ms_status_code >= 0.51 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS corr_latency_ms_status_code_tier,

    FROM enriched

        account_id,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        HOUR(txn_time) AS txn_time_hour
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(is_flagged_flag) OVER w_ordered AS prev_is_flagged_flag,
        LEAD(txn_time_hour) OVER w_ordered AS next_txn_time_hour,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS row_seq
    FROM base
    WHERE is_flagged
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY merchant, account_id ORDER BY txn_time_hour, id)
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id, merchant
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE amount < 2000
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.merchant = k.merchant
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        is_flagged_flag / NULLIF(txn_time_hour, 0) AS is_flagged_flag_per_txn_time_hour,
        CEIL(next_txn_time_hour) AS next_txn_time_hour_whole,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'UNKNOWN') AS merchant_filled
    FROM verified
    WHERE merchant IS DISTINCT FROM 'Grab'
      AND txn_time_hour <= 47
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant, account_id ORDER BY is_flagged_flag DESC NULLS FIRST) AS is_flagged_flag_percent_rank
    FROM cleaned
),

        id,
        is_flagged,

        is_flagged_flag_percent_rank,
        COUNT(is_flagged_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS account_id_count_is_flagged_flag,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prev_is_flagged_flag NULLS FIRST) AS prev_is_flagged_flag_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, merchant ORDER BY row_seq) AS row_seq_dense_rank,
        MIN(txn_time_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant) AS merchant_min_txn_time_hour
    FROM metrics
),
filtered AS (

        id,
        is_flagged,
        is_flagged_flag,
        txn_time_hour,

        CASE WHEN account_id_count_is_flagged_flag >= 13 THEN 'High' WHEN account_id_count_is_flagged_flag >= 8 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS account_id_count_is_flagged_flag_tier
    FROM enriched_transactions
    WHERE is_flagged
)

    .withColumn("merchant_filled", F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS next_balance,
        LAG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS prev_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS seq_no
    FROM accounts
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time >= s.opened_date
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(prev_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date), status) AS opened_date_period_avg_prev_balance,
        LAG(next_balance, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY next_balance, id) AS prev_next_balance,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_part AS balance_cume_dist,
        MAX(next_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type) AS account_type_max_next_balance,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type, customer_id ORDER BY next_balance DESC, id) AS next_balance_bucket
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE next_balance > 72000
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY balance DESC)
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions x
            WHERE x.account_id = s.id
              AND x.txn_time < s.opened_date
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.transaction_txn_type
    FROM eligible s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_type AS transaction_txn_type
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    dim.segment,
    dim.country,
    s.status,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    AVG(s.balance) AS avg_balance,
    MAX(s.prev_balance) AS max_prev_balance,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM latest_match s
LEFT JOIN customers dim ON s.customer_id = dim.id
GROUP BY CUBE (dim.segment, dim.country, s.status)
ORDER BY status DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

flagged = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("txn_time") - F.lag("txn_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_transactions
    .groupBy("session_id")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("txn_type") == "REFUND").alias("refund_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "FEE", 1)).alias("fee_count"),
        F.round(F.sum("amount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("merchant") == "Shell", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("amount_per_shell"),
        F.round(F.sum("amount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "FEE", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("amount_per_fee"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("txn_type")).alias("num_txn_types"),
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        unit_price,
        unit_price - quantity AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE quantity > 7
),
base_order_items AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, line_total - unit_price AS line_total_minus_unit_price
    FROM base
    WHERE line_total < 32
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT order_id, product_id
    FROM base_order_items
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT order_id, product_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NULL
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base_order_items s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id AND s.product_id = k.product_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC NULLS FIRST) AS unit_price_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id ORDER BY line_total ASC) AS line_total_cume_dist,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY line_total DESC) AS line_total_cume_dist_2,
        SUM(line_total) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_sum_line_total
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE line_total_minus_unit_price BETWEEN 47 AND 58
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    p.brand,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(a.unit_price_percent_rank) AS total_unit_price_percent_rank,
    AVG(a.line_total_cume_dist_2) AS avg_line_total_cume_dist_2
FROM enriched a
INNER JOIN products p ON a.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (p.brand);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy("line_total")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("line_total").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("quantity") > 7)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        (F.col("unit_price") - F.col("quantity")).alias("line_total"),
    )
)

base_order_items = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("line_total") < 32)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("line_total") - F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_total_minus_unit_price"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    base_order_items
    .select("order_id", "product_id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isNull())
        .select("order_id", "product_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    base_order_items
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("line_total_minus_unit_price").between(47, 58))
    .withColumn("unit_price_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("line_total_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w2))
    .withColumn("line_total_cume_dist_2", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
    .withColumn("order_id_sum_line_total", F.sum("line_total").over(w4))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .rollup(F.col("p.brand").alias("brand"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum(F.col("a.unit_price_percent_rank")).alias("total_unit_price_percent_rank"),
        F.avg(F.col("a.line_total_cume_dist_2")).alias("avg_line_total_cume_dist_2"),
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), opened_date) / 30 AS months_since_opened_date,
        COALESCE(region, 'N/A') AS region_clean
    FROM stores
    WHERE region = 'South'
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        city,
        region,
        sqft
    FROM valid
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(sqft) AS amount,
    COUNT(1) AS item_count
    FOR region IN ('Central' AS central, 'East' AS east, 'South' AS south)
)
